[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Require canonical state/view files to move together when canonical state changes.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\nCANONICAL_STATE = \"docs/現在状態.json\"\nGENERATED_VIEWS = {\n    \"BUD.md\",\n    \"docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md\",\n}\n\n\ndef validate_changed_paths(paths: list[str]) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n    changed = set(paths)\n    if CANONICAL_STATE not in changed:\n        return True, \"canonical state unchanged\"\n    missing = sorted(GENERATED_VIEWS - changed)\n    if missing:\n        return False, (\n            \"docs/現在状態.json changed without generated views: \"\n            + \", \".join(missing)\n        )\n    return True, \"canonical state and generated views changed together\"\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--paths-file\", type=Path, required=True)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    paths = [line.strip() for line in args.paths_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").splitlines() if line.strip()]\n    ok, message = validate_changed_paths(paths)\n    print((\"OK: \" if ok else \"FAIL: \") + message)\n    return 0 if ok else 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

atomic-save guard skipped\")\n        return 0\n\n    changed = set(git(\"-c\", \"core.quotepath=false\", \"diff-tree\", \"--no-commit-id\", \"--name-only\", \"-r\", \"HEAD^\", \"HEAD\"))\n    bundle_touched = changed & BUNDLE\n    direct_chat = sorted(p for p in changed if p.startswith(DIRECT_CHAT_PREFIX))\n    state_updates = sorted(p for p in changed if p.startswith(STATE_UPDATE_PREFIX))\n\n    if not bundle_touched and not direct_chat and not state_updates:\n        print(\"OK: commit does not touch the canonical-state bundle\")\n        return 0\n\n    # Canonical direct-chat save: state and both generated views are updated\n    # atomically with exactly one source conversation record.\n    if len(direct_chat) == 1 and BUNDLE <= changed and not state_updates:\n        print(\"OK: atomic direct-chat save bundle\")\n        return 0\n\n    # Canonical state-only update: a machine-readable audit record accompanies\n    # the state and both generated views in the same commit.\n    if not direct_chat and len(state_updates) == 1 and BUNDLE <= changed:\n        print(\"OK: atomic canonical-state update bundle\")\n        return 0\n\n    # Generated-view synchronization PRs intentionally change only the two\n    # derived files; the canonical state is unchanged in this commit.\n    if not direct_chat and not state_updates and changed == GENERATED_VIEWS:\n        print(\"OK: generated-view synchronization bundle\")\n        return 0\n\n    print(\"ERROR: invalid canonical-state save/update bundle.\")\n    print(\"Allowed commit shapes:\")\n    print(\"  - docs/現在状態.json + BUD.md + docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md + exactly one 直チャット/*.md\")\n    print(\"  - docs/現在状態.json + BUD.md + docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md + exactly one docs/state-updates/*.json\")\n    print(\"  - generated-view sync: BUD.md + docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md only\")\n    print(f\"Changed paths: {sorted(changed)}\")\n    return 1\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

Existing files must remain byte-for-byte\nunchanged and at the same path; corrections belong in separate supplemental files.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import PurePosixPath\n\n\ndef parse_name_status_z(raw: bytes) -> list[tuple[str, tuple[str, ...]]]:\n    \"\"\"Parse git diff --name-status -z output, including rename records.\"\"\"\n    tokens = raw.decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"surrogateescape\").split(\"\\0\")\n    if tokens and tokens[-1] == \"\":\n        tokens.pop()\n    records: list[tuple[str, tuple[str, ...]]] = []\n    i = 0\n    while i < len(tokens):\n        status = tokens[i]\n        i += 1\n        if status.startswith((\"R\", \"C\")):\n            if i + 1 >= len(tokens):\n                raise ValueError(\"truncated rename/copy record from git diff\")\n            records.append((status, (tokens[i], tokens[i + 1])))\n            i += 2\n        else:\n            if i >= len(tokens):\n                raise ValueError(\"truncated file record from git diff\")\n            records.append((status, (tokens[i],)))\n            i += 1\n    return records\n\n\ndef is_direct_chat_path(path: str) -> bool:\n    return PurePosixPath(path).parts[:1] == (\"直チャット\",)\n\n\ndef violations(records: list[tuple[str, tuple[str, ...]]]) -> list[str]:\n    failures: list[str] = []\n    for status, paths in records:\n        affected = [path for path in paths if is_direct_chat_path(path)]\n        if not affected:\n            continue\n        # Only a genuinely new file is permitted. M/D/T and any rename/copy\n        # involving the protected directory must fail.\n        if status != \"A\":\n            failures.append(f\"{status}: \" + \" -> \".join(affected))\n    return failures\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--base\", required=True, help=\"base commit SHA\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--head\", required=True, help=\"head commit SHA\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    if not args.base or not args.head or set(args.base) == {\"0\"}:\n        print(\"FAIL: missing usable base/head SHA; cannot verify direct-chat originals\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 2\n    try:\n        raw = subprocess.check_output(\n            [\"git\", \"diff\", \"--name-status\", \"-z\", \"--find-renames\", args.base, args.head, \"--\", \"直チャット/\"],\n            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,\n        )\n        failures = violations(parse_name_status_z(raw))\n    except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, ValueError) as exc:\n        print(f\"FAIL: could not verify direct-chat immutability: {exc}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 2\n    if failures:\n        print(\"FAIL: existing direct-chat originals must not be modified, deleted, renamed, or replaced:\")\n        for failure in failures:\n            print(f\"  {failure}\")\n        print(\"Add corrections or interpretations in separate supplemental files; do not edit the original.\")\n        return 1\n    print(\"OK: direct-chat originals are unchanged; new original files may be added.\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Validate the declared kind of a direct-chat save request.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nALLOWED_KINDS = {\"会話記録\", \"保存機構メタ報告\"}\n\n\ndef section(content: str, heading: str) -> str | None:\n    heading_pattern = re.compile(rf\"^##[ \\\\t]+{re.escape(heading)}[ \\\\t]*$\")\n    boundary_pattern = re.compile(r\"^#{1,2}[ \\\\t]+\")\n    lines = content.splitlines()\n    start = None\n    for index, line in enumerate(lines):\n        if heading_pattern.fullmatch(line):\n            start = index + 1\n            break\n    if start is None:\n        return None\n    end = len(lines)\n    for index in range(start, len(lines)):\n        if boundary_pattern.match(lines[index]):\n            end = index\n            break\n    return \"\\n\".join(lines[start:end]).strip()\n\n\ndef validate(content: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n    kind = section(content, \"保存対象種別\")\n    if not kind:\n        return False, \"保存対象種別 is required\"\n    if kind not in ALLOWED_KINDS:\n        return False, f\"unknown 保存対象種別: {kind}\"\n    if kind == \"保存機構メタ報告\":\n        decision = section(content, \"新しい決定事項\")\n        if not decision:\n            return False, \"保存機構メタ報告 requires 新しい決定事項\"\n    return True, \"ok\"\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"path\", type=Path)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    ok, message = validate(args.path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    print(message)\n    return 0 if ok else 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

removed=sorted(set(before)-set(after))\n    changed=sorted(key for key in set(before)&set(after) if {f:before[key].get(f) for f in RECORD_FIELDS}!={f:after[key].get(f) for f in RECORD_FIELDS})\n    return {\"previous_count\":len(previous),\"current_count\":len(current),\"added_count\":len(added),\"changed_count\":len(changed),\"removed_count\":len(removed),\"added\":[after[k] for k in added],\"changed\":[{\"before\":before[k],\"after\":after[k]} for k in changed],\"removed\":[before[k] for k in removed]}\ndef main()->int:\n    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(); parser.add_argument(\"previous\",type=Path); parser.add_argument(\"current\",type=Path); args=parser.parse_args()\n    print(json.dumps(detect(load(args.previous),load(args.current)),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)); return 0\nif __name__==\"__main__\": raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Check a locally synced DiMORA export before normal processing.\n\nThis is an intake check only: it does not normalize or mutate the source.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nREQUIRED_FIELDS = (\"title\", \"startDate\", \"endDate\", \"bcsNm\", \"chNo\", \"mode\")\n\n\ndef load_records(path: Path) -> list[dict]:\n    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    if isinstance(data, dict):\n        data = data.get(\"record\")\n    if not isinstance(data, list) or not all(isinstance(x, dict) for x in data):\n        raise ValueError(\"input must be a JSON array or an object containing record[]\")\n    return data\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"input\", type=Path)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    raw = args.input.read_bytes()\n    records = load_records(args.input)\n    missing = sorted({field for record in records for field in REQUIRED_FIELDS if field not in record})\n    result = {\n        \"path\": str(args.input),\n        \"size_bytes\": len(raw),\n        \"sha256\": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),\n        \"record_count\": len(records),\n        \"required_fields_missing\": missing,\n        \"ready_for_normal_processing\": not missing,\n    }\n    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))\n    return 0 if not missing else 2\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Normalize an exported DiMORA favorite-programs JSON file.\n\nInput is the array written by the authenticated DiMORA page:\nwindow.GL_FAVPGM_DATA.record\nIt also accepts an object containing a \"record\" array.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport json\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\n\nFIELDS = (\n    \"eventId\",\n    \"mindsProgramId\",\n    \"title\",\n    \"startDate\",\n    \"endDate\",\n    \"bcsNm\",\n    \"chNo\",\n    \"mode\",\n    \"requestId\",\n    \"recTimerState\",\n    \"length\",\n    \"status\",\n    \"genre\",\n)\n\n\ndef load_records(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    if isinstance(data, dict):\n        data = data.get(\"record\")\n    if not isinstance(data, list):\n        raise ValueError(\"input must be a JSON array or an object containing record[]\")\n    if not all(isinstance(record, dict) for record in data):\n        raise ValueError(\"every record must be a JSON object\")\n    return data\n\n\ndef normalize_record(record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    return {field: record.get(field) for field in FIELDS}\n\n\ndef normalize(records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n    return [normalize_record(record) for record in records]\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"input\", type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"-o\", \"--output\", type=Path)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    result = normalize(load_records(args.input))\n    text = json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\"\n    if args.output:\n        args.output.write_text(text, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    else:\n        print(text, end=\"\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

progress.get(\"current_step\"),\n            \"steps\": sorted(\n                (\n                    {\"id\": step.get(\"id\"), \"status\": step.get(\"status\")}\n                    for step in progress.get(\"steps\", [])\n                ),\n                key=lambda step: str(step[\"id\"]),\n            ),\n        })\n    payload = {\"work_items\": sorted(work_items, key=lambda item: str(item[\"id\"]))}\n    raw = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(\",\", \":\"))\n    return hashlib.sha256(raw.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()\n\n\ndef has_progress_claim(text: str) -> bool:\n    return any(re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE) for pattern in CLAIM_PATTERNS)\n\n\ndef validate_blocked_output(state: dict, text: str) -> None:\n    readiness = (state.get(\"next_step\") or {}).get(\"readiness\")\n    if readiness == \"blocked\" and has_progress_claim(text):\n        raise ValueError(\n            \"blocked next_step rejects progress/completion claims; \"\n            \"only evidence acquisition, preflight, or unblock work may be reported\"\n        )\n\n\ndef validate_evidence_claim(text: str, evidence: list[dict] | None) -> None:\n    if not has_progress_claim(text):\n        return\n    evidence = evidence or []\n    if not evidence:\n        raise ValueError(\"progress/completion claim requires explicit evidence records\")\n    for item in evidence:\n        if not item.get(\"kind\") or not item.get(\"path\") or not item.get(\"sha256\"):\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence record requires kind, path, and sha256\")\n        path = Path(item[\"path\"])\n        if not path.is_file():\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence file does not exist: \" + str(path))\n        actual = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()\n        if actual != item[\"sha256\"]:\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence SHA-256 mismatch: \" + str(path))\n\n\ndef validate_loop(history: list[dict], threshold: int = 2) -> None:\n    if threshold < 2:\n        raise ValueError(\"loop threshold must be >= 2\")\n    if len(history) < threshold:\n        return\n    tail = history[-threshold:]\n    fingerprints = [item.get(\"state_fingerprint\") for item in tail]\n    # Progress is represented by the structured fingerprint. Do not trust a\n    # caller-supplied progress boolean that can contradict unchanged state.\n    if fingerprints[0] and len(set(fingerprints)) == 1:\n        raise ValueError(\n            f\"forced stop: identical structured work state repeated {threshold} times\"\n        )\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--state\", type=Path, required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--text\", default=\"\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--evidence-json\", type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--history\", type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--loop-threshold\", type=int, default=2)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    try:\n        state = load_json(args.state)\n        validate_blocked_output(state, args.text)\n        evidence = None\n        if args.evidence_json:\n            evidence = json.loads(args.evidence_json.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        validate_evidence_claim(args.text, evidence)\n        if args.history:\n            history = json.loads(args.history.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n            if not isinstance(history, list):\n                raise ValueError(\"history must be a JSON list\")\n            validate_loop(history, args.loop_threshold)\n        print(\"OK: interaction preflight passed\")\n        return 0\n    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:\n        print(f\"STOP: {exc}\")\n        return 2\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "# Dropbox作業管理移行：依存関係・切替対応表\n\n更新日：2026-10-16  \n対象：PR #1116 マージ後の `main`  \n状態：移行の依存関係・履歴記録。現行実装は2026-10-17のPR #1135で旧GitHubキュー参照を廃止中。PR未マージのためmainの切替完了を意味しない。\n\n## 1. 切替の境界\n\n- Dropboxの `/ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx` を、日常作業項目・状態・優先度・次の行動の管理先とする。2026-10-16に実ファイルのメタデータと抽出内容を読み戻し、固定ファイル名と現行行を確認した。\n- GitHubはソースコード、CI、技術状態、正式仕様、PR/commitの証拠、直チャット原本を保持する。\n- 切替前は `docs/現在状態.json` が起動時ゲートとして有効。Dropboxへの切替が検証されるまでは、GitHub側の入口を先行して切り替えない。\n- 既存の直チャット原本は変更・削除・改名・上書き・置換しない。訂正は別ファイルに記録する。\n- 旧作業キュー専用情報は、参照切替後に「廃止・移行先」を明記して残すか、依存と代替先の検証後に整理する。履歴・技術的証拠・原本は作業キューと同じ扱いで削除しない。\n- Dropbox統合ボードの運用ルールは優先度1〜5、既定値3。設計書に残る「優先度未指定」はボード現行ルールと矛盾するため、移行設計側を修正する。\n\n## 2. GitHub依存関係一覧\n\n| 層 | 実ファイル／仕組み | 現在の役割 | 切替方針 | 検証 |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 起動入口 | `README.md` | `docs/現在状態.json` を最初に読み、正本から作業キューを導出するよう指示 | Dropboxボードを日常キューの入口に変更。GitHubの技術資料・履歴への導線は維持 | `scripts/check_entry_docs.py` と入口文書テスト |\n| 読解マップ | `docs/AI_READ_MAP.md` | 現在状態JSONを唯一の作業キュー正本として案内 | Dropboxを日常作業キュー、GitHubを技術情報・証拠の管理先として明記 | 入口検査と文言回帰テスト |\n| ルール入口 | `rules/README.md` | 運用ルールの正本へ案内 | 入口自体は維持し、移行ルールの参照先を追加 | 入口検査 |\n| 運用規則 | `rules/運用ルール.md` | 現在状態JSON、work_items、生成ビューのライフサイクルを規定 | 日常キューの取得先・保留・再実行禁止・証拠・保存分離をDropbox基準へ改訂。技術的な正本・原本保護規則は残す | ルール関連テスト、コールドスタート試験 |\n| 旧作業キュー選択（廃止対象） | `scripts/work_queue.py`、`tests/test_work_queue.py` | 旧JSONキューから候補・next_stepを導出していた | PR #1135でモジュールと専用テストを削除。Dropbox以外の候補選定ロジックを残さない | 参照検索、回帰テスト、CI |\n| 生成ビュー | `scripts/generate_current_views.py` | JSONから `BUD.md` と引き継ぎ文書を生成 | 日常作業キューの複製をやめ、必要な技術状態・入口・保留境界のみを生成するか、用途を明記して維持 | 生成結果の決定性・一致検査 |\n| 現在状態ガード | `scripts/current_state_guard.py` | JSONのスキーマ、work_items、next_step、ビューの整合性を検査 | 技術状態と保存安全性の検査は維持。Dropboxの作業一覧と二重の正本を要求しないよう変更 | 現在状態統合テスト、CI |\n| 再開検査 | `scripts/resume_check.py` | JSONを読み、actionable・waiting_external・next_stepを検査 | 起動案内がDropboxを読み取る手順へ切り替わった後、技術状態の安全ゲートとして残す。Dropboxを取得できない場合に古いキューへ黙ってフォールバックしない | resume checkテスト、コールドスタート試験 |\n| 移行依存関係ガード | `scripts/check_dropbox_migration_map.py` | 移行表・安全境界・廃止済み旧キューコードの残存を検査 | 旧GitHubキュー専用コードを復活させない。現行のDropbox単一正本と歴史記録を区別 | ガード単体テスト、CI |\n| 入口文書検査 | `scripts/check_entry_docs.py` | README、運用ルール、AI_READ_MAPにJSON正本の文言があることを要求 | Dropbox正本の文言とGitHub技術資料の役割分離を要求するよう更新 | このスクリプトのテストとCI |\n| 正本・ビュー同時変更ガード | `scripts/check_canonical_state_change.py` | JSONを変えたらBUD・引き継ぎも同時更新するよう要求 | 移行後にJSONが作業キューではなくなった場合、ガード対象と条件を再定義。移行中は現行ガードを維持 | ガードのユニットテスト |\n| 現在状態CI | `.github/workflows/current-state-guard.yml` | 状態ガード、変更検査、直チャット原本保護、ビュー一致を実行 | 原本保護と必要な技術検証は維持。移行後の正本契約に合わせて検査を更新 | workflow全体のCI |\n| 生成ビューCI | `.github/workflows/current-state-views.yml` | 生成ビュー、保存経路、直接チャット検索等を検証 | 技術的な保存経路・原本保護のテストを維持し、旧作業キュー生成への依存を除去 | workflow全体のCI |\n| 原本保護 | `scripts/check_direct_chat_immutability.py`、`tests/test_check_direct_chat_immutability.py` | 既存 `直チャット/` の変更・削除・改名を検出 | 維持。移行作業で例外化しない | PR #1116 のガードと回帰テスト |\n| 生成ビュー | `BUD.md`、`docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md` | JSONから生成される互換ビュー | 移行後の役割を明示。手動で個別編集しない。必要な情報のみ残す | 生成一致検査 |\n| 技術的正本 | `docs/現在状態.json` | 現行の起動時状態・作業キュー正本 | 切替が検証されるまでは現行契約を維持。切替後は作業キューの複製を止め、必要な技術状態・背景・移行先案内に限定 | JSONスキーマ、CI、コールドスタート |\n| 旧案内 | `docs/全体進行設計図.md`、`docs/マスタープラン.md`、`docs/正本リポジトリ.md` | 過去の正本・読解順・工程を案内している可能性 | 参照箇所を調べ、旧手順に「廃止・移行先」を明記。リンク切れは現行入口へ修正。歴史資料は無断削除しない | リポジトリ全体の参照検索、リンク検査 |\n| 移行設計 | `docs/計画/Dropbox作業管理移行設計.md` | 切替の設計・ゲート | ボードの現行ルール、PR #1116・#1118の実績、実施状況を同期 | 読み戻し、PR差分レビュー |\n\n## 3. Dropboxボードの項目対応\n\n| GitHub側の情報 | Dropbox側 | 切替時の扱い |\n|---|---|---|\n| GSC-確認 | 012 | 外部待ちを維持。同じURL検査・原因切り分けを再実施しない |\n| BLOG-0004 | 013 | 012の完了まで保留。子工程を重複登録しない |\n| GitHub Pages本番運用 | 014 | 継続運用として一本化。確認済み表示確認を繰り返さない |\n| AI-MANUAL-PRODUCTION | 007〜011 | 007は親として全体追跡。008〜010は実サービス確認・公開準備・需要検証、011は条件付き保留。完了済み保存検証を巻き戻さない |\n| PAT-EXPIRY | 015 | 認証方式と承認者の変更はたかの判断待ち |\n| 作業状態正本更新 | 006 | PR/commitとJSONの不一致を正規手順で是正 |\n| 作業キュー生成・再開 | 003 | Dropbox切替対象。技術状態検査・原本保護は維持 |\n| 旧案内・参照先 | 004 | 参照切替後に廃止表示・移行先明記・参照漏れ検査 |\n| コールドスタート | 005 | 切替後、過去会話に頼らずボードから再開できるか検証 |\n| ボード保存・読み戻し | 002 | ユーザー確認により完了扱い。再実施・再監査しない。現行の固定名ボードを通常更新先とし、日時入り複製を作らない |\n\n## 4. 確認済みのPR実績と現行矛盾\n\n- PR #1102：2026-10-15にマージ済み。merge commit `c745fe47744593b6ce14f013e74fc63cd11950f5`。JSON内の「open・未マージ」記述は現状と矛盾する。\n- PR #1111：クローズ・未マージ。マージ実績として扱わない。\n- PR #1118：2026-10-16にマージ済み。既存直チャット原本14件を復元。merge commit `1f00303d0578d6205921a3dff6ebac0c7c6ffd5e`。\n- PR #1116：2026-10-16にマージ済み。Dropbox移行設計と既存直チャット原本保護ガードを導入。merge commit `0a02b47284b64e56c9e366bf646f9281371237c7`。\n- 現在の `docs/現在状態.json` はPR #1102を未マージとする記述を含む。項目006の正規更新で是正する。移行設計の存在を切替完了の証拠にしない。\n\n## 5. 実装順序とゲート\n\n1. **001：対応表確定** — この文書と参照検索結果を使い、参照元・実装・テストを確認する。未確認のパスは確認済みと偽らない。\n2. **006：状態の現在化** — PR #1102等の実績を正本・生成ビューへ正規手順で反映し、CIで検証する。Dropbox切替とは別の変更目的としてレビュー可能にする。\n3. **002：ボード保存・読み戻し** — 新規版を作成し、アップロード後に再読込み。既存ボードは変更しない。Excelの全15項目・ルール・セル内容を確認する。\n4. **003：GitHub入口・生成・検査の切替** — Dropboxを取得する入口、GitHubに残す技術状態、旧キュー参照、ガード、CI、テストを同一の切�... subprocess, sys\nfrom datetime import date\nfrom pathlib import Path\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nsys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / \"scripts\"))\nfrom save_and_currentize import merge_patch, sync_next_step, render_views, STATE_PATH, BUD_PATH, HANDOVER_PATH\n\ndef apply_work_item_updates(state: dict, updates: object) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Apply ID-keyed patches to existing work items without replacing the queue.\"\"\"\n    if updates is None:\n        return\n    if not isinstance(updates, list) or not updates:\n        raise SystemExit(\"work_item_updates must be a non-empty array when provided\")\n    work_items = state.get(\"work_items\")\n    if not isinstance(work_items, list):\n        raise SystemExit(\"state work_items must be an array\")\n    seen_update_ids = set()\n    for update in updates:\n        if not isinstance(update, dict) or set(update) != {\"id\", \"patch\"}:\n            raise SystemExit(\"each work_item_update must contain exactly id and patch\")\n        item_id = update[\"id\"]\n        item_patch = update[\"patch\"]\n        if not isinstance(item_id, str) or not item_id.strip():\n            raise SystemExit(\"work_item_update id must be a non-empty string\")\n        if item_id in seen_update_ids:\n            raise SystemExit(f\"duplicate work_item_update id: {item_id}\")\n        seen_update_ids.add(item_id)\n        if not isinstance(item_patch, dict) or not item_patch:\n            raise SystemExit(f\"work_item_update patch for {item_id} must be a non-empty object\")\n        if \"id\" in item_patch:\n            raise SystemExit(f\"work_item_update may not change id: {item_id}\")\n        matches = [item for item in work_items if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get(\"id\") == item_id]\n        if len(matches) != 1:\n            reason = \"not found\" if not matches else \"is not unique\"\n            raise SystemExit(f\"work_item id {item_id!r} {reason}\")\n        merge_patch(matches[0], item_patch)\n\ndef main():\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--request-file\", type=Path, required=True)\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n    req = json.loads(args.request_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    uid = req.get(\"update_id\", \"\")\n    if not re.fullmatch(r\"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,70}\", uid):\n        raise SystemExit(\"invalid update_id\")\n    patch = req.get(\"patch\", {})\n    work_item_updates = req.get(\"work_item_updates\")\n    if not isinstance(patch, dict):\n        raise SystemExit(\"patch must be an object\")\n    if not patch and (not isinstance(work_item_updates, list) or not work_item_updates):\n        raise SystemExit(\"provide a non-empty patch or work_item_updates array\")\n    if \"work_items\" in patch and work_item_updates is not None:\n        raise SystemExit(\"use either patch.work_items or work_item_updates, not both\")\n    for key in (\"purpose\", \"source\"):\n        if not isinstance(req.get(key), str) or not req[key].strip():\n            raise SystemExit(f\"{key} must be a non-empty string\")\n    audit_path = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"state-updates\" / f\"{uid}.json\"\n    if audit_path.exists():\n        raise SystemExit(f\"refusing to overwrite {audit_path.relative_to(ROOT)}\")\n    state = json.loads(STATE_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    merge_patch(state, patch)\n    apply_work_item_updates(state, work_item_updates)\n    state[\"updated\"] = date.today().isoformat()\n    sync_next_step(state)\n    STATE_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    audit = {\"schema_version\": 1, \"date\": uid[:10], \"kind\": \"canonical_state_update\",\n             \"purpose\": req[\"purpose\"], \"source\": req[\"source\"],\n             \"confirmed\": req.get(\"confirmed\", []), \"not_verified\": req.get(\"not_verified\", []),\n             \"references\": req.get(\"references\", []), \"patch\": patch,\n             \"work_item_updates\": work_item_updates or []}\n    for key in (\"confirmed\", \"not_verified\", \"references\"):\n        if not isinstance(audit[key], list):\n            raise SystemExit(f\"{key} must be an array\")\n untouched = [dict(state[\"work_items\"][1]), dict(state[\"work_items\"][2])]\n        apply_work_item_updates(state, [{\"id\": \"one\", \"patch\": {\"status\": \"done\", \"progress\": {\"current\": This keeps canonical state changes on the normal\n    atomic save path while allowing the queue entry to request an explicit state patch.\n    \"\"\"\n    pattern = re.compile(\n isinstance(patch, dict):\n        raise SystemExit(\"embedded state patch must be a JSON object\")\n    cleaned = (content[:match.start()] + content[match.end():]).strip() + \"\\n\"\n    return cleaned, patch\n\n\ndef sync_next_step(state: dict) -> None:\n    item = derived_next_step(state[\"work_items\"], state.get(\"updated\"))\n    if item is None:\n        state[\"next_step\"] = {}\n        return\n    fields = (\"id\", \"title\", \"priority\", \"depends_on\", \"not_before\", \"environment\",\n              \"scope\", \"target\", \"evidence\", \"readiness\", \"unblock_action\")\n    state[\"next_step\"] = {key: item[key] for key in fields}\n    if item.get(\"readiness\") == \"blocked\":\n        state[\"next_step\"][\"blocked_reason\"] = item[\"blocked_reason\"]\n    state[\"next_step\"][\"prerequisites\"] = item.get(\"prerequisites\", [])\n\n\ndef render_views() -> None:\n    subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, \"scripts/generate_current_views.py\", \"--out-dir\", \".generated-save-views\"],\n        cwd=ROOT,\n        check=True,\n    )\n    src = ROOT / \".generated-save-views\"\n    BUD_PATH.write_text((src / \"BUD.md\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    HANDOVER_PATH.write_text((src / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    subprocess.run([\"rm\", \"-rf\", str(src)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--content-file\", type=Path, help=\"direct-chat markdown; stdin when omitted\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--message\", default=None)\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--state-patch-file\",\n        type=Path,\n        default=None,\n        help=\"optional JSON object recursively merged into docs/現在状態.json before views are generated\",\n    )\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    if run(\"git\", \"diff\", \"--cached\", \"--name-only\"):\n        raise SystemExit(\"refusing to run with pre-staged changes\")\n\n    content = (args.content_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\") if args.content_file else sys.stdin.read())\n    content, embedded_patch = extract_embedded_state_patch(content)\n    if not content.endswith(\"\\n\"):\n        content += \"\\n\"\n\n    now = datetime.now(ZoneInfo(\"Asia/Tokyo\"))\n    save_date = now.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n    timestamp = f\"{save_date}T{now:%H-%M-%S.%f%z}\"\n    filename = f\"{save_date}_直チャット即時保存_{timestamp}.md\"\n    path = DIRECT_CHAT_DIR / filename\n    if path.exists():\n        raise SystemExit(f\"refusing to overwrite existing record: {path}\")\n\n    title = f\"# 直チャット{timestamp}\\n\"\n    if not content.startswith(\"# 直チャット\"):\n        content = title + \"\\n\" + content.lstrip()\n    path.write_text(content, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n    state = json.loads(STATE_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    state[\"updated\"] = save_date\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"latest_saved\"] = timestamp\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"latest_path\"] = f\"直チャット/{filename}\"\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"latest_content_sha\"] = git_blob_sha(content.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"legacy_serial_files_preserved\"] = True\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"new_timestamp_naming_allowed\"] = True\n\n    # Keep canonical save metadata aligned with the sole live entrypoint.\n    state[\"save_pipeline\"][\"normal_entrypoints\"] = [\"save-request-intake.yml (pull_request_target; queue PR required)\"]\n    if args.state_patch_file:\n        patch = json.loads(args.state_patch_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        if not isinstance(patch, dict):\n            raise SystemExit(\"state patch must be a str(BUD_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)),\n        str(HANDOVER_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)),\n    }\n    staged_raw = subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"diff\", \"--cached\", \"--name-only\", \"-z\"], cwd=ROOT)\n    staged = set(p for p in staged_raw.decode(\"utf-8\").split(\"\\0\") if p)\n    if staged != expected:\n        raise SystemExit(f\"unexpected staged paths: {sorted(staged)}\")\n\n    subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"scripts/check_repo_integrity.py\"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"scripts/generate_current_views.py\", \"--out-dir\", subprocess.run([\"cmp\", \"--silent\", \".generated-save-check/現在の引き継ぎ.md\", str(HANDOVER_PATH)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    subprocess.run([\"rm\", \"-rf\", \".generated-save-check\"], cwd=ROOT, merge_patch, sync_next_step, render_views, STATE_PATH, BUD_PATH, HANDOVER_PATH\n\ndef apply_work_item_updates(state: dict, updates: object) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Apply ID-keyed patches to existing work items without replacing the queue.\"\"\"\n    if updates is None:\n        return\n    if not isinstance(updates, list) or not updates:\n        raise SystemExit(\"work_item_updates must be a non-empty array when provided\")\n    work_items = state.get(\"work_items\")\n    if not isinstance(work_items, list):\n        raise SystemExit(\"state work_items must be an array\")\n    seen_update_ids = set()\n    for update in updates:\n        if not isinstance(update, dict) or set(update) != {\"id\", \"patch\"}:\n            raise SystemExit(\"each work_item_update must contain exactly id and patch\")\n        item_id = update[\"id\"]\n        item_patch = update[\"patch\"]\n        if not isinstance(item_id, str) or not item_id.strip():\n            raise SystemExit(\"work_item_update id must be a non-empty string\")\n        if item_id in seen_update_ids:\n            raise SystemExit(f\"duplicate work_item_update id: {item_id}\")\n        seen_update_ids.add(item_id)\n        if not isinstance(item_patch, dict) or not item_patch:\n            raise SystemExit(f\"work_item_update patch for {item_id} must be a non-empty object\")\n        if \"id\" in item_patch:\n            raise SystemExit(f\"work_item_update may not change id: {item_id}\")\n        matches = [item for item in work_items if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get(\"id\") == item_id]\n        if len(matches) != 1:\n            reason = \"not found\" if not matches else \"is not unique\"\n            raise SystemExit(f\"work_item id {item_id!r} {reason}\")\n        merge_patch(matches[0], item_patch)\n\ndef main():\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--request-file\", type=Path, required=True)\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n    req = json.loads(args.request_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    uid = req.get(\"update_id\", \"\")\n    if not re.fullmatch(r\"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,70}\", uid):\n        raise SystemExit(\"invalid update_id\")\n    patch = req.get(\"patch\", {})\n    work_item_updates = req.get(\"work_item_updates\")\n    if not isinstance(patch, dict):\n        raise SystemExit(\"patch must be an object\")\n    if not patch and (not isinstance(work_item_updates, list) or not work_item_updates):\n        raise SystemExit(\"provide a non-empty patch or work_item_updates array\")\n    if \"work_items\" in patch and work_item_updates is not None:\n        raise SystemExit(\"use either patch.work_items or work_item_updates, not both\")\n    for key in (\"purpose\", \"source\"):\n        if not isinstance(req.get(key), str) or not req[key].strip():\n            raise SystemExit(f\"{key} must be a non-empty string\")\n    audit_path = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"state-updates\" / f\"{uid}.json\"\n    if audit_path.exists():\n        raise SystemExit(f\"refusing to overwrite {audit_path.relative_to(ROOT)}\")\n    state = json.loads(STATE_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    merge_patch(state, patch)\n    apply_work_item_updates(state, work_item_updates)\n    state[\"updated\"] = date.today().isoformat()\n    sync_next_step(state)\n    STATE_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    audit = {\"schema_version\": 1, \"date\": uid[:10], \"kind\": \"canonical_state_update\",\n             \"purpose\": req[\"purpose\"], \"source\": req[\"source\"],\n             \"confirmed\": req.get(\"confirmed\", []), \"not_verified\": req.get(\"not_verified\", []),\n             \"references\": req.get(\"references\", []), \"patch\": patch,\n             \"work_item_updates\": work_item_updates or []}\n    for key in (\"confirmed\", \"not_verified\", \"references\"):\n        if not isinstance(audit[key], list):\n            raise SystemExit(f\"{key} must be an array\")\n    audit_path.write_text(json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    render_views()\n    for command in ([sys.executable, \"scripts/check_repo_integrity.py\"],\n                    [sys.executable, \"scripts/current_state_guard.py\"],\n                    [sys.executable, \"scripts/resume_check.py\"]):\n        subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    subprocess.run([\"git\", \"add\", str(STATE_PATH), str(BUD_PATH), str(HANDOVER_PATH), str(audit_path)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    expected = {str(STATE_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)), str(BUD_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)),\n                str(HANDOVER_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)), str(audit_path.relative_to(ROOT))}\n    changed = set(subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"-c\", \"core.quotePath=false\", \"diff\", \"--cached\", \"--name-only\"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).splitlines())\n    if changed != expected:\n        raise SystemExit(f\"unexpected staged paths: {sorted(changed)}\")\n    print(\"OK: canonical state, audit record, and generated views staged atomically\")\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

[L2]   "content": "import unittest\nfrom pathlib import Path\nimport sys\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nsys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / \"scripts\"))\nfrom save_and_currentize import merge_patch\n\nclass CanonicalStateUpdateTests(unittest.TestCase):\n    def test_merge_patch_recurses_and_replaces_lists(self):\n        target = {\"a\": {\"b\": 1, \"keep\": 2}, \"items\": [1, 2]}\n        merge_patch(target, {\"a\": {\"b\": 3}, \"items\": [4]})\n        self.assertEqual(target, {\"a\": {\"b\": 3, \"keep\": 2}, \"items\": [4]})\n    def test_keyed_update_changes_only_matching_item_and_preserves_order(self):\n        from apply_canonical_state_update import apply_work_item_updates\n        state = {\"work_items\": [{\"id\": \"one\", \"status\": \"pending\", \"progress\": {\"steps\": [\"a\", \"b\"]}}, {\"id\": \"two\", \"status\": \"in_progress\", \"note\": \"keep\"}, {\"id\": \"three\", \"status\": \"queued\"}]}\n        untouched = [dict(state[\"work_items\"][1]), dict(state[\"work_items\"][2])]\n        apply_work_item_updates(state, [{\"id\": \"one\", \"patch\": {\"status\": \"done\", \"progress\": {\"current\": \"next\"}}}])\n        self.assertEqual([item[\"id\"] for item in state[\"work_items\"]], [\"one\", \"two\", \"three\"])\n        self.assertEqual(state[\"work_items\"][0], {\"id\": \"one\", \"status\": \"done\", \"progress\": {\"steps\": [\"a\", \"b\"], \"current\": \"next\"}})\n        self.assertEqual(state[\"work_items\"][1:], untouched)\n\n    def test_keyed_update_rejects_missing_and_duplicate_target_ids(self):\n        from apply_canonical_state_update import apply_work_item_updates\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, \"not found\"):\n            apply_work_item_updates({\"work_items\": [{\"id\": \"one\"}]}, [{\"id\": \"missing\", \"patch\": {\"status\": \"done\"}}])\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, \"is not unique\"):\n            apply_work_item_updates({\"work_items\": [{\"id\": \"one\"}, {\"id\": \"one\"}]}, [{\"id\": \"one\", \"patch\": {\"status\": \"done\"}}])\n\n    def test_keyed_update_rejects_duplicate_requests_and_id_mutation(self):\n        from apply_canonical_state_update import apply_work_item_updates\n        state = {\"work_items\": [{\"id\": \"one\", \"status\": \"pending\"}]}\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, \"duplicate work_item_update id\"):\n            apply_work_item_updates(state, [{\"id\": \"one\", \"patch\": {\"status\": \"done\"}}, {\"id\": \"one\", \"patch\": {\"status\": \"pending\"}}])\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, \"may not change id\"):\n            apply_work_item_updates(state, [{\"id\": \"one\", \"patch\": {\"id\": \"two\"}}])\n\n    def test_keyed_update_rejects_invalid_request_shape_and_empty_patch(self):\n        from apply_canonical_state_update import apply_work_item_updates\n        state = {\"work_items\": [{\"id\": \"one\"}]}\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, \"exactly id and patch\"):\n            apply_work_item_updates(state, [{\"id\": \"one\", \"patch\": {\"status\": \"done\"}, \"extra\": True}])\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, \"non-empty object\"):\n            apply_work_item_updates(state, [{\"id\": \"one\", \"patch\": {}}])\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    unittest.main()\n",

[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Generate a freshness manifest from the canonical current-state JSON.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\nimport argparse, hashlib, json\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nSTATE = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"現在状態.json\"\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--output\", type=Path, required=True)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    raw = STATE.read_bytes()\n    state = json.loads(raw.decode(\"utf-8\"))\n    manifest = {\n        \"manifest_version\": 1,\n        \"source\": \"docs/現在状態.json\",\n        \"source_sha256\": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),\n        \"source_updated\": state[\"updated\"],\n        \"execution_environment\": state[\"execution_environment\"],\n        \"current_position\": state[\"current_position\"],\n        \"next_step\": state[\"next_step\"],\n        \"required_first_check\": \"scripts/resume_check.py\",\n        \"stop_if\": [\n            \"canonical state unreadable\",\n            \"required current-state fields missing\",\n            \"active/retired environment conflict\",\n            \"next_step.environment differs from active environment\",\n            \"generated views are not regenerated from the canonical state\",\n        ],\n    }\n    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    print(f\"OK: wrote {args.output}\")\n    print(f\"source_sha256: {manifest['source_sha256']}\")\n    return 0\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Generate a freshness manifest from the canonical current-state JSON.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\nimport argparse, hashlib, json\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nSTATE = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"現在状態.json\"\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--output\", type=Path, required=True)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    raw = STATE.read_bytes()\n    state = json.loads(raw.decode(\"utf-8\"))\n    manifest = {\n        \"manifest_version\": 1,\n        \"source\": \"docs/現在状態.json\",\n        \"source_sha256\": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),\n        \"source_updated\": state[\"updated\"],\n        \"execution_environment\": state[\"execution_environment\"],\n        \"current_position\": state[\"current_position\"],\n        \"next_step\": state[\"next_step\"],\n        \"required_first_check\": \"scripts/resume_check.py\",\n        \"stop_if\": [\n            \"canonical state unreadable\",\n            \"required current-state fields missing\",\n            \"active/retired environment conflict\",\n            \"next_step.environment differs from active environment\",\n            \"generated views are not regenerated from the canonical state\",\n        ],\n    }\n    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    print(f\"OK: wrote {args.output}\")\n    print(f\"source_sha256: {manifest['source_sha256']}\")\n    return 0\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

Dropbox board is the only daily queue\")\n    queue_section = (\n        \"## 作業キュー\\n\\n\"\n        \"- 正本：Dropboxの固定ファイル /ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx\\n\"\n        \"- GitHubは技術状態・履歴・検証証拠を保持し、日常作業の状態を複製しない。\\n\"\n        \"- ボードを読み取れない場合は停止し、古いGitHub項目へフォールバックしない。\"\n    )\n\n    header = f\"\"\"更新日：{state[\"updated\"]}\n\n## 正本\n\n- 正本リポジトリ：{state[\"canonical_repository\"]}\n- 現在状態正本：docs/現在状態.json\n- 現在ビュー：BUD.md / docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md\n\n## 実行環境\n\n- 現在：**{env[\"active\"]}**\n- 退役：{\", \".join(env.get(\"retired\", [])) or \"(なし)\"}\n- work_pc clone：**{state.get(\"work_pc\", {}).get(\"clone_status\", \"unknown\")}**\n\n## 現在地点\n\n**{current[\"summary\"]}**\n\n{queue_section}\n\n\"\"\".rstrip(\"\\n\")\n\n    bud = f\"\"\"# BUD — バドのための最上位ダッシュボード\n\n{header}\n## 現在の作業レーン\n\n**{state[\"primary_lane\"]}**\n\n「一括改修」は設計を一括で行う意味であり、実装は小さな検証単位で進める。\n\n順序：**現状棚卸し → 大手術の設計 → 採用する改善を確定 → 小さな検証単位で順次実装 → 検証**。\n\n- 棚卸し：{surgery[\"inventory\"]}\n- 設計：{surgery[\"design\"]}\n- 採用：{surgery[\"adoption\"]}\n- 実装：{surgery[\"bulk_refactor\"]}\n- 検証：{surgery[\"verification\"]}\n\n## 現在状態モデル\n\n- {model[\"target\"]}\n- 自動生成：{model[\"generation_flow\"]}\n\n## 直チャット\n\n- 最新保存：**{dc[\"latest_saved\"]}**\n- 最新パス：{dc[\"latest_path\"]}\n- 旧連番保存：{str(dc[\"legacy_serial_files_preserved\"]).lower()}\n- 新タイムスタンプ方式：{str(dc[\"new_timestamp_naming_allowed\"]).lower()}\n\n## 移行\n\n- 状態：{migration[\"status\"]}\n- 通常工程：{migration[\"normal_work_policy\"]}\n- 暫定同期：{migration[\"temporary_manual_sync\"]}\n\"\"\"\n\n    handover = f\"\"\"# 現在の引き継ぎ\n\n{header}\n## 現在の作業レーン\n\n**{state[\"primary_lane\"]}**\n\n「一括改修」＝設計を一括、実装を小さな検証単位。\n\n## 現在状態\n\n- 目的：{model[\"target\"]}\n- 自動生成状態：{model[\"status\"]}\n- 生成フロー：{model[\"generation_flow\"]}\n\n## 直チャット\n\n- 最新：**{dc[\"latest_saved\"]}**\n- 実体：{dc[\"latest_path\"]}\n\n## 移行\n\n- {migration[\"normal_work_policy\"]}\n- {migration[\"temporary_manual_sync\"]}\n\"\"\"\n    # Generated views intentionally have no trailing newline; the checked-in views\n    # use the same byte-level contract and CI compares them with cmp.\n    return bud.rstrip(\"\\n\"), handover.rstrip(\"\\n\")\n\ndef check_committed_views(bud: str, handover: str, root: Path = ROOT) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n    \"\"\"Check exact UTF-8 bytes and report the first mismatch for actionable CI failures.\"\"\"\n    expected = (\n        (root / \"BUD.md\", bud),\n        (root / \"docs\" / \"引き継ぎ\" / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\", handover),\n    )\n    for path, rendered in expected:\n        if not path.is_file():\n            return False, f\"committed generated view is missing: {path.relative_to(root)}\"\n        actual_bytes = path.read_bytes()\n        expected_bytes = rendered.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        if actual_bytes != expected_bytes:\n            mismatch = next(\n                (i for i, (actual, expected_byte) in enumerate(zip(actual_bytes, expected_bytes))\n                 if actual != expected_byte),\n                min(len(actual_bytes), len(expected_bytes)),\n            )\n            expected_excerpt = expected_bytes[max(0, mismatch - 24):mismatch + 48].decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n            actual_excerpt = actual_bytes[max(0, mismatch - 24):mismatch + 48].decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n            return False, (\n                f\"committed generated view differs: {path.relative_to(root)}; \"\n                f\"first byte mismatch at offset {mismatch}; \"\n                f\"expected_bytes={len(expected_bytes)}, actual_bytes={len(actual_bytes)}; \"\n                f\"expected_excerpt={expected_excerpt!r}; actual_excerpt={actual_excerpt!r}\"\n            )\n    return True, \"checked-in views match canonical state\"\n\n\ndef write_views_atomically(out_dir: Path, bud: str, handover: str) -> None:\n    out_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    temp_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f\".{out_dir.name}.\", dir=out_dir.parent))\n    try:\n        (temp_dir / \"BUD.md\").write_text(bud, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        (temp_dir / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\").write_text(handover, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        if out_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(out_dir)\n        temp_dir.rename(out_dir)\n        temp_dir = None\n    finally:\n        if temp_dir is not None and temp_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir)\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--out-dir\", type=Path, required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--check-deterministic\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--check-committed\", action=\"store_true\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    bud, handover = render(load_state())\n    write_views_atomically(args.out_dir, bud, handover)\n\n    if args.check_deterministic:\n        bud2, handover2 = render(load_state())\n        if (bud, handover) != (bud2, handover2):\n            print(\"FAIL: render is not deterministic\")\n            return 1\n        if bud.endswith(\"\\n\") or handover.endswith(\"\\n\"):\n            print(\"FAIL: generated views must not have a trailing newline\")\n            return 1\n        print(\"OK: deterministic render\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"OK: rendered {args.out_dir / 'BUD.md'}\")\n        print(f\"OK: rendered {args.out_dir / '現在の引き継ぎ.md'}\")\n    if args.check_committed:\n        ok, message = check_committed_views(bud, handover)\n        print((\"OK: \" if ok else \"FAIL: \") + message)\n        if not ok:\n            return 1\n    return 0\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Generate a freshness manifest from the canonical current-state JSON.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\nimport argparse, hashlib, json\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nSTATE = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"現在状態.json\"\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--output\", type=Path, required=True)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    raw = STATE.read_bytes()\n    state = json.loads(raw.decode(\"utf-8\"))\n    manifest = {\n        \"manifest_version\": 1,\n        \"source\": \"docs/現在状態.json\",\n        \"source_sha256\": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),\n        \"source_updated\": state[\"updated\"],\n        \"execution_environment\": state[\"execution_environment\"],\n        \"current_position\": state[\"current_position\"],\n        \"required_first_check\": \"scripts/resume_check.py\",\n        \"stop_if\": [\n            \"canonical state unreadable\",\n            \"required current-state fields missing\",\n            \"active/retired environment conflict\",\n            \"generated views are not regenerated from the canonical state\",\n        ],\n    }\n    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    print(f\"OK: wrote {args.output}\")\n    print(f\"source_sha256: {manifest['source_sha256']}\")\n    return 0\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

BUD_PATH.write_text((src / \"BUD.md\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    HANDOVER_PATH.write_text((src / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    subprocess.run([\"rm\", \"-rf\", str(src)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--content-file\", type=Path, help=\"direct-chat help=\"optional JSON object recursively merged into docs/現在状態.json before views are generated\",\n    )\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    if run(\"git\", \"diff\", \"--cached\", \"--name-only\"):\n        raise SystemExit(\"refusing to run with pre-staged changes\")\n\n    content = (args.content_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\") if args.content_file else sys.stdin.read())\n    content, path.exists():\n        raise SystemExit(f\"refusing to overwrite existing record: {path}\")\n\n    title = f\"# 直チャット{timestamp}\\n\"\n    if not content.startswith(\"# 直チャット\"):\n        content = state[\"direct_chat\"][\"latest_saved\"] = timestamp\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"latest_path\"] = f\"直チャット/{filename}\"\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"latest_content_sha\"] = git_blob_sha(content.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"legacy_serial_files_preserved\"] = True\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"new_timestamp_naming_allowed\"] = True\n\n    # Keep args.state_patch_file:\n        patch = json.loads(args.state_patch_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        if not isinstance(patch, dict):\n            raise SystemExit(\"state patch must be a subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"scripts/check_repo_integrity.py\"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"scripts/generate_current_views.py\", \"--out-dir\", dict):\n        raise SystemExit(\"patch must be an object\")\n    if not patch:\n        raise SystemExit(\"provide a non-empty technical-state patch\")\n    if \"work_items\" in patch or \"work_item_updates\" in request:\n        raise SystemExit(\"GitHub work_items updates are retired; update the Dropbox board for daily queue changes\")\n    return patch\n\n\ndef main():\n    ap = overwrite {audit_path.relative_to(ROOT)}\")\n    state = json.loads(STATE_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    merge_patch(state, patch)\n    state[\"updated\"] = date.today().isoformat()\n    sync_next_step(state)\n    STATE_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    audit = {\"schema_version\": 1, \"date\": uid[:10], \"kind\": \"canonical_state_update\",\n             \"purpose\": req[\"purpose\"], \"source\": req[\"source\"],\n             \"confirmed\": req.get(\"confirmed\", []), \"not_verified\": req.get(\"not_verified\", []),\n             \"references\": req.get(\"references\", []), \"patch\": patch,\n             \"patch\": patch}\n    for key in (\"confirmed\", \"not_verified\", \"references\"):\n        if not isinstance(audit[key], list):\n            raise SystemExit(f\"{key} must be an array\")\n    audit_path.write_text(json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    render_views()\n    for command in ([sys.executable, \"scripts/check_repo_integrity.py\"],\n                    [sys.executable, str(STATE_PATH), str(BUD_PATH), str(HANDOVER_PATH), str(audit_path)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    expected = {str(STATE_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)), str(BUD_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)),\n                str(HANDOVER_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)), str(audit_path.relative_to(ROOT))}\n    changed = set(subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"-c\", \"core.quotePath=false\", \"diff\", \"--cached\", subprocess, sys\nfrom datetime import date\nfrom pathlib import Path\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nsys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / \"scripts\"))\nfrom save_and_currentize import merge_patch, validate_queue_retirement, render_views, STATE_PATH, BUD_PATH, HANDOVER_PATH\n\n\ndef validate_technical_patch(patch: object, request: dict) -> dict:\n    if not isinstance(patch, dict):\n        raise SystemExit(\"patch must be an object\")\n    if not patch:\n        raise SystemExit(\"provide a non-empty technical-state patch\")\n    if \"work_items\" in patch or \"work_item_updates\" in request:\n        raise SystemExit(\"GitHub work_items updates are retired; update the Dropbox board for daily queue changes\")\n    return patch\n\n\ndef main():\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--request-file\", type=Path, required=True)\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n    req = json.loads(args.request_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    uid = req.get(\"update_id\", \"\")\n    if not re.fullmatch(r\"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,70}\", uid):\n        raise SystemExit(\"invalid update_id\")\n    patch = validate_technical_patch(req.get(\"patch\", {}), req)\n    for key in (\"purpose\", \"source\"):\n        if not isinstance(req.get(key), str) or not req[key].strip():\n            raise SystemExit(f\"{key} must be a non-empty string\")\n    audit_path = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"state-updates\" / f\"{uid}.json\"\n    if audit_path.exists():\n        raise SystemExit(f\"refusing to overwrite {audit_path.relative_to(ROOT)}\")\n    state = json.loads(STATE_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    merge_patch(state, patch)\n    state[\"updated\"] = date.today().isoformat()\n    sync_next_step(state)\n    STATE_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    audit = {\"schema_version\": 1, \"date\": uid[:10], \"kind\": \"canonical_state_update\",\n             \"purpose\": req[\"purpose\"], \"source\": req[\"source\"],\n             \"confirmed\": req.get(\"confirmed\", []), \"not_verified\": req.get(\"not_verified\", []),\n             \"references\": req.get(\"references\", []), \"patch\": patch,\n             \"patch\": patch}\n    for key in (\"confirmed\", \"not_verified\", \"references\"):\n        if not isinstance(audit[key], list):\n            raise SystemExit(f\"{key} must be an array\")\n    audit_path.write_text(json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    render_views()\n    for command in ([sys.executable, \"scripts/check_repo_integrity.py\"],\n                    [sys.executable, \"scripts/current_state_guard.py\"],\n                    [sys.executable, \"scripts/resume_check.py\"]):\n        subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    subprocess.run([\"git\", \"add\", str(STATE_PATH), str(BUD_PATH), str(HANDOVER_PATH), str(audit_path)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    expected = {str(STATE_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)), str(BUD_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)),\n                str(HANDOVER_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)), str(audit_path.relative_to(ROOT))}\n    changed = set(subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"-c\", \"core.quotePath=false\", \"diff\", \"--cached\", \"--name-only\"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).splitlines())\n    if changed != expected:\n        raise SystemExit(f\"unexpected staged paths: {sorted(changed)}\")\n    print(\"OK: canonical state, audit [L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Generate a freshness manifest from the canonical current-state JSON.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\nimport argparse, hashlib, json\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nSTATE = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"現在状態.json\"\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--output\", type=Path, required=True)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    raw = STATE.read_bytes()\n    state = json.loads(raw.decode(\"utf-8\"))\n    manifest = {\n        \"manifest_version\": 1,\n        \"source\": \"docs/現在状態.json\",\n        \"source_sha256\": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),\n        \"source_updated\": state[\"updated\"],\n        \"execution_environment\": state[\"execution_environment\"],\n        \"current_position\": state[\"current_position\"],\n        \"required_first_check\": \"scripts/resume_check.py\",\n        \"stop_if\": [\n            \"canonical state unreadable\",\n            \"required current-state fields missing\",\n            \"active/retired environment conflict\",\n            \"generated views are not regenerated from the canonical state\",\n        ],\n    }\n    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    print(f\"OK: wrote {args.output}\")\n    print(f\"source_sha256: {manifest['source_sha256']}\")\n    return 0\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Mechanical preflight for progress claims and conversational loop risk.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nBLOCKED_PROGRESS_PATTERNS = (\n    r\"完了(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"進(?:みました|んだ|めました|めた)\",\n    r\"検証(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"確認(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"実施(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"成功(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"反映(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"解消(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"マージ(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"verified\",\n    r\"completed\",\n    r\"merged\",\n)\n\nCLAIM_PATTERNS = BLOCKED_PROGRESS_PATTERNS + (\n    r\"問題(?:ありません|なし)\",\n    r\"対応(?:済み|しました|した)\",\n)\n\n\ndef load_json(path: Path) -> dict:\n    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n\n\ndef state_fingerprint(state: dict) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Fingerprint actual work progress, not mutable prose in the handoff.\"\"\"\n    work_items = []\n    for item in state.get(\"work_items\", []):\n        progress = item.get(\"progress\") or {}\n        work_items.append({\n            \"id\": item.get(\"id\"),\n            \"status\": item.get(\"status\"),\n            \"readiness\": item.get(\"readiness\"),\n            \"execution_state\": item.get(\"execution_state\"),\n            \"current_step\": progress.get(\"current_step\"),\n            \"steps\": sorted(\n                (\n                    {\"id\": step.get(\"id\"), \"status\": step.get(\"status\")}\n                    for step in progress.get(\"steps\", [])\n                ),\n                key=lambda step: str(step[\"id\"]),\n            ),\n        })\n    payload = {\"work_items\": sorted(work_items, key=lambda item: str(item[\"id\"]))}\n    raw = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(\",\", \":\"))\n    return hashlib.sha256(raw.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()\n\n\ndef has_progress_claim(text: str) -> bool:\n    return any(re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE) for pattern in CLAIM_PATTERNS)\n\n\ndef validate_blocked_output(state: dict, text: str) -> None:\n    readiness = (state.get(\"next_step\") or {}).get(\"readiness\")\n    if readiness == \"blocked\" and has_progress_claim(text):\n        raise ValueError(\n            \"blocked next_step rejects progress/completion claims; \"\n            \"only evidence acquisition, preflight, or unblock work may be reported\"\n        )\n\n\ndef validate_evidence_claim(text: str, evidence: list[dict] | None) -> None:\n    if not has_progress_claim(text):\n        return\n    evidence = evidence or []\n    if not evidence:\n        raise ValueError(\"progress/completion claim requires explicit evidence records\")\n    for item in evidence:\n        if not item.get(\"kind\") or not item.get(\"path\") or not item.get(\"sha256\"):\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence record requires kind, path, and sha256\")\n        path = Path(item[\"path\"])\n        if not path.is_file():\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence file does not exist: \" + str(path))\n        actual = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()\n        if actual != item[\"sha256\"]:\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence SHA-256 mismatch: \" + str(path))\n\n\ndef validate_loop(history: list[dict], threshold: int = 2) -> None:\n    if threshold < 2:\n        raise ValueError(\"loop threshold must be >= 2\")\n    if len(history) < threshold:\n        return\n    tail = history[-threshold:]\n    fingerprints = [item.get(\"state_fingerprint\") for item in tail]\n    # Progress is represented by the structured fingerprint. Do not trust a\n    # caller-supplied progress boolean that can contradict unchanged state.\n    if fingerprints[0] and len(set(fingerprints)) == 1:\n        raise ValueError(\n            f\"forced stop: identical structured work state repeated {threshold} times\"\n        )\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--state\", type=Path, required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--text\", default=\"\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--evidence-json\", type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--history\", type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--loop-threshold\", type=int, default=2)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    try:\n        state = load_json(args.state)\n        validate_blocked_output(state, args.text)\n        evidence = None\n        if args.evidence_json:\n            evidence = json.loads(args.evidence_json.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        validate_evidence_claim(args.text, evidence)\n        if args.history:\n            history = json.loads(args.history.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n            if not isinstance(history, list):\n                raise ValueError(\"history must be a JSON list\")\n            validate_loop(history, args.loop_threshold)\n        print(\"OK: interaction preflight passed\")\n        return 0\n    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:\n        print(f\"STOP: {exc}\")\n        return 2\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Mechanical preflight for progress claims and conversational loop risk.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nBLOCKED_PROGRESS_PATTERNS = (\n    r\"完了(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"進(?:みました|んだ|めました|めた)\",\n    r\"検証(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"確認(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"実施(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"成功(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"反映(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"解消(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"マージ(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"verified\",\n    r\"completed\",\n    r\"merged\",\n)\n\nCLAIM_PATTERNS = BLOCKED_PROGRESS_PATTERNS + (\n    r\"問題(?:ありません|なし)\",\n    r\"対応(?:済み|しました|した)\",\n)\n\n\ndef load_json(path: Path) -> dict:\n    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n\n\ndef state_fingerprint(state: dict) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Fingerprint actual work progress, not mutable prose in the handoff.\"\"\"\n    work_items = []\n    for item in state.get(\"work_items\", []):\n        progress = item.get(\"progress\") or {}\n        work_items.append({\n            \"id\": item.get(\"id\"),\n            \"status\": item.get(\"status\"),\n            \"readiness\": item.get(\"readiness\"),\n            \"execution_state\": item.get(\"execution_state\"),\n            \"current_step\": progress.get(\"current_step\"),\n            \"steps\": sorted(\n                (\n                    {\"id\": step.get(\"id\"), \"status\": step.get(\"status\")}\n                    for step in progress.get(\"steps\", [])\n                ),\n                key=lambda step: str(step[\"id\"]),\n            ),\n        })\n    payload = {\"work_items\": sorted(work_items, key=lambda item: str(item[\"id\"]))}\n    raw = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(\",\", \":\"))\n    return hashlib.sha256(raw.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()\n\n\ndef has_progress_claim(text: str) -> bool:\n    return any(re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE) for pattern in CLAIM_PATTERNS)\n\n\ndef validate_blocked_output(state: dict, text: str) -> None:\n    readiness = (state.get(\"next_step\") or {}).get(\"readiness\")\n    if readiness == \"blocked\" and has_progress_claim(text):\n        raise ValueError(\n            \"blocked next_step rejects progress/completion claims; \"\n            \"only evidence acquisition, preflight, or unblock work may be reported\"\n        )\n\n\ndef validate_evidence_claim(text: str, evidence: list[dict] | None) -> None:\n    if not has_progress_claim(text):\n        return\n    evidence = evidence or []\n    if not evidence:\n        raise ValueError(\"progress/completion claim requires explicit evidence records\")\n    for item in evidence:\n        if not item.get(\"kind\") or not item.get(\"path\") or not item.get(\"sha256\"):\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence record requires kind, path, and sha256\")\n        path = Path(item[\"path\"])\n        if not path.is_file():\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence file does not exist: \" + str(path))\n        actual = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()\n        if actual != item[\"sha256\"]:\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence SHA-256 mismatch: \" + str(path))\n\n\ndef validate_loop(history: list[dict], threshold: int = 2) -> None:\n    if threshold < 2:\n        raise ValueError(\"loop threshold must be >= 2\")\n    if len(history) < threshold:\n        return\n    tail = history[-threshold:]\n    fingerprints = [item.get(\"state_fingerprint\") for item in tail]\n    # Progress is represented by the structured fingerprint. Do not trust a\n    # caller-supplied progress boolean that can contradict unchanged state.\n    if fingerprints[0] and len(set(fingerprints)) == 1:\n        raise ValueError(\n            f\"forced stop: identical structured work state repeated {threshold} times\"\n        )\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--state\", type=Path, required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--text\", default=\"\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--evidence-json\", type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--history\", type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--loop-threshold\", type=int, default=2)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    try:\n        state = load_json(args.state)\n        validate_blocked_output(state, args.text)\n        evidence = None\n        if args.evidence_json:\n            evidence = json.loads(args.evidence_json.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        validate_evidence_claim(args.text, evidence)\n        if args.history:\n            history = json.loads(args.history.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n            if not isinstance(history, list):\n                raise ValueError(\"history must be a JSON list\")\n            validate_loop(history, args.loop_threshold)\n        print(\"OK: interaction preflight passed\")\n        return 0\n    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:\n        print(f\"STOP: {exc}\")\n        return 2\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

json.loads(self.state_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n\n    def test_dropbox_is_the_only_daily_queue_and_legacy_data_is_empty(self):\n        self.assertEqual(self.state[\"work_queue_source\"], \"dropbox_board\")\n        self.assertEqual(self.state.get(\"work_items\"), [])\n        self.assertEqual(self.state[\"next_step\"][\"id\"], \"LEGACY-QUEUE-RETIRED\")\n        self.assertIn(\"Issue #1059\", \" \".join(self.state[\"known_constraints\"]))\n        current_state_guard.validate_state(self.state)\n\n    def test_technical_evidence_survives_queue_removal(self):\n        summary = self.state[\"current_position\"][\"summary\"]\n        self.assertIn(\"部分合格\", summary)\n        self.assertIn(\"チェックボックス\", summary)\n        self.assertIn(\"WritingBlock\", summary)\n        self.assertIn(\"sitemap.xml\", summary)\n        closeout = self.state[\"verification_records\"][\"closeout_sync_gap_2026_10_08\"]\n        self.assertEqual(closeout[\"status\"], \"verified\")\n        self.assertIn(\"一本化\", closeout[\"corrective_action\"])\n\n    def test_generated_views_have_no_github_queue(self):\n        bud, handover = generate_current_views.render(self.state)\n        for view in (bud, handover):\n            self.assertIn(\"/ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx\", view)\n            self.assertIn(\"古いGitHub項目へフォールバックしない\", view)\n            self.assertNotIn(\"actionable：\", view)\n            self.assertNotIn(\"validation-findings-follow-up [in_progress]\", view)\n\n    def test_resume_check_accepts_canonical_state_with_readable_board(self):\n        old_state = resume_check.STATE\n        old_board = os.environ.get(\"DROPBOX_WORK_QUEUE_PATH\")\n        resume_check.STATE = self.state_path\n        try:\n            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:\n                board = Path(td) / \"Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx\"\n                with zipfile.ZipFile(board, \"w\") as workbook:\n                    workbook.writestr(\"[Content_Types].xml\", \"scripts\"))\nfrom generate_current_views import render\nSTATE_PATH = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"現在状態.json\"\n\nREQUIRED = (\"execution_environment\", \"current_position\")\nRETIRED_ALIASES = {\n    \"vaio_p\": (\"vaio_p\", \"VAIO P\", \"VAIO P + Chromium\", \"VAIO P運用\"),\n}\n\ndef fail(message: str) -> None:\n    raise ValueError(message)\n\ndef load_state(path: Path = STATE_PATH) -> dict:\n    try:\n        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    except Exception as exc:\n        fail(f\"canonical state unreadable: {exc}\")\n\ndef validate_external_response_gate(state: dict) -> None:\n    gate = state.get(\"external_response_gate\", {\"status\": \"clear\"})\n    if not isinstance(gate, dict):\n        fail(\"external_response_gate must be an object\")\n    status = gate.get(\"status\", \"clear\")\n    if status not in {\"clear\", \"pending\"}:\n        fail(\"external_response_gate.status must be clear or pending\")\n    contract = gate.get(\"reaction_contract\")\n    if not isinstance(contract, dict):\n        fail(\"external_response_gate.reaction_contract must be an object\")\n    required_contract = (\"required_fields\", \"judgment_values\", \"rule\", \"clear_condition\")\n    missing_contract = [key for key in required_contract if not contract.get(key)]\n    if missing_contract:\n        fail(\"reaction_contract missing: \" + \", \".join(missing_contract))\n    if status == \"clear\" and gate.get(\"last_reaction\") is None and not gate.get(\"clear_reason\"):\n        fail(\"clear external_response_gate requires last_reaction or clear_reason\")\n    reaction = gate.get(\"last_reaction\")\n    if reaction is not None:\n        required_reaction = (\"proposal\", \"judgment\", \"reason\", \"next_action\", \"consistency\")\n        missing_reaction = [key for key in required_reaction if not reaction.get(key)]\n        if missing_reaction:\n            fail(\"last_reaction missing: \" + \", \".join(missing_reaction))\n        if reaction.get(\"judgment\") not in contract[\"judgment_values\"]:\n            fail(\"last_reaction.judgment is invalid\")\n        if reaction.get(\"consistency\") is not True:\n            fail(\"last_reaction.consistency must be true\")\n    if status == \"pending\":\n        required = (\"purpose\", \"trigger\", \"required_action\", \"completion\")\n        missing = [key for key in required if not gate.get(key)]\n        if missing:\n            fail(\"pending external_response_gate missing: \" + \", \".join(missing))\n\n\n\ndef validate_completed_verifications(state: dict) -> None:\n    records = state.get(\"verification_records\")\n    if not isinstance(records, dict):\n        fail(\"verification_records must be an object\")\n    for scope, record in records.items():\n        if not isinstance(record, dict):\n            fail(f\"verification_records[{scope}] must be an object\")\n        if record.get(\"status\") not in {\"verified\", \"unverified\", \"retired\"}:\n            fail(f\"verification_records[{scope}].status must be verified, unverified, or retired\")\n        if record.get(\"status\") == \"retired\":\n            evidence = record.get(\"evidence\")\n            if not isinstance(evidence, dict) or not evidence.get(\"method\") or not evidence.get(\"checked_at\") or not evidence.get(\"reason\"):\n                fail(f\"retired verification record requires method, checked_at, and reason: {scope}\")\n        if record.get(\"status\") == \"verified\":\n            evidence = record.get(\"evidence\")\n            if not isinstance(evidence, dict) or not evidence.get(\"method\") or not evidence.get(\"checked_at\"):\n                fail(f\"verified verification record requires method and checked_at: {scope}\")\n\n\ndef validate_completed_step_prose(state: dict) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Check only current technical-state prose; old queue-step status rules are retired.\"\"\"\n    current = state.get(\"current_position\", {})\n    for key in (\"summary\", \"next_stage_boundary\", \"next_focus\"):\n        value = current.get(key)\n        if isinstance(value, str) and not value.strip():\n            fail(f\"current_position.{key} must not be blank\")\n\n\ndef state.get(\"migration\")\n    if not isinstance(migration, dict):\n        fail(\"WordPress production lane requires migration policy\")\n    policy = migration.get(\"normal_work_policy\", \"\")\n overwrite {audit_path.relative_to(ROOT)}\")\n    state = json.loads(STATE_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    merge_patch(state, patch)\n    state[\"updated\"] = date.today().isoformat()\n the checked-in views\n    # use the same byte-level contract and CI compares them with cmp.\n    return bud.rstrip(\"\\n\"), handover.rstrip(\"\\n\")\n\ndef check_committed_views(bud: str, handover: str, root: Path = ROOT) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n    \"\"\"Check exact UTF-8 bytes and report the first mismatch for actionable CI failures.\"\"\"\n    expected = (\n        (root / \"BUD.md\", bud),\n        (root / \"docs\" / \"引き継ぎ\" / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\", handover),\n    )\n    for path, rendered in expected:\n        if not path.is_file():\n            return False, f\"committed generated view is missing: {path.relative_to(root)}\"\n        actual_bytes = path.read_bytes()\n        expected_bytes = rendered.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        if actual_bytes != expected_bytes:\n            mismatch = next(\n                (i for i, (actual, expected_byte) in enumerate(zip(actual_bytes, expected_bytes))\n                 if actual != expected_byte),\n                min(len(actual_bytes), len(expected_bytes)),\n            )\n            expected_excerpt = expected_bytes[max(0, mismatch - 24):mismatch + 48].decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n            actual_excerpt = actual_bytes[max(0, mismatch - 24):mismatch + 48].decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n            return False, (\n                f\"committed generated view differs: {path.relative_to(root)}; \"\n                f\"first byte mismatch at offset {mismatch}; \"\n                f\"expected_bytes={len(expected_bytes)}, actual_bytes={len(actual_bytes)}; \"\n                f\"expected_excerpt={expected_excerpt!r}; actual_excerpt={actual_excerpt!r}\"\n            )\n    return True, \"checked-in views match canonical state\"\n\n\ndef write_views_atomically(out_dir: Path, bud: str, handover: str) -> None:\n    out_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    temp_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f\".{out_dir.name}.\", dir=out_dir.parent))\n    try:\n        (temp_dir / \"BUD.md\").write_text(bud, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        (temp_dir / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\").write_text(handover, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        if out_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(out_dir)\n        temp_dir.rename(out_dir)\n        temp_dir = None\n    finally:\n        if temp_dir is not None and temp_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir)\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--out-dir\", type=Path, required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--check-deterministic\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--check-committed\", action=\"store_true\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    bud, handover = render(load_state())\n    write_views_atomically(args.out_dir, bud, handover)\n\n    if args.check_deterministic:\n        bud2, handover2 = render(load_state())\n        if (bud, handover) != (bud2, handover2):\n            print(\"FAIL: render is not deterministic\")\n            return 1\n        if bud.endswith(\"\\n\") or handover.endswith(\"\\n\"):\n            print(\"FAIL: generated views must not have a trailing newline\")\n            return 1\n        print(\"OK: deterministic render\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"OK: rendered {args.out_dir / 'BUD.md'}\")\n        print(f\"OK: rendered {args.out_dir / '現在の引き継ぎ.md'}\")\n    if args.check_committed:\n        ok, message = check_committed_views(bud, handover)\n        print((\"OK: \" if ok else \"FAIL: \") + message)\n        if not ok:\n            return 1\n    return 0\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Generate a freshness manifest from the canonical current-state JSON.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\nimport argparse, hashlib, json\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nSTATE = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"現在状態.json\"\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--output\", type=Path, required=True)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    raw = STATE.read_bytes()\n    state = json.loads(raw.decode(\"utf-8\"))\n    manifest = {\n        \"manifest_version\": 1,\n        \"source\": \"docs/現在状態.json\",\n        \"source_sha256\": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),\n        \"source_updated\": state[\"updated\"],\n        \"execution_environment\": state[\"execution_environment\"],\n        \"current_position\": state[\"current_position\"],\n        \"required_first_check\": \"scripts/resume_check.py\",\n        \"stop_if\": [\n            \"canonical state unreadable\",\n            \"required current-state fields missing\",\n            \"active/retired environment conflict\",\n            \"generated views are not regenerated from the canonical state\",\n        ],\n    }\n    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    print(f\"OK: wrote {args.output}\")\n    print(f\"source_sha256: {manifest['source_sha256']}\")\n    return 0\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

guard.validate_loop(history, 2)\n\n    def test_loop_ignores_caller_progress_boolean(self):\n        history = [{\"state_fingerprint\": \"same\", \"progress\": False}, {\"state_fingerprint\": \"same\", \"progress\": True}]\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, \"forced stop\"):\n            guard.validate_loop(history, 2)\n\n    def test_loop_threshold_must_be_at_least_two(self):\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, \"threshold must be >= 2\"):\n            guard.validate_loop([], 1)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    unittest.main()\n",
