[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Mechanical preflight for progress claims and conversational loop risk.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nBLOCKED_PROGRESS_PATTERNS = (\n    r\"完了(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"進(?:みました|んだ|めました|めた)\",\n    r\"検証(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"確認(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"実施(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"成功(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"反映(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"解消(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"マージ(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"verified\",\n    r\"completed\",\n    r\"merged\",\n)\n\nCLAIM_PATTERNS = BLOCKED_PROGRESS_PATTERNS + (\n    r\"問題(?:ありません|なし)\",\n    r\"対応(?:済み|しました|した)\",\n)\n\n\ndef load_json(path: Path) -> dict:\n    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n\n\ndef has_progress_claim(text: str) -> bool:\n    return any(re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE) for pattern in CLAIM_PATTERNS)\n\n\ndef validate_evidence_claim(text: str, evidence: list[dict] | None) -> None:\n    if not has_progress_claim(text):\n        return\n    evidence = evidence or []\n    if not evidence:\n        raise ValueError(\"progress/completion claim requires explicit evidence records\")\n    for item in evidence:\n        if not item.get(\"kind\") or not item.get(\"path\") or not item.get(\"sha256\"):\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence record requires kind, path, and sha256\")\n        path = Path(item[\"path\"])\n        if not path.is_file():\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence file does not exist: \" + str(path))\n        actual = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()\n        if actual != item[\"sha256\"]:\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence SHA-256 mismatch: \" + str(path))\n\n\ndef validate_loop(history: list[dict], threshold: int = 2) -> None:\n    if threshold < 2:\n        raise ValueError(\"loop threshold must be >= 2\")\n    if len(history) < threshold:\n        return\n    tail = history[-threshold:]\n    fingerprints = [item.get(\"state_fingerprint\") for item in tail]\n    # Progress is represented by the structured fingerprint. Do not trust a\n    # caller-supplied progress boolean that can contradict unchanged state.\n    if fingerprints[0] and len(set(fingerprints)) == 1:\n        raise ValueError(\n            f\"forced stop: identical structured work state repeated {threshold} times\"\n        )\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--state\", type=Path, required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--text\", default=\"\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--evidence-json\", type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--history\", type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--loop-threshold\", type=int, default=2)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    try:\n        state = load_json(args.state)\n        evidence = None\n        if args.evidence_json:\n            evidence = json.loads(args.evidence_json.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        validate_evidence_claim(args.text, evidence)\n        if args.history:\n            history = json.loads(args.history.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n            if not isinstance(history, list):\n                raise ValueError(\"history must be a JSON list\")\n            validate_loop(history, args.loop_threshold)\n        print(\"OK: interaction preflight passed\")\n        return 0\n    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:\n        print(f\"STOP: {exc}\")\n        return 2\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

generate_current_views import check_committed_views\n\n\nclass CheckCommittedViewsTests(unittest.TestCase):\n    def setUp(self):\n        self.tempdir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()\n        self.root = Path(self.tempdir.name)\n        (self.root / \"docs\" / \"引き継ぎ\").mkdir(parents=True)\n        (self.root / \"BUD.md\").write_text(\"BUD rendered\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        (self.root / \"docs\" / \"引き継ぎ\" / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\").write_text(\n            \"handover rendered\", encoding=\"utf-8\"\n        )\n\n    def tearDown(self):\n        self.tempdir.cleanup()\n\n    def test_matching_committed_views_pass(self):\n        ok, message = check_committed_views(\"BUD rendered\", \"handover rendered\", self.root)\n        self.assertTrue(ok, message)\n\n    def test_stale_committed_view_fails(self):\n        ok, message = check_committed_views(\"BUD rendered\", \"outdated handover\", self.root)\n        self.assertFalse(ok)\n        self.assertIn(\"differs\", message)\n\n    def test_missing_committed_view_fails(self):\n        (self.root / \"BUD.md\").unlink()\n        ok, message = check_committed_views(\"BUD rendered\", \"handover rendered\", self.root)\n        self.assertFalse(ok)\n        self.assertIn(\"missing\", message)\n\n    def test_byte_mismatch_reports_offset_and_context(self):\n        (self.root / [L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Reject non-save-track PRs that only move canonical state/docs without doing main work.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nfrom pathlib import Path\nimport subprocess\n\n\nADMIN_ONLY = {\n    \"BUD.md\",\n    \"docs/現在状態.json\",\n    \"docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md\",\n}\nSUBSTANTIVE_PREFIXES = (\n    \"scripts/\",\n    \"tests/\",\n    \"src/\",\n    \"app/\",\n    \"tools/\",\n    \"docs/企画/\",\n    \"docs/設計/\",\n    \"schemas/\",\n    \"rules/\",\n    \"経験ログ/\",\n)\nSUBSTANTIVE_FILES = {\"README.md\", \"指針等/ID管理台帳.md\"}\n\nSUBSTANTIVE_WORKFLOW_PREFIX = \".github/workflows/\"\n\n\ndef changed_paths(base: str, head: str) -> list[str]:\n    # -z prevents Git from quoting/escaping non-ASCII paths (for example Japanese\n    # filenames), so validate() receives the real repository paths.\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [\"git\", \"diff\", \"--name-only\", \"-z\", f\"{base}...{head}\"],\n        check=True,\n        text=True,\n        capture_output=True,\n    )\n    return [path for path in result.stdout.split(\"\\0\") if path]\n\n\ndef validate(branch: str, paths: list[str]) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n    if branch.startswith((\"chat-save-request/\", \"save/direct-chat-\", \"save/currentize-\")):\n        return True, \"save-track branch; progress gate not required\"\n    substantive = [\n        path for path in paths\n        if path not in ADMIN_ONLY\n        and (\n            path in SUBSTANTIVE_FILES\n            or path.startswith(SUBSTANTIVE_PREFIXES)\n            or path.startswith(SUBSTANTIVE_WORKFLOW_PREFIX)\n        )\n    ]\n    if substantive:\n        return True, \"substantive main-work change detected: \" + \", \".join(sorted(substantive))\n    return False, (\n        \"non-save-track PR contains no substantive main-work change. \"\n        \"State/view-only updates belong to the save track; \"\n        \"a normal PR must include implementation, tests, or workflow changes. \"\n        f\"changed paths: {', '.join(sorted(paths)) or '(none)'}\"\n    )\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--branch\", required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--base\", required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--head\", required=True)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    paths = changed_paths(args.base, args.head)\n    ok, message = validate(args.branch, paths)\n    print((\"OK: \" if ok else \"FAIL: \") + message)\n    return 0 if ok else 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Require canonical state/view files to move together when canonical state changes.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\nCANONICAL_STATE = \"docs/現在状態.json\"\nGENERATED_VIEWS = {\n    \"BUD.md\",\n    \"docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md\",\n}\n\n\ndef validate_changed_paths(paths: list[str]) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n    changed = set(paths)\n    if CANONICAL_STATE not in changed:\n        return True, \"canonical state unchanged\"\n    missing = sorted(GENERATED_VIEWS - changed)\n    if missing:\n        return False, (\n            \"docs/現在状態.json changed without generated views: \"\n            + \", \".join(missing)\n        )\n    return True, \"canonical state and generated views changed together\"\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--paths-file\", type=Path, required=True)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    paths = [line.strip() for line in args.paths_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").splitlines() if line.strip()]\n    ok, message = validate_changed_paths(paths)\n    print((\"OK: \" if ok else \"FAIL: \") + message)\n    return 0 if ok else 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Generate a freshness manifest from the canonical current-state JSON.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\nimport argparse, hashlib, json\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nSTATE = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"現在状態.json\"\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--output\", type=Path, required=True)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    raw = STATE.read_bytes()\n    state = json.loads(raw.decode(\"utf-8\"))\n    manifest = {\n        \"manifest_version\": 1,\n        \"source\": \"docs/現在状態.json\",\n        \"source_sha256\": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),\n        \"source_updated\": state[\"updated\"],\n        \"execution_environment\": state[\"execution_environment\"],\n        \"current_position\": state[\"current_position\"],\n        \"required_first_check\": \"scripts/resume_check.py\",\n        \"stop_if\": [\n            \"canonical state unreadable\",\n            \"required current-state fields missing\",\n            \"active/retired environment conflict\",\n            \"generated views are not regenerated from the canonical state\",\n        ],\n    }\n    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    print(f\"OK: wrote {args.output}\")\n    print(f\"source_sha256: {manifest['source_sha256']}\")\n    return 0\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "# 運用ルール\n\n### 7-5-4-1. ブログ制作における勝手な判断・作業の禁止（必須）\n\nブログ制作では、**ルール上バドに判断権があることと、バドが勝手に判断・作業を実行してよいことを同一視してはならない。**\n\n- ブログ本文、構成、見出し、引用、強調（太字・赤字・赤＋黄等）、会話表示、HTML構造、画像、リンク、公開設定その他の記事に関係する内容について、たかの明示的な指示・確認なしに変更・追加・削除してはならない。\n- 「ルール上この形式が望ましい」「バドが判断できる」と定められている場合でも、それだけを根拠に実作業を開始してはならない。ルールは判断基準であり、作業開始の許可そのものではない。\n- 外部AIの提案・レビュー、バド自身が発見した改善案、制作途中で気づいた問題についても、採否を勝手に決めて実装してはならない。必要な場合は、変更内容・理由・対象をたかへ提示し、たかの指示を受けてから実行する。\n- たかが明示した作業範囲を超えて、関連しそうな修正を便乗して行ってはならない。例えば「A〜Cを修正してよい」と指示された場合、A〜C以外の太字追加・文章修正・構成変更等を同時に行ってはならない。\n- 一度確認済み・確定済みの本文やHTMLは、後の工程で勝手に変更してはならない。変更が必要になった場合は、変更箇所と理由を提示し、改めてたかの確認を受ける。\n- 「判断してよい」と「実行してよい」を分離する。実行許可が明示されていない場合は、提案または確認で止める。\n- この禁止は、ブログ記事の新規作成だけでなく、統合、改稿、HTML化、既存HTMLの修正、公開前の仕上げを含むブログ制作全般に適用する。\n\n**完了条件**：ブログ制作において、実施した変更がたかから明示された作業範囲内であること、未承認の判断・変更・追加・削除が混入していないことを確認する。\n\n\n## 目的\n\nこのファイルは、`ai-project` における現在の作業手順と横断的な運用ルールを一本化する。日常の作業に組み込み、保存・更新漏れや「保存したつもり」を防ぐ。\n\nまた、過去ログに残った「次の作業」を現在の命令として機械的に再実行しない。過去の成功・失敗・判断を現在の作業判断へ反映し、同じ条件で同じ失敗を無意味に繰り返さない。\n\n### 0-0. 日常作業キュー正本の切替（必須）\n\n- / `next_step` や生成ビューへフォールバックしない。ボードの再取得またはユーザーによる可用性回復を待つ。\n- 本節は日常作業キューの正本に関する旧記述に優先する。旧 `work_items` を前提とするルールは、明示的に技術状態の検証を目的とする場合を除き、日常作業キューとして適用しない。\n\n### 0-1. 現在状態正本と生成ビュー\n\n- `docs/現在状態.json` たかが明示した作業範囲を超えて、関連しそうな修正を便乗して行ってはならない。例えば「A〜Cを修正してよい」と指示された場合、A〜C以外の太字追加・文章修正・構成変更等を同時に行ってはならない。\n- 一度確認済み・確定済みの本文やHTMLは、後の工程で勝手に変更してはならない。変更が必要になった場合は、変更箇所と理由を提示し、改めてたかの確認を受ける。\n- 「判断してよい」と「実行してよい」を分離する。実行許可が明示されていない場合は、提案または確認で止める。\n- この禁止は、ブログ記事の新規作成だけでなく、統合、改稿、HTML化、既存HTMLの修正、公開前の仕上げを含むブログ制作全般に適用する。\n\n**完了条件**：ブログ制作において、実施した変更がたかから明示された作業範囲内であること、未承認の判断・変更・追加・削除が混入していないことを確認する。\n\n\n## 目的\n\nこのファイルは、`ai-project` における現在の作業手順と横断的な運用ルールを一本化する。日常の作業に組み込み、保存・更新漏れや「保存したつもり」を防ぐ。\n\nまた、過去ログに残った「次の作業」を現在の命令として機械的に再実行しない。過去の成功・失敗・判断を現在の作業判断へ反映し、同じ条件で同じ失敗を無意味に繰り返さない。\n\n### 0-0. 日常作業キュー正本の切替（必須）\n\n- 日常作業キューの唯一の正本はDropboxの固定ファイル `/ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx` とする。タスク番号・状態・優先度・次のアクションはこのボードから取得する。\n- GitHubの `docs/現在状態.json` は技術状態・履歴・証拠の正本であり、日常作業キューの正本ではない。旧 `work_items` / `next_step` は技術上の事実・検証証拠を必要な場所へ移した後に削除し、日常作業の選定・優先順位付け・再開判断に使用しない。\n- `BUD.md` と `docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md` はGitHub技術状態から生成される互換ビューであり、日常作業キューの代替ではない。\n- Dropboxボードが読めない・接続できない場合は作業キュー利用不可として停止し、古いGitHub `work_items` / `next_step` や生成ビューへフォールバックしない。ボードの再取得またはユーザーによる可用性回復を待つ。\n- 本節は日常作業キューの正本に関する旧記述に優先する。旧 `work_items` を前提とするルールは、明示的に技術状態の検証を目的とする場合を除き、日常作業キューとして適用しない。\n\n### 0-1. 現在状態正本と生成ビュー\n\n- `docs/現在状態.json` を**唯一の現在状態正本**とする。\n- `BUD.md` と `docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md` は、現在状態正本から生成される**互換ビュー**であり、現在状態の判断根拠として個別に編集・更新してはならない。\n- 現在状態を変更するPRでは、`scripts/generate_current_views.py` から両生成ビューを再生成し、同じPRに含める。保存パイプラインによる一括更新も、正本と生成ビューを同一コミットに含める。同期workflowは補助的な回復経路であり、PRの完全一致検査を代替しない。\n- guard は `docs/現在状態.json` からその場で生成したビューの妥当性に加え、チェックイン済みの `BUD.md` と引き継ぎが生成結果とバイト単位で一致することも検査する。不一致はCI失敗とし、古いビューを次回起動のダッシュボードとして残さない。\n- 保存経路では、`scripts/save_and_currentize.py` が現在状態と生成ビューを同一コミットへ含める。通常更新では生成ビュー同期workflowが必要な場合だけ追随コミットを作成する。\n- `docs/現在状態.json` の `work_items` と `next_step` を、日常作業の選定・優先順位・再開判断・完了判定に使用しない。これらに関する旧ルールは廃止する。\n- Dropboxボードが読めない、取得できない、または形式検証に失敗した場合は作業を停止する。GitHubの旧データ、生成ビュー、会話履歴から作業候補を復元しない。\n- GitHubの技術状態・履歴・検証証拠は、日常作業キューとは分離して保持する。旧キュー項目を削除するときは、技術上の事実や検証証拠に固有情報がないかを先に確認し、必要な情報だけを技術状態・Git履歴へ移す。旧キューの複製を別名で温存しない。\n- 変更後は、ルール・検査処理・テスト・生成ビューに旧キューを正本として扱う経路が残っていないことを確認する。\n\n### 0-2-4. [L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Generate deterministic current-state views atomically.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport json\nimport shutil\nimport tempfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\nimport sys\nsys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[0]))\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nSTATE = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"現在状態.json\"\n\ndef load_state() -> dict:\n    with STATE.open(encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        return json.load(f)\n\ndef render(state: dict) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    dc = state[\"direct_chat\"]\n    surgery = state[\"surgery\"]\n    model = state[\"current_state_model\"]\n    migration = state[\"migration\"]\n    env = state[\"execution_environment\"]\n    current = state[\"current_position\"]\n    queue_source = state.get(\"work_queue_source\")\n    if queue_source != \"dropbox_board\":\n        raise ValueError(f\"unsupported work_queue_source: {queue_source!r}; Dropbox board is the only daily queue\")\n    queue_section = (\n        \"## 作業キュー\\n\\n\"\n        \"- 正本：Dropboxの固定ファイル /ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx\\n\"\n        \"- GitHubは技術状態・履歴・検証証拠を保持し、日常作業の状態を複製しない。\\n\"\n        \"- ボードを読み取れない場合は停止し、古いGitHub項目へフォールバックしない。\"\n    )\n\n    header = f\"\"\"更新日：{state[\"updated\"]}\n\n## 正本\n\n- 正本リポジトリ：{state[\"canonical_repository\"]}\n- 現在状態正本：docs/現在状態.json\n- 現在ビュー：BUD.md / docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md\n\n## 実行環境\n\n- 現在：**{env[\"active\"]}**\n- 退役：{\", \".join(env.get(\"retired\", [])) or \"(なし)\"}\n- work_pc clone：**{state.get(\"work_pc\", {}).get(\"clone_status\", \"unknown\")}**\n\n## 現在地点\n\n**{current[\"summary\"]}**\n\n{queue_section}\n\n\"\"\".rstrip(\"\\n\")\n\n    bud = f\"\"\"# BUD — バドのための最上位ダッシュボード\n\n{header}\n## 現在の作業レーン\n\n**{state[\"primary_lane\"]}**\n\n「一括改修」は設計を一括で行う意味であり、実装は小さな検証単位で進める。\n\n順序：**現状棚卸し → 大手術の設計 → 採用する改善を確定 → 小さな検証単位で順次実装 → 検証**。\n\n- 棚卸し：{surgery[\"inventory\"]}\n- 設計：{surgery[\"design\"]}\n- 採用：{surgery[\"adoption\"]}\n- 実装：{surgery[\"bulk_refactor\"]}\n- 検証：{surgery[\"verification\"]}\n\n## 現在状態モデル\n\n- {model[\"target\"]}\n- 自動生成：{model[\"generation_flow\"]}\n\n## 直チャット\n\n- 最新保存：**{dc[\"latest_saved\"]}**\n- 最新パス：{dc[\"latest_path\"]}\n- 旧連番保存：{str(dc[\"legacy_serial_files_preserved\"]).lower()}\n- 新タイムスタンプ方式：{str(dc[\"new_timestamp_naming_allowed\"]).lower()}\n\n## 移行\n\n- 状態：{migration[\"status\"]}\n- 通常工程：{migration[\"normal_work_policy\"]}\n- 暫定同期：{migration[\"temporary_manual_sync\"]}\n\"\"\"\n\n    handover = f\"\"\"# 現在の引き継ぎ\n\n{header}\n## 現在の作業レーン\n\n**{state[\"primary_lane\"]}**\n\n「一括改修」＝設計を一括、実装を小さな検証単位。\n\n## 現在状態\n\n- 目的：{model[\"target\"]}\n- 自動生成状態：{model[\"status\"]}\n- 生成フロー：{model[\"generation_flow\"]}\n\n## 直チャット\n\n- 最新：**{dc[\"latest_saved\"]}**\n- 実体：{dc[\"latest_path\"]}\n\n## 移行\n\n- {migration[\"normal_work_policy\"]}\n- {migration[\"temporary_manual_sync\"]}\n\"\"\"\n    # Generated views intentionally have no trailing newline; the checked-in views\n    # use the same byte-level contract and CI compares them with cmp.\n    return bud.rstrip(\"\\n\"), handover.rstrip(\"\\n\")\n\ndef check_committed_views(bud: str, handover: str, root: Path = ROOT) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n    \"\"\"Check exact UTF-8 bytes and report the first mismatch for actionable CI failures.\"\"\"\n    expected = (\n        (root / \"BUD.md\", bud),\n        (root / \"docs\" / \"引き継ぎ\" / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\", handover),\n    )\n    for path, rendered in expected:\n        if not path.is_file():\n            return False, f\"committed generated view is missing: {path.relative_to(root)}\"\n        actual_bytes = path.read_bytes()\n        expected_bytes = rendered.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        if actual_bytes != expected_bytes:\n            mismatch = next(\n                (i for i, (actual, expected_byte) in enumerate(zip(actual_bytes, expected_bytes))\n                 if actual != expected_byte),\n                min(len(actual_bytes), len(expected_bytes)),\n            )\n            expected_excerpt = expected_bytes[max(0, mismatch - 24):mismatch + 48].decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n            actual_excerpt = actual_bytes[max(0, mismatch - 24):mismatch + 48].decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n            return False, (\n                f\"committed generated view differs: {path.relative_to(root)}; \"\n                f\"first byte mismatch at offset {mismatch}; \"\n                f\"expected_bytes={len(expected_bytes)}, actual_bytes={len(actual_bytes)}; \"\n                f\"expected_excerpt={expected_excerpt!r}; actual_excerpt={actual_excerpt!r}\"\n            )\n    return True, \"checked-in views match canonical state\"\n\n\ndef write_views_atomically(out_dir: Path, bud: str, handover: str) -> None:\n    out_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    temp_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f\".{out_dir.name}.\", dir=out_dir.parent))\n    try:\n        (temp_dir / \"BUD.md\").write_text(bud, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        (temp_dir / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\").write_text(handover, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        if out_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(out_dir)\n        temp_dir.rename(out_dir)\n        temp_dir = None\n    finally:\n        if temp_dir is not None and temp_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir)\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--out-dir\", type=Path, required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--check-deterministic\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--check-committed\", action=\"store_true\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    bud, handover = render(load_state())\n    write_views_atomically(args.out_dir, bud, handover)\n\n    if args.check_deterministic:\n        bud2, handover2 = render(load_state())\n        if (bud, handover) != (bud2, handover2):\n            print(\"FAIL: render is not deterministic\")\n            return 1\n        if bud.endswith(\"\\n\") or handover.endswith(\"\\n\"):\n            print(\"FAIL: generated views must not have a trailing newline\")\n            return 1\n        print(\"OK: deterministic render\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"OK: rendered {args.out_dir / 'BUD.md'}\")\n        print(f\"OK: rendered {args.out_dir / '現在の引き継ぎ.md'}\")\n    if args.check_committed:\n        ok, message = check_committed_views(bud, handover)\n        print((\"OK: \" if ok else \"FAIL: \") + message)\n        if not ok:\n            return 1\n    return 0\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

This keeps canonical state changes on the normal\n    atomic save path while allowing the queue entry to request an explicit state patch.\n    \"\"\"\n    pattern = re.compile(\n        re.escape(STATE_PATCH_BEGIN) + r\"\\s*\\n(.*?)\\n\" + re.escape(STATE_PATCH_END),\n        re.DOTALL,\n    )\n    match = pattern.search(content)\n    if not match:\n        return content, None\n    try:\n        patch = json.loads(match.group(1))\n    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:\n        raise SystemExit(f\"invalid embedded state patch JSON: {exc}\") from exc\n    if not isinstance(patch, dict):\n        raise SystemExit(\"embedded state patch must be a JSON object\")\n    cleaned = (content[:match.start()] + content[match.end():]).strip() + \"\\n\"\n    return cleaned, patch\n\n\ndef validate_queue_retirement(state: dict) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Enforce the Dropbox-only queue contract without deriving a GitHub queue.\"\"\"\n    if state.get(\"work_queue_source\") != \"dropbox_board\":\n        raise SystemExit(\"work_queue_source must be dropbox_board; GitHub queue fallback is disabled\")\n    if state.get(\"work_items\") != []:\n        raise SystemExit(\"legacy GitHub work_items must be empty; Dropbox is the only daily queue\")\n\n\ndef render_views() -> None:\n    subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, \"scripts/generate_current_views.py\", \"--out-dir\", \".generated-save-views\"],\n        cwd=ROOT,\n        check=True,\n    )\n    src = ROOT / \".generated-save-views\"\n    BUD_PATH.write_text((src / \"BUD.md\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    HANDOVER_PATH.write_text((src / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    subprocess.run([\"rm\", \"-rf\", str(src)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--content-file\", type=Path, help=\"direct-chat markdown; stdin when omitted\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--message\", default=None)\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--state-patch-file\",\n        type=Path,\n        default=None,\n        help=\"optional JSON object recursively merged into docs/現在状態.json before views are generated\",\n    )\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    if run(\"git\", \"diff\", \"--cached\", \"--name-only\"):\n        raise SystemExit(\"refusing to run with pre-staged changes\")\n\n    content = (args.content_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\") if args.content_file else sys.stdin.read())\n    content, embedded_patch = extract_embedded_state_patch(content)\n    if not content.endswith(\"\\n\"):\n        content += \"\\n\"\n\n    now = datetime.now(ZoneInfo(\"Asia/Tokyo\"))\n    save_date = now.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n    timestamp = f\"{save_date}T{now:%H-%M-%S.%f%z}\"\n    filename = f\"{save_date}_直チャット即時保存_{timestamp}.md\"\n    path = DIRECT_CHAT_DIR / filename\n    if path.exists():\n        raise SystemExit(f\"refusing to overwrite existing record: {path}\")\n\n    title = f\"# 直チャット{timestamp}\\n\"\n    if not content.startswith(\"# 直チャット\"):\n        content = title + \"\\n\" + content.lstrip()\n    path.write_text(content, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n    state = json.loads(STATE_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    state[\"updated\"] = save_date\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"latest_saved\"] = timestamp\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"latest_path\"] = f\"直チャット/{filename}\"\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"latest_content_sha\"] = git_blob_sha(content.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"legacy_serial_files_preserved\"] = True\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"new_timestamp_naming_allowed\"] = True\n\n    # Keep canonical save metadata aligned with the sole live entrypoint.\n    state[\"save_pipeline\"][\"normal_entrypoints\"] = [\"save-request-intake.yml (pull_request_target; queue PR required)\"]\n    if args.state_patch_file:\n        patch = json.loads(args.state_patch_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        if not isinstance(patch, dict):\n            raise SystemExit(\"state patch must be a JSON object\")\n        merge_patch(state, patch)\n    if embedded_patch is not None:\n        merge_patch(state, embedded_patch)\n\n    validate_queue_retirement(state)\n    STATE_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    render_views()\n\n    subprocess.run([\"git\", \"add\", str(path), str(STATE_PATH), str(BUD_PATH), str(HANDOVER_PATH)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    expected = {\n        str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),\n        str(STATE_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)),\n        str(BUD_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)),\n        str(HANDOVER_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)),\n    }\n    staged_raw = subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"diff\", \"--cached\", \"--name-only\", \"-z\"], cwd=ROOT)\n    staged = set(p for p in staged_raw.decode(\"utf-8\").split(\"\\0\") if p)\n    if staged != expected:\n        raise SystemExit(f\"unexpected staged paths: {sorted(staged)}\")\n\n    subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"scripts/check_repo_integrity.py\"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"scripts/generate_current_views.py\", \"--out-dir\", \".generated-save-check\", \"--check-deterministic\"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    subprocess.run([\"cmp\", \"--silent\", \".generated-save-check/BUD.md\", \"BUD.md\"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    subprocess.run([\"cmp\", \"--silent\", \".generated-save-check/現在の引き継ぎ.md\", str(HANDOVER_PATH)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    subprocess.run([\"rm\", \"-rf\", \".generated-save-check\"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n\n    message = args.message or f\"直チャット{timestamp}保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期\"\n    subprocess.run([\"git\", \"commit\", \"-m\", message], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    print(run(\"git\", \"rev-parse\", \"HEAD\"))\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

Dropbox board is the only daily queue\")\n    queue_section = (\n        \"## 作業キュー\\n\\n\"\n        \"- 正本：Dropboxの固定ファイル /ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx\\n\"\n        \"- GitHubは技術状態・履歴・検証証拠を保持し、日常作業の状態を複製しない。\\n\"\n        \"- ボードを読み取れない場合は停止し、古いGitHub項目へフォールバックしない。\"\n    )\n\n    header = f\"\"\"更新日：{state[\"updated\"]}\n\n## 正本\n\n- 正本リポジトリ：{state[\"canonical_repository\"]}\n- 現在状態正本：docs/現在状態.json\n- 現在ビュー：BUD.md / docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md\n\n## 実行環境\n\n- 現在：**{env[\"active\"]}**\n- 退役：{\", \".join(env.get(\"retired\", [])) or \"(なし)\"}\n- work_pc clone：**{state.get(\"work_pc\", {}).get(\"clone_status\", \"unknown\")}**\n\n## 現在地点\n\n**{current[\"summary\"]}**\n\n{queue_section}\n\n\"\"\".rstrip(\"\\n\")\n\n    bud = f\"\"\"# BUD — バドのための最上位ダッシュボード\n\n{header}\n## 現在の作業レーン\n\n**{state[\"primary_lane\"]}**\n\n「一括改修」は設計を一括で行う意味であり、実装は小さな検証単位で進める。\n\n順序：**現状棚卸し → 大手術の設計 → 採用する改善を確定 → 小さな検証単位で順次実装 → 検証**。\n\n- 棚卸し：{surgery[\"inventory\"]}\n- 設計：{surgery[\"design\"]}\n- 採用：{surgery[\"adoption\"]}\n- 実装：{surgery[\"bulk_refactor\"]}\n- 検証：{surgery[\"verification\"]}\n\n## 現在状態モデル\n\n- {model[\"target\"]}\n- 自動生成：{model[\"generation_flow\"]}\n\n## 直チャット\n\n- 最新保存：**{dc[\"latest_saved\"]}**\n- 最新パス：{dc[\"latest_path\"]}\n- 旧連番保存：{str(dc[\"legacy_serial_files_preserved\"]).lower()}\n- 新タイムスタンプ方式：{str(dc[\"new_timestamp_naming_allowed\"]).lower()}\n\n## 移行\n\n- 状態：{migration[\"status\"]}\n- 通常工程：{migration[\"normal_work_policy\"]}\n- 暫定同期：{migration[\"temporary_manual_sync\"]}\n\"\"\"\n\n    handover = f\"\"\"# 現在の引き継ぎ\n\n{header}\n## 現在の作業レーン\n\n**{state[\"primary_lane\"]}**\n\n「一括改修」＝設計を一括、実装を小さな検証単位。\n\n## 現在状態\n\n- 目的：{model[\"target\"]}\n- 自動生成状態：{model[\"status\"]}\n- 生成フロー：{model[\"generation_flow\"]}\n\n## 直チャット\n\n- 最新：**{dc[\"latest_saved\"]}**\n- 実体：{dc[\"latest_path\"]}\n\n## 移行\n\n- {migration[\"normal_work_policy\"]}\n- {migration[\"temporary_manual_sync\"]}\n\"\"\"\n    # Generated views intentionally have no trailing newline; the checked-in views\n    # use the same byte-level contract and CI compares them with cmp.\n    return bud.rstrip(\"\\n\"), handover.rstrip(\"\\n\")\n\ndef check_committed_views(bud: str, handover: str, root: Path = ROOT) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n    \"\"\"Check exact UTF-8 bytes and report the first mismatch for actionable CI failures.\"\"\"\n    expected = (\n        (root / \"BUD.md\", bud),\n        (root / \"docs\" / \"引き継ぎ\" / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\", handover),\n    )\n    for path, rendered in expected:\n        if not path.is_file():\n            return False, f\"committed generated view is missing: {path.relative_to(root)}\"\n        actual_bytes = path.read_bytes()\n        expected_bytes = rendered.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        if actual_bytes != expected_bytes:\n            mismatch = next(\n                (i for i, (actual, expected_byte) in enumerate(zip(actual_bytes, expected_bytes))\n                 if actual != expected_byte),\n                min(len(actual_bytes), len(expected_bytes)),\n            )\n            expected_excerpt = expected_bytes[max(0, mismatch - 24):mismatch + 48].decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n            actual_excerpt = actual_bytes[max(0, mismatch - 24):mismatch + 48].decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n            return False, (\n                f\"committed generated view differs: {path.relative_to(root)}; \"\n                f\"first byte mismatch at offset {mismatch}; \"\n                f\"expected_bytes={len(expected_bytes)}, actual_bytes={len(actual_bytes)}; \"\n                f\"expected_excerpt={expected_excerpt!r}; actual_excerpt={actual_excerpt!r}\"\n            )\n    return True, \"checked-in views match canonical state\"\n\n\ndef write_views_atomically(out_dir: Path, bud: str, handover: str) -> None:\n    out_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    temp_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f\".{out_dir.name}.\", dir=out_dir.parent))\n    try:\n        (temp_dir / \"BUD.md\").write_text(bud, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        (temp_dir / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\").write_text(handover, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        if out_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(out_dir)\n        temp_dir.rename(out_dir)\n        temp_dir = None\n    finally:\n        if temp_dir is not None and temp_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir)\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--out-dir\", type=Path, required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--check-deterministic\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--check-committed\", action=\"store_true\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    bud, handover = render(load_state())\n    write_views_atomically(args.out_dir, bud, handover)\n\n    if args.check_deterministic:\n        bud2, handover2 = render(load_state())\n        if (bud, handover) != (bud2, handover2):\n            print(\"FAIL: render is not deterministic\")\n            return 1\n        if bud.endswith(\"\\n\") or handover.endswith(\"\\n\"):\n            print(\"FAIL: generated views must not have a trailing newline\")\n            return 1\n        print(\"OK: deterministic render\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"OK: rendered {args.out_dir / 'BUD.md'}\")\n        print(f\"OK: rendered {args.out_dir / '現在の引き継ぎ.md'}\")\n    if args.check_committed:\n        ok, message = check_committed_views(bud, handover)\n        print((\"OK: \" if ok else \"FAIL: \") + message)\n        if not ok:\n            return 1\n    return 0\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

subprocess, sys\nfrom datetime import date\nfrom pathlib import Path\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nsys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / \"scripts\"))\nfrom save_and_currentize import merge_patch, validate_queue_retirement, render_views, STATE_PATH, BUD_PATH, HANDOVER_PATH\n\n\ndef validate_technical_patch(patch: object, request: dict) -> dict:\n    if not isinstance(patch, dict):\n        raise SystemExit(\"patch must be an object\")\n    if not patch:\n        raise SystemExit(\"provide a non-empty technical-state patch\")\n    if \"work_items\" in patch or \"work_item_updates\" in request:\n        raise SystemExit(\"GitHub work_items updates are retired; update the Dropbox board for daily queue changes\")\n    return patch\n\n\ndef main():\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--request-file\", type=Path, required=True)\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n    req = json.loads(args.request_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    uid = req.get(\"update_id\", \"\")\n    if not re.fullmatch(r\"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,70}\", uid):\n        raise SystemExit(\"invalid update_id\")\n    patch = validate_technical_patch(req.get(\"patch\", {}), req)\n    for key in (\"purpose\", \"source\"):\n        if not isinstance(req.get(key), str) or not req[key].strip():\n            raise SystemExit(f\"{key} must be a non-empty string\")\n    audit_path = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"state-updates\" / f\"{uid}.json\"\n    if audit_path.exists():\n        raise SystemExit(f\"refusing to overwrite {audit_path.relative_to(ROOT)}\")\n    state = json.loads(STATE_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    merge_patch(state, patch)\n    state[\"updated\"] = date.today().isoformat()\n    validate_queue_retirement(state)\n    STATE_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    audit = {\"schema_version\": 1, \"date\": uid[:10], \"kind\": \"canonical_state_update\",\n             \"purpose\": req[\"purpose\"], \"source\": req[\"source\"],\n             \"confirmed\": req.get(\"confirmed\", []), \"not_verified\": req.get(\"not_verified\", []),\n             \"references\": req.get(\"references\", []), \"patch\": patch,\n             \"patch\": patch}\n    for key in (\"confirmed\", \"not_verified\", \"references\"):\n        if not isinstance(audit[key], list):\n            raise SystemExit(f\"{key} must be an array\")\n    audit_path.write_text(json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    render_views()\n    for command in ([sys.executable, \"scripts/check_repo_integrity.py\"],\n                    [sys.executable, \"scripts/current_state_guard.py\"],\n                    [sys.executable, \"scripts/resume_check.py\"]):\n        subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    subprocess.run([\"git\", \"add\", str(STATE_PATH), str(BUD_PATH), str(HANDOVER_PATH), str(audit_path)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    expected = {str(STATE_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)), str(BUD_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)),\n                str(HANDOVER_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)), str(audit_path.relative_to(ROOT))}\n    changed = set(subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"-c\", \"core.quotePath=false\", \"diff\", \"--cached\", \"--name-only\"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).splitlines())\n    if changed != expected:\n        raise SystemExit(f\"unexpected staged paths: {sorted(changed)}\")\n    print(\"OK: canonical state, audit record, and generated views staged atomically\")\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

merge_patch, validate_queue_retirement, render_views, STATE_PATH, BUD_PATH, HANDOVER_PATH\n\n\ndef validate_technical_patch(patch: object, request: dict) -> dict:\n    if not isinstance(patch, dict):\n        raise SystemExit(\"patch must be an object\")\n    if not patch:\n        raise SystemExit(\"provide a non-empty technical-state patch\")\n    if \"work_items\" in patch or \"work_item_updates\" in request:\n        raise SystemExit(\"GitHub work_items updates are retired; update the Dropbox board for daily queue changes\")\n    return patch\n\n\ndef main():\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--request-file\", type=Path, required=True)\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n    req = json.loads(args.request_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    uid = req.get(\"update_id\", \"\")\n    if not re.fullmatch(r\"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,70}\", uid):\n        raise SystemExit(\"invalid update_id\")\n    patch = validate_technical_patch(req.get(\"patch\", {}), req)\n    for key in (\"purpose\", \"source\"):\n        if not isinstance(req.get(key), str) or not req[key].strip():\n            raise SystemExit(f\"{key} must be a non-empty string\")\n    audit_path = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"state-updates\" / f\"{uid}.json\"\n    if audit_path.exists():\n        raise SystemExit(f\"refusing to overwrite {audit_path.relative_to(ROOT)}\")\n    state = json.loads(STATE_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    merge_patch(state, patch)\n    state[\"updated\"] = date.today().isoformat()\n    validate_queue_retirement(state)\n    STATE_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    audit = {\"schema_version\": 1, \"date\": uid[:10], \"kind\": \"canonical_state_update\",\n             \"purpose\": req[\"purpose\"], \"source\": req[\"source\"],\n             \"confirmed\": req.get(\"confirmed\", []), \"not_verified\": req.get(\"not_verified\", []),\n             \"references\": req.get(\"references\", []), \"patch\": patch,\n             \"patch\": patch}\n    for key in (\"confirmed\", \"not_verified\", \"references\"):\n        if not isinstance(audit[key], list):\n            raise SystemExit(f\"{key} must be an array\")\n    audit_path.write_text(json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    render_views()\n    for command in ([sys.executable, \"scripts/check_repo_integrity.py\"],\n                    [sys.executable, \"scripts/current_state_guard.py\"],\n                    [sys.executable, \"scripts/resume_check.py\"]):\n        subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    subprocess.run([\"git\", \"add\", str(STATE_PATH), str(BUD_PATH), str(HANDOVER_PATH), str(audit_path)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    expected = {str(STATE_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)), str(BUD_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)),\n                str(HANDOVER_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)), str(audit_path.relative_to(ROOT))}\n    changed = set(subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"-c\", \"core.quotePath=false\", \"diff\", \"--cached\", \"--name-only\"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).splitlines())\n    if changed != expected:\n        raise SystemExit(f\"unexpected staged paths: {sorted(changed)}\")\n    print(\"OK: canonical state, audit record, and generated views staged atomically\")\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

the checked-in views\n    # use the same byte-level contract and CI compares them with cmp.\n    return bud.rstrip(\"\\n\"), handover.rstrip(\"\\n\")\n\ndef check_committed_views(bud: str, handover: str, root: Path = ROOT) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n    \"\"\"Check exact UTF-8 bytes and report the first mismatch for actionable CI failures.\"\"\"\n    expected = (\n        (root / \"BUD.md\", bud),\n        (root / \"docs\" / \"引き継ぎ\" / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\", handover),\n    )\n    for path, rendered in expected:\n        if not path.is_file():\n            return False, f\"committed generated view is missing: {path.relative_to(root)}\"\n        actual_bytes = path.read_bytes()\n        expected_bytes = rendered.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        if actual_bytes != expected_bytes:\n            mismatch = next(\n                (i for i, (actual, expected_byte) in enumerate(zip(actual_bytes, expected_bytes))\n                 if actual != expected_byte),\n                min(len(actual_bytes), len(expected_bytes)),\n            )\n            expected_excerpt = expected_bytes[max(0, mismatch - 24):mismatch + 48].decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n            actual_excerpt = actual_bytes[max(0, mismatch - 24):mismatch + 48].decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n            return False, (\n                f\"committed generated view differs: {path.relative_to(root)}; \"\n                f\"first byte mismatch at offset {mismatch}; \"\n                f\"expected_bytes={len(expected_bytes)}, actual_bytes={len(actual_bytes)}; \"\n                f\"expected_excerpt={expected_excerpt!r}; actual_excerpt={actual_excerpt!r}\"\n            )\n    return True, \"checked-in views match canonical state\"\n\n\ndef write_views_atomically(out_dir: Path, bud: str, handover: str) -> None:\n    out_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    temp_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f\".{out_dir.name}.\", dir=out_dir.parent))\n    try:\n        (temp_dir / \"BUD.md\").write_text(bud, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        (temp_dir / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\").write_text(handover, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        if out_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(out_dir)\n        temp_dir.rename(out_dir)\n        temp_dir = None\n    finally:\n        if temp_dir is not None and temp_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir)\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--out-dir\", type=Path, required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--check-deterministic\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--check-committed\", action=\"store_true\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    bud, handover = render(load_state())\n    write_views_atomically(args.out_dir, bud, handover)\n\n    if args.check_deterministic:\n        bud2, handover2 = render(load_state())\n        if (bud, handover) != (bud2, handover2):\n            print(\"FAIL: render is not deterministic\")\n            return 1\n        if bud.endswith(\"\\n\") or handover.endswith(\"\\n\"):\n            print(\"FAIL: generated views must not have a trailing newline\")\n            return 1\n        print(\"OK: deterministic render\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"OK: rendered {args.out_dir / 'BUD.md'}\")\n        print(f\"OK: rendered {args.out_dir / '現在の引き継ぎ.md'}\")\n    if args.check_committed:\n        ok, message = check_committed_views(bud, handover)\n        print((\"OK: \" if ok else \"FAIL: \") + message)\n        if not ok:\n            return 1\n    return 0\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

This keeps canonical state changes on the normal\n    atomic save path while allowing the queue entry to request an explicit state patch.\n    \"\"\"\n    pattern = re.compile(\n HANDOVER_PATH.write_text((src / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    subprocess.run([\"rm\", \"-rf\", str(src)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--content-file\", type=Path, help=\"direct-chat markdown; stdin when omitted\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--message\", default=None)\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--state-patch-file\",\n        type=Path,\n        default=None,\n        help=\"optional JSON object recursively merged into docs/現在状態.json before views are generated\",\n    )\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    if run(\"git\", \"diff\", \"--cached\", \"--name-only\"):\n        raise SystemExit(\"refusing to run with pre-staged changes\")\n\n    content = f\"{save_date}T{now:%H-%M-%S.%f%z}\"\n    filename = f\"{save_date}_直チャット即時保存_{timestamp}.md\"\n    path = DIRECT_CHAT_DIR / filename\n    if path.exists():\n        raise SystemExit(f\"refusing to path.write_text(content, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n    state = json.loads(STATE_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    state[\"updated\"] = save_date\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"latest_saved\"] = timestamp\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"latest_path\"] = f\"直チャット/{filename}\"\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"latest_content_sha\"] = git_blob_sha(content.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"legacy_serial_files_preserved\"] = True\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"new_timestamp_naming_allowed\"] = True\n\n    # Keep canonical save metadata aligned with the sole live \"--silent\", \".generated-save-check/現在の引き継ぎ.md\", str(HANDOVER_PATH)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    subprocess.run([\"rm\", \"-rf\", \".generated-save-check\"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n\n    message = merge_patch, validate_queue_retirement, render_views, STATE_PATH, BUD_PATH, HANDOVER_PATH\n\n\ndef validate_technical_patch(patch: object, request: dict) -> dict:\n    if not isinstance(patch, dict):\n        raise SystemExit(\"patch must be an object\")\n    if not patch:\n        raise SystemExit(\"provide a non-empty technical-state patch\")\n    if \"work_items\" in patch or \"next_step\" in patch or \"work_item_updates\" in request:\n        raise SystemExit(\"GitHub work_items/next_step updates are retired; update the Dropbox board for daily queue changes\")\n    return patch\n\n\ndef main():\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--request-file\", type=Path, required=True)\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n    req = raise SystemExit(\"invalid update_id\")\n    patch = validate_technical_patch(req.get(\"patch\", {}), req)\n    for key in (\"purpose\", \"source\"):\n        if not isinstance(req.get(key), str) or not req[key].strip():\n            raise SystemExit(f\"{key} must be a non-empty string\")\n    audit_path = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"state-updates\" / f\"{uid}.json\"\n    if audit_path.exists():\n        raise SystemExit(f\"refusing to overwrite {audit_path.relative_to(ROOT)}\")\n    state = json.loads(STATE_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    merge_patch(state, patch)\n    state[\"updated\"] = date.today().isoformat()\n    validate_queue_retirement(state)\n    STATE_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    audit = {\"schema_version\": 1, \"date\": uid[:10], \"kind\": \"canonical_state_update\",\n             \"purpose\": req[\"purpose\"], \"source\": req[\"source\"],\n             \"confirmed\": req.get(\"confirmed\", []), \"not_verified\": req.get(\"not_verified\", []),\n             \"references\": req.get(\"references\", []), \"patch\": patch,\n             \"patch\": patch}\n    for key in (\"confirmed\", \"not_verified\", \"references\"):\n        if not isinstance(audit[key], list):\n            raise SystemExit(f\"{key} must be an array\")\n    audit_path.write_text(json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    render_views()\n    for command in ([sys.executable, \"scripts/check_repo_integrity.py\"],\n                    [sys.executable, \"scripts/current_state_guard.py\"],\n                    [sys.executable, \"scripts/resume_check.py\"]):\n        subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    subprocess.run([\"git\", \"add\", str(STATE_PATH), str(BUD_PATH), str(HANDOVER_PATH), str(audit_path)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    expected = {str(STATE_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)), str(BUD_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)),\n                str(HANDOVER_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)), str(audit_path.relative_to(ROOT))}\n    changed = set(subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"-c\", \"core.quotePath=false\", \"diff\", \"--cached\", \"--name-only\"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).splitlines())\n    if changed != expected:\n        raise SystemExit(f\"unexpected staged paths: {sorted(changed)}\")\n    print(\"OK: canonical state, audit record, and generated views staged atomically\")\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Generate deterministic current-state views atomically.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport json\nimport shutil\nimport tempfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\nimport sys\nsys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[0]))\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nSTATE = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"現在状態.json\"\n\ndef load_state() -> dict:\n    with STATE.open(encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        return json.load(f)\n\ndef render(state: dict) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    dc = state[\"direct_chat\"]\n    surgery = state[\"surgery\"]\n    model = state[\"current_state_model\"]\n    migration = state[\"migration\"]\n    env = state[\"execution_environment\"]\n    current = state[\"current_position\"]\n    queue_source = state.get(\"work_queue_source\")\n    if queue_source != \"dropbox_board\":\n        raise ValueError(f\"unsupported work_queue_source: {queue_source!r}; Dropbox board is the only daily queue\")\n    queue_section = (\n        \"## 作業キュー\\n\\n\"\n        \"- 正本：Dropboxの固定ファイル /ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx\\n\"\n        \"- GitHubは技術状態・履歴・検証証拠を保持し、日常作業の状態を複製しない。\\n\"\n        \"- ボードを読み取れない場合は停止し、古いGitHub項目へフォールバックしない。\"\n    )\n\n    header = f\"\"\"更新日：{state[\"updated\"]}\n\n## 正本\n\n- 正本リポジトリ：{state[\"canonical_repository\"]}\n- 現在状態正本：docs/現在状態.json\n- 現在ビュー：BUD.md / docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md\n\n## 実行環境\n\n- 現在：**{env[\"active\"]}**\n- 退役：{\", \".join(env.get(\"retired\", [])) or \"(なし)\"}\n- work_pc clone：**{state.get(\"work_pc\", {}).get(\"clone_status\", \"unknown\")}**\n\n## 現在地点\n\n**{current[\"summary\"]}**\n\n{queue_section}\n\n\"\"\".rstrip(\"\\n\")\n\n    bud = f\"\"\"# BUD — バドのための最上位ダッシュボード\n\n{header}\n## 現在の作業レーン\n\n**{state[\"primary_lane\"]}**\n\n「一括改修」は設計を一括で行う意味であり、実装は小さな検証単位で進める。\n\n順序：**現状棚卸し → 大手術の設計 → 採用する改善を確定 → 小さな検証単位で順次実装 → 検証**。\n\n- 棚卸し：{surgery[\"inventory\"]}\n- 設計：{surgery[\"design\"]}\n- 採用：{surgery[\"adoption\"]}\n- 実装：{surgery[\"bulk_refactor\"]}\n- 検証：{surgery[\"verification\"]}\n\n## 現在状態モデル\n\n- {model[\"target\"]}\n- 自動生成：{model[\"generation_flow\"]}\n\n## 直チャット\n\n- 最新保存：**{dc[\"latest_saved\"]}**\n- 最新パス：{dc[\"latest_path\"]}\n- 旧連番保存：{str(dc[\"legacy_serial_files_preserved\"]).lower()}\n- 新タイムスタンプ方式：{str(dc[\"new_timestamp_naming_allowed\"]).lower()}\n\n## 移行\n\n- 状態：{migration[\"status\"]}\n- 通常工程：{migration[\"normal_work_policy\"]}\n- 暫定同期：{migration[\"temporary_manual_sync\"]}\n\"\"\"\n\n    handover = f\"\"\"# 現在の引き継ぎ\n\n{header}\n## 現在の作業レーン\n\n**{state[\"primary_lane\"]}**\n\n「一括改修」＝設計を一括、実装を小さな検証単位。\n\n## 現在状態\n\n- 目的：{model[\"target\"]}\n- 自動生成状態：{model[\"status\"]}\n- 生成フロー：{model[\"generation_flow\"]}\n\n## 直チャット\n\n- 最新：**{dc[\"latest_saved\"]}**\n- 実体：{dc[\"latest_path\"]}\n\n## 移行\n\n- {migration[\"normal_work_policy\"]}\n- {migration[\"temporary_manual_sync\"]}\n\"\"\"\n    # Generated views intentionally have no trailing newline; the checked-in views\n    # use the same byte-level contract and CI compares them with cmp.\n    return bud.rstrip(\"\\n\"), handover.rstrip(\"\\n\")\n\ndef check_committed_views(bud: str, handover: str, root: Path = ROOT) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n    \"\"\"Check exact UTF-8 bytes and report the first mismatch for actionable CI failures.\"\"\"\n    expected = (\n        (root / \"BUD.md\", bud),\n        (root / \"docs\" / \"引き継ぎ\" / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\", handover),\n    )\n    for path, rendered in expected:\n        if not path.is_file():\n            return False, f\"committed generated view is missing: {path.relative_to(root)}\"\n        actual_bytes = path.read_bytes()\n        expected_bytes = rendered.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        if actual_bytes != expected_bytes:\n            mismatch = next(\n                (i for i, (actual, expected_byte) in enumerate(zip(actual_bytes, expected_bytes))\n                 if actual != expected_byte),\n                min(len(actual_bytes), len(expected_bytes)),\n            )\n            expected_excerpt = expected_bytes[max(0, mismatch - 24):mismatch + 48].decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n            actual_excerpt = actual_bytes[max(0, mismatch - 24):mismatch + 48].decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n            return False, (\n                f\"committed generated view differs: {path.relative_to(root)}; \"\n                f\"first byte mismatch at offset {mismatch}; \"\n                f\"expected_bytes={len(expected_bytes)}, actual_bytes={len(actual_bytes)}; \"\n                f\"expected_excerpt={expected_excerpt!r}; actual_excerpt={actual_excerpt!r}\"\n            )\n    return True, \"checked-in views match canonical state\"\n\n\ndef write_views_atomically(out_dir: Path, bud: str, handover: str) -> None:\n    out_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    temp_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f\".{out_dir.name}.\", dir=out_dir.parent))\n    try:\n        (temp_dir / \"BUD.md\").write_text(bud, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        (temp_dir / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\").write_text(handover, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        if out_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(out_dir)\n        temp_dir.rename(out_dir)\n        temp_dir = None\n    finally:\n        if temp_dir is not None and temp_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir)\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--out-dir\", type=Path, required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--check-deterministic\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--check-committed\", action=\"store_true\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    bud, handover = render(load_state())\n    write_views_atomically(args.out_dir, bud, handover)\n\n    if args.check_deterministic:\n        bud2, handover2 = render(load_state())\n        if (bud, handover) != (bud2, handover2):\n            print(\"FAIL: render is not deterministic\")\n            return 1\n        if bud.endswith(\"\\n\") or handover.endswith(\"\\n\"):\n            print(\"FAIL: generated views must not have a trailing newline\")\n            return 1\n        print(\"OK: deterministic render\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"OK: rendered {args.out_dir / 'BUD.md'}\")\n        print(f\"OK: rendered {args.out_dir / '現在の引き継ぎ.md'}\")\n    if args.check_committed:\n        ok, message = check_committed_views(bud, handover)\n        print((\"OK: \" if ok else \"FAIL: \") + message)\n        if not ok:\n            return 1\n    return 0\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

Dropbox board is the only daily queue\")\n    queue_section = (\n        \"## 作業キュー\\n\\n\"\n        \"- 正本：Dropboxの固定ファイル /ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx\\n\"\n        \"- GitHubは技術状態・履歴・検証証拠を保持し、日常作業の状態を複製しない。\\n\"\n        \"- ボードを読み取れない場合は停止し、古いGitHub項目へフォールバックしない。\"\n    )\n\n    header = f\"\"\"更新日：{state[\"updated\"]}\n\n## 正本\n\n- 正本リポジトリ：{state[\"canonical_repository\"]}\n- 現在状態正本：docs/現在状態.json\n- 現在ビュー：BUD.md / docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md\n\n## 実行環境\n\n- 現在：**{env[\"active\"]}**\n- 退役：{\", \".join(env.get(\"retired\", [])) or \"(なし)\"}\n- work_pc clone：**{state.get(\"work_pc\", {}).get(\"clone_status\", \"unknown\")}**\n\n## 現在地点\n\n**{current[\"summary\"]}**\n\n{queue_section}\n\n\"\"\".rstrip(\"\\n\")\n\n    bud = f\"\"\"# BUD — バドのための最上位ダッシュボード\n\n{header}\n## 現在の作業レーン\n\n**{state[\"primary_lane\"]}**\n\n「一括改修」は設計を一括で行う意味であり、実装は小さな検証単位で進める。\n\n順序：**現状棚卸し → 大手術の設計 → 採用する改善を確定 → 小さな検証単位で順次実装 → 検証**。\n\n- 棚卸し：{surgery[\"inventory\"]}\n- 設計：{surgery[\"design\"]}\n- 採用：{surgery[\"adoption\"]}\n- 実装：{surgery[\"bulk_refactor\"]}\n- 検証：{surgery[\"verification\"]}\n\n## 現在状態モデル\n\n- {model[\"target\"]}\n- 自動生成：{model[\"generation_flow\"]}\n\n## 直チャット\n\n- 最新保存：**{dc[\"latest_saved\"]}**\n- 最新パス：{dc[\"latest_path\"]}\n- 旧連番保存：{str(dc[\"legacy_serial_files_preserved\"]).lower()}\n- 新タイムスタンプ方式：{str(dc[\"new_timestamp_naming_allowed\"]).lower()}\n\n## 移行\n\n- 状態：{migration[\"status\"]}\n- 通常工程：{migration[\"normal_work_policy\"]}\n- 暫定同期：{migration[\"temporary_manual_sync\"]}\n\"\"\"\n\n    handover = f\"\"\"# 現在の引き継ぎ\n\n{header}\n## 現在の作業レーン\n\n**{state[\"primary_lane\"]}**\n\n「一括改修」＝設計を一括、実装を小さな検証単位。\n\n## 現在状態\n\n- 目的：{model[\"target\"]}\n- 自動生成状態：{model[\"status\"]}\n- 生成フロー：{model[\"generation_flow\"]}\n\n## 直チャット\n\n- 最新：**{dc[\"latest_saved\"]}**\n- 実体：{dc[\"latest_path\"]}\n\n## 移行\n\n- {migration[\"normal_work_policy\"]}\n- {migration[\"temporary_manual_sync\"]}\n\"\"\"\n    # Generated views intentionally have no trailing newline; the checked-in views\n    # use the same byte-level contract and CI compares them with cmp.\n    return bud.rstrip(\"\\n\"), handover.rstrip(\"\\n\")\n\ndef check_committed_views(bud: str, handover: str, root: Path = ROOT) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n    \"\"\"Check exact UTF-8 bytes and report the first mismatch for actionable CI failures.\"\"\"\n    expected = (\n        (root / \"BUD.md\", bud),\n        (root / \"docs\" / \"引き継ぎ\" / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\", handover),\n    )\n    for path, rendered in expected:\n        if not path.is_file():\n            return False, f\"committed generated view is missing: {path.relative_to(root)}\"\n        actual_bytes = path.read_bytes()\n        expected_bytes = rendered.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        if actual_bytes != expected_bytes:\n            mismatch = next(\n                (i for i, (actual, expected_byte) in enumerate(zip(actual_bytes, expected_bytes))\n                 if actual != expected_byte),\n                min(len(actual_bytes), len(expected_bytes)),\n            )\n            expected_excerpt = expected_bytes[max(0, mismatch - 24):mismatch + 48].decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n            actual_excerpt = actual_bytes[max(0, mismatch - 24):mismatch + 48].decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n            return False, (\n                f\"committed generated view differs: {path.relative_to(root)}; \"\n                f\"first byte mismatch at offset {mismatch}; \"\n                f\"expected_bytes={len(expected_bytes)}, actual_bytes={len(actual_bytes)}; \"\n                f\"expected_excerpt={expected_excerpt!r}; actual_excerpt={actual_excerpt!r}\"\n            )\n    return True, \"checked-in views match canonical state\"\n\n\ndef write_views_atomically(out_dir: Path, bud: str, handover: str) -> None:\n    out_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    temp_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f\".{out_dir.name}.\", dir=out_dir.parent))\n    try:\n        (temp_dir / \"BUD.md\").write_text(bud, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        (temp_dir / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\").write_text(handover, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        if out_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(out_dir)\n        temp_dir.rename(out_dir)\n        temp_dir = None\n    finally:\n        if temp_dir is not None and temp_dir.exists():\n            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir)\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--out-dir\", type=Path, required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--check-deterministic\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--check-committed\", action=\"store_true\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    bud, handover = render(load_state())\n    write_views_atomically(args.out_dir, bud, handover)\n\n    if args.check_deterministic:\n        bud2, handover2 = render(load_state())\n        if (bud, handover) != (bud2, handover2):\n            print(\"FAIL: render is not deterministic\")\n            return 1\n        if bud.endswith(\"\\n\") or handover.endswith(\"\\n\"):\n            print(\"FAIL: generated views must not have a trailing newline\")\n            return 1\n        print(\"OK: deterministic render\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"OK: rendered {args.out_dir / 'BUD.md'}\")\n        print(f\"OK: rendered {args.out_dir / '現在の引き継ぎ.md'}\")\n    if args.check_committed:\n        ok, message = check_committed_views(bud, handover)\n        print((\"OK: \" if ok else \"FAIL: \") + message)\n        if not ok:\n            return 1\n    return 0\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "import json\nimport sys\nimport unittest\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nsys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / \"scripts\"))\nfrom generate_current_views import render\n\n\nclass ActionableProgressHandoffTests(unittest.TestCase):\n    def test_legacy_github_queue_source_is_rejected(self):\n        state = json.loads((ROOT / \"docs\" / \"現在状態.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        state[\"work_queue_source\"] = \"github_json\"\n        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):\n            render(state)\n\n    def test_dropbox_queue_view_never_renders_legacy_items(self):\n        state = json.loads((ROOT / \"docs\" / \"現在状態.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        state[\"work_queue_source\"] = \"dropbox_board\"\n        bud, handover = render(state)\n        for view in (bud, handover):\n            self.assertIn(\"Dropboxの固定ファイル /ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx\", view)\n            self.assertIn(\"古いGitHub項目へフォールバックしない\", view)\n            self.assertNotIn(\"actionable：\", view)\n            self.assertNotIn(\"validation-findings-follow-up [in_progress]\", view)\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    unittest.main()\n",

try:\n        patch = json.loads(match.group(1))\n    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:\n        raise SystemExit(f\"invalid embedded state patch JSON: {exc}\") from exc\n    if not cleaned, patch\n\n\ndef validate_queue_retirement(state: dict) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Enforce the Dropbox-only queue contract without deriving a GitHub queue.\"\"\"\n    if HANDOVER_PATH.write_text((src / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    subprocess.run([\"rm\", \"-rf\", str(src)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n test_merge_patch_recurses_and_replaces_lists(self):\n        target = {\"a\": {\"b\": 1, \"keep\": 2}, \"items\": [1, 2]}\n        merge_patch(target, {\"a\": {\"b\": 3}, \"items\": [4]})\n        self.assertEqual(target, {\"a\": {\"b\": 3, \"keep\": 2}, \"items\": [4]})\n\n    def test_technical_patch_rejects_retired_queue_data(self):\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, updates are retired\"):\n            validate_technical_patch({\"next_step\": {\"target\": \"old queue\"}}, {})\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, \"work_items/next_step updates are retired\"):\n            validate_technical_patch({\"current_position\": {\"summary\": \"x\"}}, {\"work_item_updates\": [{\"id\": \"old\"}]})\n\n    def with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:\n            path = Path(td) / \"evidence.txt\"\n            path.write_text(\"verified evidence\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()\n            guard.validate_evidence_claim(\"検証しました。\", [{\"kind\": \"file\", \"path\": str(path), \"sha256\": digest}])\n\n    def test_evidence_sha_mismatch_is_rejected(self):\n        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:\n            path = Path(td) / \"evidence.txt\"\n            path.write_text(\"evidence\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, \"SHA-256 mismatch\"):\n                guard.validate_evidence_claim(\"完了しました。\", [{\"kind\": \"file\", \"path\": str(path), \"sha256\": \"0\" * 64}])\n\n    def test_loop_stops_on_repeated_external_state_fingerprint(self):\n        history = [{\"state_fingerprint\": \"dropbox-sha-1\"}, {\"state_fingerprint\": \"dropbox-sha-1\"}]\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, \"forced stop\"):\n            guard.validate_loop(history, 2)\n\n    def test_loop_allows_changed_external_state_fingerprint(self):\n        history = [{\"state_fingerprint\": \"dropbox-sha-1\"}, {\"state_fingerprint\": \"dropbox-sha-2\"}]\n        guard.validate_loop(history, 2)\n\n    def test_loop_ignores_caller_progress_boolean(self):\n        history = [{\"state_fingerprint\": \"same\", \"progress\": False}, {\"state_fingerprint\": \"same\", \"progress\": True}]\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, \"forced stop\"):\n            guard.validate_loop(history, 2)\n\n    def test_loop_threshold_must_be_at_least_two(self):\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, \"threshold must be >= 2\"):\n            guard.validate_loop([], 1)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    unittest.main()\n",

[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Mechanical preflight for progress claims and conversational loop risk.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nBLOCKED_PROGRESS_PATTERNS = (\n    r\"完了(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"進(?:みました|んだ|めました|めた)\",\n    r\"検証(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"確認(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"実施(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"成功(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"反映(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"解消(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"マージ(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"verified\",\n    r\"completed\",\n    r\"merged\",\n)\n\nCLAIM_PATTERNS = BLOCKED_PROGRESS_PATTERNS + (\n    r\"問題(?:ありません|なし)\",\n    r\"対応(?:済み|しました|した)\",\n)\n\n\ndef load_json(path: Path) -> dict:\n    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n\n\ndef has_progress_claim(text: str) -> bool:\n    return any(re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE) for pattern in CLAIM_PATTERNS)\n\n\ndef validate_evidence_claim(text: str, evidence: list[dict] | None) -> None:\n    if not has_progress_claim(text):\n        return\n    evidence = evidence or []\n    if not evidence:\n        raise ValueError(\"progress/completion claim requires explicit evidence records\")\n    for item in evidence:\n        if not item.get(\"kind\") or not item.get(\"path\") or not item.get(\"sha256\"):\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence record requires kind, path, and sha256\")\n        path = Path(item[\"path\"])\n        if not path.is_file():\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence file does not exist: \" + str(path))\n        actual = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()\n        if actual != item[\"sha256\"]:\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence SHA-256 mismatch: \" + str(path))\n\n\ndef validate_loop(history: list[dict], threshold: int = 2) -> None:\n    if threshold < 2:\n        raise ValueError(\"loop threshold must be >= 2\")\n    if len(history) < threshold:\n        return\n    tail = history[-threshold:]\n    fingerprints = [item.get(\"state_fingerprint\") for item in tail]\n    # Progress is represented by the structured fingerprint. Do not trust a\n    # caller-supplied progress boolean that can contradict unchanged state.\n    if fingerprints[0] and len(set(fingerprints)) == 1:\n        raise ValueError(\n            f\"forced stop: identical structured work state repeated {threshold} times\"\n        )\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--state\", type=Path, required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--text\", default=\"\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--evidence-json\", type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--history\", type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--loop-threshold\", type=int, default=2)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    try:\n        state = load_json(args.state)\n        evidence = None\n        if args.evidence_json:\n            evidence = json.loads(args.evidence_json.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        validate_evidence_claim(args.text, evidence)\n        if args.history:\n            history = json.loads(args.history.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n            if not isinstance(history, list):\n                raise ValueError(\"history must be a JSON list\")\n            validate_loop(history, args.loop_threshold)\n        print(\"OK: interaction preflight passed\")\n        return 0\n    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:\n        print(f\"STOP: {exc}\")\n        return 2\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Explicit per-turn loop gate for callers that can supply canonical state.\n\nThis does not hook into ChatGPT's runtime. A caller must invoke it once per turn\nand keep one history file per conversation/session.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport json\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\ntry:\n    from scripts import interaction_guard as guard\nexcept ModuleNotFoundError:\n    import interaction_guard as guard\n\n\ndef load_history(path: Path) -> list[dict]:\n    if not path.exists():\n        return []\n    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    if not isinstance(data, list) or any(\n        not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get(\"state_fingerprint\"), str)\n        for item in data\n    ):\n        raise ValueError(\"history must be a JSON list of state_fingerprint records\")\n    return data\n\n\ndef atomic_write_json(path: Path, data: list[dict]) -> None:\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=path.name + \".\", suffix=\".tmp\", dir=path.parent)\n    try:\n        with os.fdopen(fd, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\", newline=\"\\n\") as stream:\n            json.dump(data, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)\n            stream.write(\"\\n\")\n        os.replace(temporary, path)\n    except BaseException:\n        try:\n            os.unlink(temporary)\n        except FileNotFoundError:\n            pass\n        raise\n\n\ndef record_turn(state_path: Path, history_path: Path, threshold: int = 2) -> str:\n    state = guard.load_json(state_path)\n    history = load_history(history_path)\n    fingerprint = guard.state_fingerprint(state)\n    candidate = history + [{\"state_fingerprint\": fingerprint}]\n    guard.validate_loop(candidate, threshold)\n    atomic_write_json(history_path, candidate)\n    return fingerprint\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(\n        description=\"Record one turn's structured state; stop if it repeats without state change.\"\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\"--state\", type=Path, required=True, help=\"Path to docs/現在状態.json\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--history\", type=Path, required=True, help=\"Private JSON ledger for this conversation\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--loop-threshold\", type=int, default=2)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    try:\n        fingerprint = record_turn(args.state, args.history, args.loop_threshold)\n        print(\"OK: turn state recorded; fingerprint=\" + fingerprint)\n        return 0\n    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:\n        print(\"STOP: \" + str(exc))\n        return 2\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Mechanical preflight for progress claims and conversational loop risk.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nBLOCKED_PROGRESS_PATTERNS = (\n    r\"完了(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"進(?:みました|んだ|めました|めた)\",\n    r\"検証(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"確認(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"実施(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"成功(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"反映(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"解消(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"マージ(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"verified\",\n    r\"completed\",\n    r\"merged\",\n)\n\nCLAIM_PATTERNS = BLOCKED_PROGRESS_PATTERNS + (\n    r\"問題(?:ありません|なし)\",\n    r\"対応(?:済み|しました|した)\",\n)\n\n\ndef load_json(path: Path) -> dict:\n    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n\n\ndef has_progress_claim(text: str) -> bool:\n    return any(re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE) for pattern in CLAIM_PATTERNS)\n\n\ndef validate_evidence_claim(text: str, evidence: list[dict] | None) -> None:\n    if not has_progress_claim(text):\n        return\n    evidence = evidence or []\n    if not evidence:\n        raise ValueError(\"progress/completion claim requires explicit evidence records\")\n    for item in evidence:\n        if not item.get(\"kind\") or not item.get(\"path\") or not item.get(\"sha256\"):\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence record requires kind, path, and sha256\")\n        path = Path(item[\"path\"])\n        if not path.is_file():\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence file does not exist: \" + str(path))\n        actual = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()\n        if actual != item[\"sha256\"]:\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence SHA-256 mismatch: \" + str(path))\n\n\ndef validate_loop(history: list[dict], threshold: int = 2) -> None:\n    if threshold < 2:\n        raise ValueError(\"loop threshold must be >= 2\")\n    if len(history) < threshold:\n        return\n    tail = history[-threshold:]\n    fingerprints = [item.get(\"state_fingerprint\") for item in tail]\n    # Progress is represented by the structured fingerprint. Do not trust a\n    # caller-supplied progress boolean that can contradict unchanged state.\n    if fingerprints[0] and len(set(fingerprints)) == 1:\n        raise ValueError(\n            f\"forced stop: identical structured work state repeated {threshold} times\"\n        )\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--state\", type=Path, required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--text\", default=\"\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--evidence-json\", type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--history\", type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--loop-threshold\", type=int, default=2)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    try:\n        state = load_json(args.state)\n        evidence = None\n        if args.evidence_json:\n            evidence = json.loads(args.evidence_json.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        validate_evidence_claim(args.text, evidence)\n        if args.history:\n            history = json.loads(args.history.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n            if not isinstance(history, list):\n                raise ValueError(\"history must be a JSON list\")\n            validate_loop(history, args.loop_threshold)\n        print(\"OK: interaction preflight passed\")\n        return 0\n    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:\n        print(f\"STOP: {exc}\")\n        return 2\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Explicit per-turn loop gate for callers that can supply canonical state.\n\nThis does not hook into ChatGPT's runtime. A caller must invoke it once per turn\nand keep one history file per conversation/session.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport json\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\ntry:\n    from scripts import interaction_guard as guard\nexcept ModuleNotFoundError:\n    import interaction_guard as guard\n\n\ndef load_history(path: Path) -> list[dict]:\n    if not path.exists():\n        return []\n    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    if not isinstance(data, list) or any(\n        not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get(\"state_fingerprint\"), str)\n        for item in data\n    ):\n        raise ValueError(\"history must be a JSON list of state_fingerprint records\")\n    return data\n\n\ndef atomic_write_json(path: Path, data: list[dict]) -> None:\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=path.name + \".\", suffix=\".tmp\", dir=path.parent)\n    try:\n        with os.fdopen(fd, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\", newline=\"\\n\") as stream:\n            json.dump(data, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)\n            stream.write(\"\\n\")\n        os.replace(temporary, path)\n    except BaseException:\n        try:\n            os.unlink(temporary)\n        except FileNotFoundError:\n            pass\n        raise\n\n\ndef record_turn(state_path: Path, history_path: Path, threshold: int = 2) -> str:\n    state = guard.load_json(state_path)\n    history = load_history(history_path)\n    fingerprint = guard.state_fingerprint(state)\n    candidate = history + [{\"state_fingerprint\": fingerprint}]\n    guard.validate_loop(candidate, threshold)\n    atomic_write_json(history_path, candidate)\n    return fingerprint\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(\n        description=\"Record one turn's structured state; stop if it repeats without state change.\"\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\"--state\", type=Path, required=True, help=\"Path to docs/現在状態.json\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--history\", type=Path, required=True, help=\"Private JSON ledger for this conversation\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--loop-threshold\", type=int, default=2)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    try:\n        fingerprint = record_turn(args.state, args.history, args.loop_threshold)\n        print(\"OK: turn state recorded; fingerprint=\" + fingerprint)\n        return 0\n    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:\n        print(\"STOP: \" + str(exc))\n        return 2\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "# BUD — バドのための最上位ダッシュボード\n\n更新日：2026-10-17\n\n## 正本\n\n- 正本リポジトリ：takalenny-blip/ai-project\n- 現在状態正本：docs/現在状態.json\n- 現在ビュー：BUD.md / docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md\n\n## 実行環境\n\n- 現在：**work_pc**\n- 退役：vaio_p\n- work_pc clone：**unverified**\n\n## 現在地点\n\n**AI作業セッティングマニュアル第2章の承認済み構成に沿った本文更新と公式案内の確認が完了。PR #1102はopen・未マージ。2026-10-14のMarkdown保存実地検証は実施済み・部分合格で、チェックボックス変換とWritingBlockタグ混入を確認。公開ソース調査ではチェックボックス欠落の有力仮説を得たが、実機の拡張機能名・版と当日のDOMは未確認。公開ソースに外部通信処理は見当たらない一方、実機版の外部送信は未確認。初回検証を繰り返さず、次は実機拡張の識別と該当版のソース確認。GitHub Pagesのトップページ、sitemap.xml、robots.txtのURL確認は実施済みで、Google側の処理結果待ちのため同じURL確認を再実施しない。**\n\n## 作業キュー\n\n- 正本：Dropboxの固定ファイル /ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx\n- GitHubは技術状態・履歴・検証証拠を保持し、日常作業の状態を複製しない。\n- ボードを読み取れない場合は停止し、古いGitHub項目へフォールバックしない。\n## 現在の作業レーン\n\n**experience-log → Blogger下書き確認 → GitHub Pages本番公開**\n\n「一括改修」は設計を一括で行う意味であり、実装は小さな検証単位で進める。\n\n順序：**現状棚卸し → 大手術の設計 → 採用する改善を確定 → 小さな検証単位で順次実装 → 検証**。\n\n- 棚卸し：complete\n- 設計：revised_complete\n- 採用：complete\n- 実装：current_views_migrated_ci_guard_added\n- 検証：done\n\n## 現在状態モデル\n\n- docs/現在状態.jsonを技術状態・履歴・証拠の正本とし、日常作業キューの唯一の正本はDropboxの固定ファイル /ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx とする。BUD.mdとdocs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.mdは生成ビュー。\n- 自動生成：GitHub JSONは技術状態・履歴・証拠を保持する。日常作業キューはDropbox固定ボードから取得し、GitHubに作業候補や次の行動を複製しない。\n\n## 直チャット\n\n- 最新保存：**2026-10-17T09-07-03.144000+0900**\n- 最新パス：直チャット/2026-10-17_直チャット即時保存_2026-10-17T09-07-03.144000+0900.md\n- 旧連番保存：true\n- 新タイムスタンプ方式：true\n\n## 移行\n\n- 状態：complete\n- 通常工程：DiMORA本来工程へは復帰せず、経験ログを中心としたAI編集を継続する。Bloggerは下書き・表示確認、GitHub Pagesは本番公開先とする。WordPressは本番公開先として扱わない。\n- 暫定同期：BUD/引き継ぎの手動同期は終了し、現在状態JSONを正本として生成結果を一致検証する",
