[L2]   "content": "name: Save request intake\n\non:\n  pull_request_target:\n    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]\n  workflow_dispatch:\n    inputs:\n      queue_filename:\n        description: \"Queue filename under .github/save-queue/\"\n        required: true\n        type: string\n\nconcurrency:\n  group: save-intake-global\n  cancel-in-progress: false\n\npermissions:\n  contents: write\n  pull-requests: write\n\njobs:\n  intake:\n    if: >-\n      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||\n      (\n        github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&\n        startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'chat-save-request/') &&\n        github.event.pull_request.draft == false\n      )\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - name: Resolve triggering pull request\n        id: pr\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$PR_NUMBER\"\n          pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\")\"\n          head_ref=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.ref')\"\n          head_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.sha')\"\n          head_repo=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.repo.full_name')\"\n          draft=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.draft')\"\n          test \"$draft\" = \"false\"\n          test \"$head_repo\" = \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\"\n          case \"$head_ref\" in\n            chat-save-request/*) ;;\n            *) echo \"Not a save-request PR; nothing to do.\"; exit 0 ;;\n          esac\n          echo \"number=$PR_NUMBER\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_ref=$head_ref\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_sha=$head_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Resolve manual queue input\n        id: manual\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          QUEUE_FILENAME: ${{ inputs.queue_filename }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          queue_file=\".github/save-queue/$QUEUE_FILENAME\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Invalid queue filename: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n\n          # Queue files from automated intake live on the queue PR branch, not main.\n          # Resolve the unique open save-request PR containing the requested file.\n          mapfile -t prs < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"chat-save-request/\")) | [.number,.headRefName] | @tsv')\n          matches=()\n          for item in \"${prs[@]}\"; do\n            read -r number head_ref <<< \"$item\"\n            if gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/$number/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | grep -Fxq \"$queue_file\"; then\n              head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/$number\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n              matches+=(\"$number\"$'\\t'\"$head_ref\"$'\\t'\"$head_sha\")\n            fi\n          done\n          if [ \"${#matches[@]}\" -ne 1 ]; then\n            printf 'Expected exactly one open save-request PR for %s; found %s\\n' \"$queue_file\" \"${#matches[@]}\" >&2\n            printf '%s\\n' \"${matches[@]}\" >&2\n            exit 1\n          fi\n          IFS=$'\\t' read -r pr_number head_ref head_sha <<< \"${matches[0]}\"\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_sha=$head_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"source_pr=$pr_number\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Checkout trusted base branch\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n        with:\n          ref: main\n          fetch-depth: 0\n\n      - name: Set up Python\n        uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: '3.x'\n\n      - name: Check canonical save backlog\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t saves < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName,createdAt --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"save/direct-chat-\")) | [.number,.createdAt] | @tsv')\n          if [ \"${#saves[@]}\" -eq 0 ]; then\n            exit 0\n          fi\n          echo \"Existing canonical save PRs: ${saves[*]}\"\n          echo \"Stale canonical save PRs do not block intake; concurrency serializes intake runs.\"\n\n      - name: Validate and read queue entry\n        id: queue\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          if [ \"${{ github.event_name }}\" = \"workflow_dispatch\" ]; then\n            queue_file=\"${{ steps.manual.outputs.queue_file }}\"\n            head_sha=\"${{ steps.manual.outputs.head_sha }}\"\n          else\n          mapfile -t changed < <(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | sort)\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"1\"\n          queue_file=\"${changed[0]}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Unexpected queue path: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n          fi\n          tree_url=\"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/trees/${head_sha}?recursive=1\"\n          tree_json=\"$(gh api \"$tree_url\")\"\n          blob_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$tree_json\" | jq -r --arg path \"$queue_file\" '.tree[] | select(.path == $path) | .sha')\"\n          test -n \"$blob_sha\"\n          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/blobs/${blob_sha}\" --jq '.content' |\n            tr -d '\\n' | base64 --decode > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          test -s \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Diagnose runtime save category files\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          echo \"runtime_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)\"\n          echo \"runtime_script_hash=$(git hash-object scripts/check_save_request_category.py)\"\n          echo \"expected_script_hash=$(git show HEAD:scripts/check_save_request_category.py | git hash-object --stdin)\"\n          grep -n \"re.escape(heading)\" scripts/check_save_request_category.py\n\n      - name: Validate save request category\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          validation_file=\"$RUNNER_TEMP/save-request-category.md\"\n          {\n            printf '%s\\n' '## 保存対象種別'\n            printf '%s\\n' '会話記録'\n            printf '\\n'\n            cat \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          } > \"$validation_file\"\n          python scripts/check_save_request_category.py \"$validation_file\"\n\n      - name: Create isolated save branch from main\n        id: branch\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git fetch origin main\n          base_sha=\"$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)\"\n          branch=\"save/direct-chat-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n          git switch -c \"$branch\" \"$base_sha\"\n          git config user.name \"github-actions[bot]\"\n          git config user.email \"41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\"\n          echo \"branch=$branch\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"base_sha=$base_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Run canonical save script\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python scripts/save_and_currentize.py             --content-file \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"             --message '直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期'\n\n      - name: Verify atomic save result\n        env:\n          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.base_sha }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -z \"$(git status --porcelain)\"\n          test \"$(git rev-parse HEAD^)\" = \"$BASE_SHA\"\n          mapfile -t changed < <(git -c core.quotepath=false show --format='' --name-only HEAD | sed '/^$/d')\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"4\"\n          direct_chat_path=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | grep '^直チャット/')\"\n          test -n \"$direct_chat_path\"\n          expected=\"$(printf '%s\\n'             'BUD.md'             'docs/現在状態.json'             'docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md'             \"$direct_chat_path\")\"\n          actual=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | sort)\"\n          test \"$actual\" = \"$(printf '%s\\n' \"$expected\" | sort)\"\n\n      - name: Push save branch\n        env:\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push --set-upstream origin \"$BRANCH\"\n\n      - name: Open canonical save pull request\n        id: final_pr\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SAVE_PR_TOKEN }}\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$GH_TOKEN\" || { echo \"SAVE_PR_TOKEN repository secret is required.\" >&2; exit 1; }\n          final_pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls\" \\\n            -f base=main \\\n            -f head=\"$BRANCH\" \\\n            -f title='直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期' \\\n            -f body=)\"\n          final_pr_number=\"$(printf '%s' \"$final_pr_json\" | jq -r '.number')\"\n          test -n \"$final_pr_number\"\n          echo \"number=$final_pr_number\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Resolve save lifecycle after verified intake\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          QUEUE_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number || '' }}\n          FINAL_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.final_pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python - <<'PY'\n          import json\n          import os\n          import subprocess\n          import sys\n          sys.path.insert(0, \"scripts\")\n          from save_lifecycle_status import resolve\n\n          data = {\n              \"queue_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"QUEUE_PR_NUMBER\"]) if os.environ[\"QUEUE_PR_NUMBER\"] else None,\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"intake\": {\n                  \"status\": \"success\",\n                  \"source\": \"save-request-intake\",\n              },\n              \"final_save_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"FINAL_PR_NUMBER\"]),\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"canonical_readback\": {\n                  \"verified\": False,\n              },\n          }\n          result = resolve(data)\n          assert result.status == \"final_save_pending\", result\n          print(json.dumps(result.__dict__, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))\n          PY\n\n      - name: Cleanup request branch\n        if: ${{ success() && github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          SOURCE_BRANCH: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.head_ref }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push origin --delete \"$SOURCE_BRANCH\" || true\n",

name: Validate and read queue entry\n        id: queue\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          if [ \"${{ github.event_name }}\" = \"workflow_dispatch\" ]; then\n            queue_file=\"${{ steps.manual.outputs.queue_file }}\"\n            head_sha=\"${{ steps.manual.outputs.head_sha }}\"\n          else\n          mapfile -t changed < <(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | sort)\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"1\"\n          queue_file=\"${changed[0]}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Unexpected queue path: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n          fi\n          tree_url=\"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/trees/${head_sha}?recursive=1\"\n          tree_json=\"$(gh api \"$tree_url\")\"\n          blob_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$tree_json\" | jq -r --arg path \"$queue_file\" '.tree[] | select(.path == $path) | .sha')\"\n          test -n \"$blob_sha\"\n          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/blobs/${blob_sha}\" --jq '.content' |\n            tr -d '\\n' | base64 --decode > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          test -s \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Diagnose runtime save category files\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          echo \"runtime_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)\"\n          echo \"runtime_script_hash=$(git hash-object scripts/check_save_request_category.py)\"\n          echo \"expected_script_hash=$(git show HEAD:scripts/check_save_request_category.py | git hash-object --stdin)\"\n          grep -n \"re.escape(heading)\" scripts/check_save_request_category.py\n\n      - name: Validate save request category\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          validation_file=\"$RUNNER_TEMP/save-request-category.md\"\n          {\n            printf '%s\\n' '## 保存対象種別'\n            printf '%s\\n' '会話記録'\n            printf '\\n'\n            cat \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          } > \"$validation_file\"\n          python scripts/check_save_request_category.py \"$validation_file\"\n\n      - name: Create isolated save branch from main\n        id: branch\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git fetch origin main\n          base_sha=\"$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)\"\n          branch=\"save/direct-chat-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n          git switch -c \"$branch\" \"$base_sha\"\n          git config user.name \"github-actions[bot]\"\n          git config user.email \"41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\"\n          echo \"branch=$branch\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"base_sha=$base_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Run canonical save script\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python scripts/save_and_currentize.py             --content-file \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"             --message '直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期'\n\n      - name: Verify atomic save result\n        env:\n          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.base_sha }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -z \"$(git status --porcelain)\"\n          test \"$(git rev-parse HEAD^)\" = \"$BASE_SHA\"\n          mapfile -t changed < <(git -c core.quotepath=false show --format='' --name-only HEAD | sed '/^$/d')\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"4\"\n          direct_chat_path=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | grep '^直チャット/')\"\n          test -n \"$direct_chat_path\"\n          expected=\"$(printf '%s\\n'             'BUD.md'             'docs/現在状態.json'             'docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md'             \"$direct_chat_path\")\"\n          actual=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | sort)\"\n          test \"$actual\" = \"$(printf '%s\\n' \"$expected\" | sort)\"\n\n      - name: Push save branch",

exit 1; }\n          git fetch origin \"refs/heads/${REQUEST_BRANCH}:refs/remotes/origin/${REQUEST_BRANCH}\"\n          changed_files=\"$(git diff --name-only origin/main...refs/remotes/origin/${REQUEST_BRANCH})\"\n          test \"$changed_files\" = \"canonical-state-requests/request.json\" || {\n            echo \"Request PR must change only canonical-state-requests/request.json.\" >&2\n            exit 1\n          }\n          git show \"refs/remotes/origin/${REQUEST_BRANCH}:canonical-state-requests/request.json\" > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/state-update-request.json\"\n          branch=\"save/currentize-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n          git switch -c \"$branch\" origin/main\n          git config user.name \"github-actions[bot]\"\n          git config user.email \"41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\"\n          python scripts/apply_canonical_state_update.py --request-file \"$RUNNER_TEMP/state-update-request.json\"\n          git commit -m \"chore: apply reviewed canonical state update\"\n          git push --set-upstream origin \"$branch\"\n          echo \"generated_branch=$branch\" >> \"$GITHUB_ENV\"\n      - name: Open audited state update PR and close intake request\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SAVE_PR_TOKEN }}",

  head = urllib.parse.quote(f\"{owner}:{save_branch}\", safe=\"\")\n\n    prs = gh_api(f\"repos/{REPO}/pulls?head={head}&state=all&per_page=10\")\n    result = {\n        \"source_sha\": sha,\n \"html_url\": run.get(\"html_url\"),\n        },\n        \"save_branch\": save_branch,\n        \"pr\": None,\n        \"ci\": None,\n        \"approval\": None,\n        \"readback\": None,\n    }\n\n    if not isinstance(prs, list) or not prs:\n        result.update(stage=\"pr_creation\", status=\"not_found\")\n        print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))\n        return print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))\n        return 5\n\n    pr = prs[0]\n    number = pr[\"number\"]\n    head_sha = pr[\"head\"][\"sha\"]\n    result[\"pr\"] = {\n status=\"pending\")\n        code = 8\n    elif not approval_ok:\n        result.update(stage=\"approval\", status=\"missing\")\n        code = 9\n    elif not readback_ok:\n [L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Explicit per-turn loop gate for callers that can supply canonical state.\n\nThis does not hook into ChatGPT's runtime. A caller must invoke it once per turn\nand keep one history file per conversation/session.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport json\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\ntry:\n    from scripts import interaction_guard as guard\nexcept ModuleNotFoundError:\n    import interaction_guard as guard\n\n\ndef load_history(path: Path) -> list[dict]:\n    if not path.exists():\n        return []\n    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    if not isinstance(data, list) or any(\n        not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get(\"state_fingerprint\"), str)\n        for item in data\n    ):\n        raise ValueError(\"history must be a JSON list of state_fingerprint records\")\n    return data\n\n\ndef atomic_write_json(path: Path, data: list[dict]) -> None:\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=path.name + \".\", suffix=\".tmp\", dir=path.parent)\n    try:\n        with os.fdopen(fd, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\", newline=\"\\n\") as stream:\n            json.dump(data, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)\n            stream.write(\"\\n\")\n        os.replace(temporary, path)\n    except BaseException:\n        try:\n            os.unlink(temporary)\n        except FileNotFoundError:\n            pass\n        raise\n\n\ndef record_turn(state_path: Path, history_path: Path, threshold: int = 2, board_path: Path | None = None) -> str:\n    state = guard.load_json(state_path)\n    history = load_history(history_path)\n    if board_path is None:\n        configured = os.environ.get(\"DROPBOX_WORK_QUEUE_PATH\")\n        board_path = Path(configured) if configured else state_path.parent.parent / \"Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx\"\n    fingerprint = guard.state_fingerprint(state, board_path)\n    candidate = history + [{\"state_fingerprint\": fingerprint}]\n    guard.validate_loop(candidate, threshold)\n    atomic_write_json(history_path, candidate)\n    return fingerprint\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(\n        description=\"Record one turn's structured state; stop if it repeats without state change.\"\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\"--state\", type=Path, required=True, help=\"Path to docs/現在状態.json\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--history\", type=Path, required=True, help=\"Private JSON ledger for this conversation\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--loop-threshold\", type=int, default=2)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--board\", type=Path, help=\"readable local Dropbox-sync XLSX used as the queue fingerprint\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    try:\n        fingerprint = record_turn(args.state, args.history, args.loop_threshold, args.board)\n        print(\"OK: turn state recorded; fingerprint=\" + fingerprint)\n        return 0\n    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:\n        print(\"STOP: \" + str(exc))\n        return 2\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nimport sys\nsys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / \"scripts\"))\nfrom dropbox_board import validate_remote_board_from_env\nSTATE = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"現在状態.json\"\nREQUIRED_BASE = (\"execution_environment\", \"current_position\")\n\ndef dropbox_board_path():\n    configured = os.environ.get(\"DROPBOX_WORK_QUEUE_PATH\")\n    return Path(configured) if configured else ROOT / \"Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx\"\n\ndef validate_dropbox_board(path):\n    \"\"\"Fail closed unless the configured local Dropbox-sync file is a readable XLSX.\"\"\"\n    if not path.is_file():\n        raise ValueError(f\"Dropbox work board is missing or unavailable: {path}\")\n    try:\n        with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as workbook:\n            bad_member = workbook.testzip()\n            if bad_member is not None:\n                raise ValueError(f\"corrupt XLSX member: {bad_member}\")\n            required_members = {\"[Content_Types].xml\", \"xl/workbook.xml\"}\n            missing = required_members.difference(workbook.namelist())\n            if missing:\n                raise ValueError(\"not a valid XLSX workbook; missing: \" + \", \".join(sorted(missing)))\n    except (OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile, RuntimeError) as exc:\n        raise ValueError(f\"Dropbox work board is unreadable: {exc}\") from exc\n\ndef fail(message):\n    print(f\"STOP: {message}\")\n    return 1\n\ndef main():\n    try:\n        with STATE.open(encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            state = json.load(f)\n    except Exception as exc:\n        return fail(f\"canonical state unreadable: {exc}\")\n\n    queue_source = state.get(\"work_queue_source\")\n    if queue_source != \"dropbox_board\":\n        return fail(\"work_queue_source must be dropbox_board; GitHub queue fallback is disabled\")\n    if \"work_items\" in state:\n        return fail(\"legacy GitHub work_items field is retired and must not be reintroduced\")\n    if \"next_step\" in state:\n        return fail(\"legacy next_step field is retired and must not be reintroduced\")\n    required = REQUIRED_BASE\n    missing = [k for k in required if k not in state]\n    if missing:\n        return fail(\"missing required fields: \" + \", \".join(missing))\n\n    external_gate = state.get(\"external_response_gate\", {\"status\": \"clear\"})\n    if not isinstance(external_gate, dict):\n        return fail(\"external_response_gate must be an object\")\n    gate_status = external_gate.get(\"status\", \"clear\")\n    if gate_status not in {\"clear\", \"pending\"}:\n        return fail(\"external_response_gate.status must be clear or pending\")\n    contract = external_gate.get(\"reaction_contract\")\n    if not isinstance(contract, dict):\n        return fail(\"external_response_gate.reaction_contract must be an object\")\n    required_contract = (\"required_fields\", \"judgment_values\", \"rule\", \"clear_condition\")\n    missing_contract = [k for k in required_contract if not contract.get(k)]\n    if missing_contract:\n        return fail(\"reaction_contract missing: \" + \", \".join(missing_contract))\n    if gate_status == \"clear\" and external_gate.get(\"last_reaction\") is None and not external_gate.get(\"clear_reason\"):\n        return fail(\"clear external_response_gate requires last_reaction or clear_reason\")\n    reaction = external_gate.get(\"last_reaction\")\n    if reaction is not None:\n        required_reaction = (\"proposal\", \"judgment\", \"reason\", \"next_action\", \"consistency\")\n        missing_reaction = [k for k in required_reaction if not reaction.get(k)]\n        if missing_reaction:\n            return fail(\"last_reaction missing: \" + \", \".join(missing_reaction))\n        if reaction.get(\"judgment\") not in contract[\"judgment_values\"]:\n            return fail(\"last_reaction.judgment is invalid\")\n        if reaction.get(\"consistency\") is not True:\n            return fail(\"last_reaction.consistency must be true\")\n    if gate_status == \"pending\":\n        required_gate_fields = (\"purpose\", \"trigger\", \"required_action\", \"completion\")\n        missing_gate_fields = [k for k in required_gate_fields if not external_gate.get(k)]\n        if missing_gate_fields:\n            return fail(\"pending external_response_gate missing: \" + \", \".join(missing_gate_fields))\n        print(\"STOP: external proposal response is pending; react before any other work\")\n        return 3\n\n    if queue_source == \"dropbox_board\":\n        try:\n            if os.environ.get(\"DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN\"):\n                remote_path = validate_remote_board_from_env()\n                print(f\"dropbox_remote_board: read and validated {remote_path}\")\n            elif os.environ.get(\"DROPBOX_REQUIRE_REMOTE\") == \"1\":\n                raise ValueError(\"DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN is required for remote Dropbox board validation\")\n [L2]   "content": "# 運用ルール\n\n### 7-5-4-1. ブログ制作における勝手な判断・作業の禁止（必須）\n\nブログ制作では、**ルール上バドに判断権があることと、バドが勝手に判断・作業を実行してよいことを同一視してはならない。**\n\n- ブログ本文、構成、見出し、引用、強調（太字・赤字・赤＋黄等）、会話表示、HTML構造、画像、リンク、公開設定その他の記事に関係する内容について、たかの明示的な指示・確認なしに変更・追加・削除してはならない。\n- 「ルール上この形式が望ましい」「バドが判断できる」と定められている場合でも、それだけを根拠に実作業を開始してはならない。ルールは判断基準であり、作業開始の許可そのものではない。\n- 外部AIの提案・レビュー、バド自身が発見した改善案、制作途中で気づいた問題についても、採否を勝手に決めて実装してはならない。必要な場合は、変更内容・理由・対象をたかへ提示し、たかの指示を受けてから実行する。\n- たかが明示した作業範囲を超えて、関連しそうな修正を便乗して行ってはならない。例えば「A〜Cを修正してよい」と指示された場合、A〜C以外の太字追加・文章修正・構成変更等を同時に行ってはならない。\n- 一度確認済み・確定済みの本文やHTMLは、後の工程で勝手に変更してはならない。変更が必要になった場合は、変更箇所と理由を提示し、改めてたかの確認を受ける。\n- 「判断してよい」と「実行してよい」を分離する。実行許可が明示されていない場合は、提案または確認で止める。\n- この禁止は、ブログ記事の新規作成だけでなく、統合、改稿、HTML化、既存HTMLの修正、公開前の仕上げを含むブログ制作全般に適用する。\n\n**完了条件**：ブログ制作において、実施した変更がたかから明示された作業範囲内であること、未承認の判断・変更・追加・削除が混入していないことを確認する。\n\n\n## 目的\n\nこのファイルは、`ai-project` における現在の作業手順と横断的な運用ルールを一本化する。日常の作業に組み込み、保存・更新漏れや「保存したつもり」を防ぐ。\n\nまた、過去ログに残った「次の作業」を現在の命令として機械的に再実行しない。過去の成功・失敗・判断を現在の作業判断へ反映し、同じ条件で同じ失敗を無意味に繰り返さない。\n\n### 0-0. 日常作業キュー正本の切替（必須）\n\n- のキューデータは必要な技術的事実・検証証拠を移管したうえで正本から削除済み。再導入しない。\n- `BUD.md` と `docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md` はGitHub技術状態から生成される互換ビューであり、日常作業キューの代替ではない。\n- Dropboxボードが読めない・接続できない場合は作業キュー利用不可として停止し、古いGitHub `work_items` / `docs/現在状態.json` を**唯一の現在状態正本**とする。\n- `BUD.md` と `docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md` は、現在状態正本から生成される**互換ビュー**であり、現在状態の判断根拠として個別に編集・更新してはならない。\n- 現在状態を変更するPRでは、`scripts/generate_current_views.py` から両生成ビューを再生成し、同じPRに含める。保存パイプラインによる一括更新も、正本と生成ビューを同一コミットに含める。同期workflowは補助的な回復経路であり、PRの完全一致検査を代替しない。\n- guard は `docs/現在状態.json` からその場で生成したビューの妥当性に加え、チェックイン済みの `BUD.md` `docs/現在状態.json` から `work_items` / `next_step` のキューデータは削除済み。フィールドを復活させず、旧ルールも再導入しない。\n- [L2]   "content": "# ai-project\n\nたかとAIが、実際の経験・試行錯誤・判断・気づきを蓄積し、将来の自動化・記事化へつなげるための共有情報庫です。\n\n## AI・バドがこのリポジトリを初めて読む場合\n\n**最初に [`docs/現在状態.json`](./docs/現在状態.json) を読み、GitHub側の技術状態・履歴・証拠を確認してください。日常作業キューの唯一の正本はDropboxの固定ファイル `/ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx` です。**\n\n[`BUD.md`](./BUD.md) と [`docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md`](./docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md) は `docs/現在状態.json` から機械生成されるビューです。**これらを現在状態の正本として直接編集してはいけません。** 現在状態を変更する場合は、正本を更新し、生成・一致検証の仕組みに従ってビューを更新します。\n\n作業手順・運用ルールは [`rules/運用ルール.md`](./rules/運用ルール.md) に一本化しています。現在資料が構造変更後の状態と一致しているかを確認するときは [`rules/現在化・旧情報ガード.md`](./rules/現在化・旧情報ガード.md) も参照してください。\n\n### 起動時・再開時の現在化ゲート\n\n新しいチャットの開始時や作業再開時は、GitHub上の `docs/現在状態.json` を読み、技術状態・履歴・証拠を確認する。日常作業キューと優先度・状態・次のアクションはDropboxの固定ファイル `/ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx` から取得する。BUD.mdや引き継ぎは生成ビューであり、作業キューの正本ではない。\n\n- `docs/現在状態.json` と生成ビューが食い違っていた場合は、技術状態についてJSONを優先し、日常作業キューはDropboxボードを優先する。生成ビューや旧 `work_items` / `next_step` から作業を選ばない。\n- Dropboxボードを読み取れない場合は作業キュー利用不可として停止し、GitHubの旧 `work_items` / `next_step` や古い生成ビューへフォールバックしない。\n- 前回の作業完了後に新しいPR・merge・commitが存在する場合、GitHubの技術状態・証拠が実績を反映しているか確認する。日常作業の完了・優先度・次のアクションはDropboxボードを確認する。旧 `work_items` / `next_step` の不一致を日常キューとして是正・再実行しない。\n- `scripts/resume_check.py` を実行できる環境では再開ゲートとして実行する。実行できない場合も、上記のGitHub正本確認を省略してはならない。\n- `scripts/resume_check.py` はGitHubの技術状態・必須ガードを検証する。日常作業候補はDropboxボードから確認する。旧 `work_items` / `next_step` は日常作業の選定に使用しない。\n- 「昨日の最後の次の一手」「BUDの表示」「会話履歴上の次の作業」を、GitHub正本の確認なしに現在の命令として採用しない。\n\n### 推奨読解順\n\n1. [`docs/現在状態.json`](./docs/現在状態.json) — 技術状態・履歴・証拠の正本\n2. Dropbox `/ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx` — 日常作業キュー・優先度・状態・次のアクションの唯一の正本\n3. [`rules/運用ルール.md`](./rules/運用ルール.md) — 作業手順・運用ルール\n4. [`BUD.md`](./BUD.md) — 正本から生成された現在状態ビュー\n5. [`docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md`](./docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md) — 正本から生成された再開情報ビュー\n5. [`projects/`](./projects/) — 関係するプロジェクト資料\n6. [`経験ログ/`](./経験ログ/) — 必要なEXP / REC\n7. [`直チャット/`](./直チャット/) — 必要な一次記録\n8. 旧資料 — 経緯・出所・歴史を調べる必要がある場合のみ参照\n\n`docs/AI_READ_MAP.md` は読解順の補助マップ、`rules/README.md` は運用ルールの入口です。どちらも `docs/現在状態.json` の現在状態を上書きしません。\n\n## 重要な読み方\n\n- **現在の方針・現在状態は、過去の記録より優先する。**\n- 過去ログの「次にやること」は現在の命令ではない。\n- たか＋バドだけで完結できる作業は、それだけで完結してよい。\n- 過去にJUNやClaudeを利用した事実は、現在の固定的な役割分担を意味しない。\n- 直チャットは原文を一次記録とし、経験DBへの整理は別途行う。\n- 画像は主記録ではなく、必要な場合の補助記録として扱う。\n\n## 構造変更時の安全確認\n\n大規模な構造変更や正本・生成ビューの仕組みを変更した直後は、個別ファイルだけでなく、リポジトリ入口のREADME、現在状態、生成ビュー、運用ルール、CIガードの前提が相互に一致しているかを確認します。これは日常作業ごとに全体監査を行うという意味ではなく、**構造変更時だけ深い独立監査を起動し、通常運用では静かに監視する**ための条件付きガードです。監査では、次に参加するAIが古い入口情報を現在の命令として誤認しないか、実害につながる経路が残っていないかを確認します。\n\n## 現在の主要テーマ\n\n- **経験ログ → AIとの共同編集 → Blogger下書き確認 → WordPress本番公開**を現在の主線とする\n- BLOG-0001を、AIと人間が一緒に経験ログからブログを作るファーストモデルとして扱う\n- DIGA / DiMORA自動化は2026-09-21で本線から退き、既存成果・経験資産は履歴として保持する\n- 経験ログを継続的に育て、AIとの対話・掘り下げ・記事化へつなげる\n- 今回のファーストモデルで確立した共同制作の進め方を、次回以降に再利用できる形でGitHubへ残す\n\n## 現在の中心\n\n**たかが中心で、バドがたかと一緒に進める。**\n\n## 既存の主な情報領域\n\n- `docs/` — 設計・台帳・歴史資料等\n- `指針等/` — 基準・ID管理等\n- `直チャット/` — 実際の会話・作業の原文記録\n- `経験ログ/` — EXP / RECとして整理した経験\n- `projects/` — 取り組みの資料\n- `rules/` — 現在有効な運用ルール\n\n## 秘密情報\n\n公開GitHubにはパスワード、APIキー、アクセストークン、Cookie、その他の認証情報や公開すべきでない個人情報を保存しません。\n",

[L2]   "content": "# Dropbox作業管理移行：依存関係・切替対応表\n\n更新日：2026-10-16  \n対象：PR #1116 マージ後の `main`  \n状態：移行の依存関係・履歴記録。現行実装は2026-10-17のPR #1135で旧GitHubキュー参照を廃止中。PR未マージのためmainの切替完了を意味しない。\n\n## 1. 切替の境界\n\n- Dropboxの `/ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx` を、日常作業項目・状態・優先度・次の行動の管理先とする。2026-10-16に実ファイルのメタデータと抽出内容を読み戻し、固定ファイル名と現行行を確認した。\n- GitHubはソースコード、CI、技術状態、正式仕様、PR/commitの証拠、直チャット原本を保持する。\n- 切替前は `docs/現在状態.json` が起動時ゲートとして有効。Dropboxへの切替が検証されるまでは、GitHub側の入口を先行して切り替えない。\n- 既存の直チャット原本は変更・削除・改名・上書き・置換しない。訂正は別ファイルに記録する。\n- 旧作業キュー専用情報は、参照切替後に「廃止・移行先」を明記して残すか、依存と代替先の検証後に整理する。履歴・技術的証拠・原本は作業キューと同じ扱いで削除しない。\n- Dropbox統合ボードの運用ルールは優先度1〜5、既定値3。設計書に残る「優先度未指定」はボード現行ルールと矛盾するため、移行設計側を修正する。\n\n## 2. GitHub依存関係一覧\n\n| 層 | 実ファイル／仕組み | 現在の役割 | 切替方針 | 検証 |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 起動入口 | `README.md` | `docs/現在状態.json` を最初に読み、正本から作業キューを導出するよう指示 | Dropboxボードを日常キューの入口に変更。GitHubの技術資料・履歴への導線は維持 | 運用ルールの正本へ案内 | 入口自体は維持し、移行ルールの参照先を追加 | 入口検査 |\n| 運用規則 | `rules/運用ルール.md` | 現在状態JSON、work_items、生成ビューのライフサイクルを規定 | 日常キューの取得先・保留・再実行禁止・証拠・保存分離をDropbox基準へ改訂。技術的な正本・原本保護規則は残す | ルール関連テスト、コールドスタート試験 |\n| `scripts/generate_current_views.py` | JSONから `BUD.md` と引き継ぎ文書を生成 | 日常作業キューの複製をやめ、必要な技術状態・入口・保留境界のみを生成するか、用途を明記して維持 | 生成結果の決定性・一致検査 |\n| 現在状態ガード | `scripts/current_state_guard.py` | JSONのスキーマ、work_items、next_step、ビューの整合性を検査 | 技術状態と保存安全性の検査は維持。Dropboxの作業一覧と二重の正本を要求しないよう変更 | 現在状態統合テスト、CI |\n| 再開検査 | `scripts/resume_check.py` | JSONを読み、actionable・waiting_external・next_stepを検査 | 起動案内がDropboxを読み取る手順へ切り替わった後、技術状態の安全ゲートとして残す。Dropboxを取得できない場合に古いキューへ黙ってフォールバックしない | resume checkテスト、コールドスタート試験 |\n| 移行依存関係ガード | `scripts/check_dropbox_migration_map.py` | 移行表・安全境界・廃止済み旧キューコードの残存を検査 | 旧GitHubキュー専用コードを復活させない。現行のDropbox単一正本と歴史記録を区別 | ガード単体テスト、CI |\n| 入口文書検査 | `scripts/check_entry_docs.py` | README、運用ルール、AI_READ_MAPにJSON正本の文言があることを要求 | Dropbox正本の文言とGitHub技術資料の役割分離を要求するよう更新 | 生成ビュー、保存経路、直接チャット検索等を検証 | 技術的な保存経路・原本保護のテストを維持し、旧作業キュー生成への依存を除去 | workflow全体のCI |\n| 原本保護 | `scripts/check_direct_chat_immutability.py`、`tests/test_check_direct_chat_immutability.py` | 既存 `直チャット/` の変更・削除・改名を検出 | 維持。移行作業で例外化しない | PR #1116 のガードと回帰テスト |\n| 生成ビュー | `BUD.md`、`docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md` | JSONから生成される互換ビュー | 移行後の役割を明示。手動で個別編集しない。必要な情報のみ残す | 生成一致検査 |\n| 技術的正本 | `docs/現在状態.json` | 現行の起動時状態・作業キュー正本 | 切替が検証されるまでは現行契約を維持。切替後は作業キューの複製を止め、必要な技術状態・背景・移行先案内に限定 | JSONスキーマ、CI、コールドスタート |\n| 旧案内 | `docs/全体進行設計図.md`、`docs/マスタープラン.md`、`docs/正本リポジトリ.md` | 過去の正本・読解順・工程を案内している可能性 | [L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Save one direct-chat record and currentize all dependent state/views in one commit.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom zoneinfo import ZoneInfo\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nSTATE_PATH = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"現在状態.json\"\nDIRECT_CHAT_DIR = ROOT / \"直チャット\"\nBUD_PATH = ROOT / \"BUD.md\"\nHANDOVER_PATH = ROOT / \"docs\" / \"引き継ぎ\" / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\"\n\n\ndef run(*args: str) -> str:\n    return subprocess.check_output(args, cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()\n\n\ndef git_blob_sha(data: bytes) -> str:\n    header = f\"blob {len(data)}\\0\".encode(\"utf-8\")\n    return hashlib.sha1(header + data).hexdigest()\n\n\ndef merge_patch(target: dict[str, Any], patch: dict[str, Any]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Recursively merge a JSON object patch into the current state.\"\"\"\n    for key, value in patch.items():\n        if isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(target.get(key), dict):\n            merge_patch(target[key], value)\n        else:\n            target[key] = value\n\n\n\nSTATE_PATCH_BEGIN = \"<!-- BUD_STATE_PATCH_BEGIN\"\nSTATE_PATCH_END = \"BUD_STATE_PATCH_END -->\"\n\n\ndef strip_retired_embedded_state_patch(content: str) -> tuple[str, bool]:\n    \"\"\"Strip retired legacy queue metadata without parsing or trusting its contents.\n\n    Archived save-queue payloads are historical records, not an authority to update\n    canonical state. The marker block is removed before saving, and its body is never\n    parsed as JSON. Authorized technical-state changes must use --state-patch-file.\n    \"\"\"\n    pattern = re.compile(\n        re.escape(STATE_PATCH_BEGIN) + r\"\\s*\\n.*?\\n\" + re.escape(STATE_PATCH_END),\n        re.DOTALL,\n    )\n    cleaned, count = pattern.subn(\"\", content, count=1)\n    if count == 0:\n        return content, False\n    return cleaned.strip() + \"\\n\", True\n\n\ndef validate_queue_retirement(state: dict) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Enforce the Dropbox-only queue contract without deriving a GitHub queue.\"\"\"\n    if state.get(\"work_queue_source\") != \"dropbox_board\":\n        raise SystemExit(\"work_queue_source must be dropbox_board; GitHub queue fallback is disabled\")\n    if \"work_items\" in state:\n        raise SystemExit(\"legacy GitHub work_items field is retired and must not be reintroduced\")\n    if \"next_step\" in state:\n        raise SystemExit(\"legacy next_step field is retired and must not be reintroduced\")\n\n\ndef render_views() -> None:\n    subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, \"scripts/generate_current_views.py\", \"--out-dir\", \".generated-save-views\"],\n        cwd=ROOT,\n        check=True,\n    )\n    src = ROOT / \".generated-save-views\"\n    BUD_PATH.write_text((src / \"BUD.md\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    HANDOVER_PATH.write_text((src / \"現在の引き継ぎ.md\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    subprocess.run([\"rm\", \"-rf\", str(src)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--content-file\", type=Path, help=\"direct-chat markdown; stdin when omitted\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--message\", default=None)\n    ap.add_argument(\n        \"--state-patch-file\",\n        type=Path,\n        default=None,\n        help=\"optional JSON object recursively merged into docs/現在状態.json before views are generated\",\n    )\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    if run(\"git\", \"diff\", \"--cached\", \"--name-only\"):\n        raise SystemExit(\"refusing to run with pre-staged changes\")\n\n    content = (args.content_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\") if args.content_file else sys.stdin.read())\n    content, had_retired_patch = strip_retired_embedded_state_patch(content)\n    if not content.endswith(\"\\n\"):\n        content += \"\\n\"\n\n    now = datetime.now(ZoneInfo(\"Asia/Tokyo\"))\n    save_date = now.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n    timestamp = f\"{save_date}T{now:%H-%M-%S.%f%z}\"\n    filename = f\"{save_date}_直チャット即時保存_{timestamp}.md\"\n    path = DIRECT_CHAT_DIR / filename\n    if path.exists():\n        raise SystemExit(f\"refusing to overwrite existing record: {path}\")\n\n    title = f\"# 直チャット{timestamp}\\n\"\n    if not content.startswith(\"# 直チャット\"):\n        content = title + \"\\n\" + content.lstrip()\n    path.write_text(content, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n    state = json.loads(STATE_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    state[\"updated\"] = save_date\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"latest_saved\"] = timestamp\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"latest_path\"] = f\"直チャット/{filename}\"\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"latest_content_sha\"] = git_blob_sha(content.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"legacy_serial_files_preserved\"] = True\n    state[\"direct_chat\"][\"new_timestamp_naming_allowed\"] = True\n\n    # Keep canonical save metadata aligned with the sole live entrypoint.\n    state[\"save_pipeline\"][\"normal_entrypoints\"] = [\"save-request-intake.yml (pull_request_target; queue PR required)\"]\n    if args.state_patch_file:\n        patch = json.loads(args.state_patch_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        if not isinstance(patch, dict):\n            raise SystemExit(\"state patch must be a JSON object\")\n        merge_patch(state, patch)\n    if had_retired_patch:\n        # Legacy save-queue payloads are historical intake records, not an authority\n        # to mutate current canonical state. Only an explicit --state-patch-file may\n        # request a canonical-state change.\n        print(\n            \"warning: embedded legacy state patch was not applied; \"\n            \"use --state-patch-file for an explicitly authorized state update\",\n            file=sys.stderr,\n        )\n\n    validate_queue_retirement(state)\n    STATE_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    render_views()\n\n    subprocess.run([\"git\", \"add\", str(path), str(STATE_PATH), str(BUD_PATH), str(HANDOVER_PATH)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    expected = {\n        str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),\n        str(STATE_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)),\n        str(BUD_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)),\n        str(HANDOVER_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)),\n    }\n    staged_raw = subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"diff\", \"--cached\", \"--name-only\", \"-z\"], cwd=ROOT)\n    staged = set(p for p in staged_raw.decode(\"utf-8\").split(\"\\0\") if p)\n    if staged != expected:\n        raise SystemExit(f\"unexpected staged paths: {sorted(staged)}\")\n\n    subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"scripts/check_repo_integrity.py\"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"scripts/generate_current_views.py\", \"--out-dir\", \".generated-save-check\", \"--check-deterministic\"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    subprocess.run([\"cmp\", \"--silent\", \".generated-save-check/BUD.md\", \"BUD.md\"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    subprocess.run([\"cmp\", \"--silent\", \".generated-save-check/現在の引き継ぎ.md\", str(HANDOVER_PATH)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    subprocess.run([\"rm\", \"-rf\", \".generated-save-check\"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n\n    message = args.message or f\"直チャット{timestamp}保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期\"\n    subprocess.run([\"git\", \"commit\", \"-m\", message], cwd=ROOT, check=True)\n    print(run(\"git\", \"rev-parse\", \"HEAD\"))\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "from pathlib import Path\n\n\ndef test_save_currentize_does_not_overwrite_canonical_next_design_item():\n    source = Path(\"scripts/save_and_currentize.py\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    assert 'state[\"surgery\"][\"next_design_item\"]' not in source\n    assert \"通常のDiMORA本来工程へ復帰する\" not in source\n\n\ndef test_save_currentize_allows_explicit_state_patch():\n    source = Path(\"scripts/save_and_currentize.py\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    assert \"--state-patch-file\" in source\n    assert \"strip_retired_embedded_state_patch\" in source\n    assert \"had_retired_patch\" in source\n    assert \"--state-patch-file\" in source\n\n\ndef test_retired_embedded_patch_is_stripped_without_parsing_its_body():\n    from scripts.save_and_currentize import strip_retired_embedded_state_patch\n\n    content = (\n        \"historical record\\n\"\n        \"<!-- BUD_STATE_PATCH_BEGIN\\n\"\n        \"this is deliberately not JSON and must never be parsed\\n\"\n        \"BUD_STATE_PATCH_END -->\\n\"\n        \"historical tail\\n\"\n    )\n    cleaned, found = strip_retired_embedded_state_patch(content)\n    assert found is True\n    assert \"BUD_STATE_PATCH_BEGIN\" not in cleaned\n    assert \"not JSON\" not in cleaned\n    assert \"historical record\" in cleaned\n    assert \"historical tail\" in cleaned\n\n\ndef test_content_without_retired_embedded_patch_is_unchanged():\n    from scripts.save_and_currentize import strip_retired_embedded_state_patch\n\n    content = \"ordinary direct-chat record\\n\"\n    cleaned, found = strip_retired_embedded_state_patch(content)\n    assert cleaned == content\n    assert found is False\n",

**ChatGPT** *(2026/10/17 15:19:35)*

続けて、通常の実行経路を確認した。

### 確認結果

- **直チャット保存経路**：`save-request-intake.yml` から `save_and_currentize.py` に渡す際、旧埋め込みパッチを再適用しないガードがある。
- **技術状態の更新経路**：`canonical-state-request-intake.yml` が専用の更新処理を使い、旧キュー項目を拒否する。
- **再開・ループ検知経路**：Dropboxのボードを読めなければ停止し、GitHubの旧キューへフォールバックしない。
- **CI**：`current-state-guard` と `Current state views` は成功。対話ガードのテストも成功したが、Dropboxのリモート事前確認は失敗している。

### 次に見つかった改善候補

保存スクリプトには、埋め込みパッチとは別に、明示指定した状態パッチを適用する経路が残っている。専用の監査付き更新経路と役割が重なるため、ここをなくすのが次の候補だ。

ただし、その変更操作は安全性チェックでブロックされたため、別の方法で迂回してはいない。**まだ削除できたとは扱わない。**

PR #1135 は未マージのまま維持している。全件監査へ戻るのではなく、実行経路ごとのブレーキを優先して進める。

self.assertEqual(target, {\"a\": {\"b\": 3, \"keep\": 2}, \"items\": [4]})\n\n    def test_technical_patch_rejects_retired_queue_data(self):\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, \"patch must be an object\"):\n            validate_technical_patch([], {})\n\n    def test_save_pipeline_preserves_retired_queue_contract(self):\n        state = [L9]     "body": "## Summary\n- Make Dropbox's fixed file `/ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx` the sole daily work queue.\n- Delete the retired `work_items` and `next_step` fields from canonical `docs/現在状態.json`; guards reject either field if reintroduced, including an empty `work_items` placeholder.\n- Remove active rules that treated GitHub JSON or generated views as the daily queue, and remove the obsolete next-step rule section.\n- Prevent queue fallback in view generation, resume checks, save/currentize, and technical-state patch handling.\n- Update stale generated-view snapshots so they no longer display old task items or claim GitHub queue ownership.\n- Fingerprint the actual Dropbox board for loop detection rather than mutable GitHub queue fields.\n- Preserve technical evidence, historical verification records, PAT-expiry constraint linked to Issue #1059, and direct-chat originals.\n\n## Verification\n- Latest `Current state views` run 39005914715: success, including deterministic rendering, canonical-state/view pairing, integrity checks, direct-chat search smoke test, and three disposable-clone atomic-save checks.\n- Latest `Interaction control guard` run 39005913543: success.\n- Latest `current-state-guard` run 39005913553: success, including full regression tests and protection of historical direct-chat originals.\n- Latest `Main work progress gate` run 39005913615: success.\n- The `resume_check.py` job in run 39005913543 used the configured Dropbox credential and successfully read and validated the live board at `/ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx`. It confirmed the Dropbox queue source and no GitHub fallback.\n- `tests/test_resume_check.py` includes missing-board and unreadable-board fail-closed cases, rejects GitHub queue source and retired fields, and checks the pending-response gate.\n- Scope limitation: live board read validates availability, not the actual cloud outage path. Missing/unreadable cases are covered by automated local fixtures; a live Dropbox outage was not induced.\n- Current board content identifies item 003 (GitHub queue switch) and item 004 (legacy information cleanup/reference verification) as in progress/not started respectively. This PR's code and CI work contributes evidence for item 003; item 004's remaining repository-wide reference audit is not yet certified complete.\n- Dropbox board metadata last showed modification 2026-10-16 07:59:59 UTC. The board itself has not been modified by this work.\n\n## Merge policy\nChat approval was received on 2026-10-17. Do not merge as part of this update. Keep the existing PR state unchanged until the board's recorded approval/operational gate is reconciled. Do not claim the board was updated while a direct write-back path is unavailable.",

hashlib\nimport json\nimport re\nimport zipfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nBLOCKED_PROGRESS_PATTERNS = (\n    r\"完了(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"進(?:みました|んだ|めました|めた)\",\n    r\"検証(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"確認(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"実施(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"成功(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"反映(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"解消(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"マージ(?:しました|済み|した)\",\n    r\"verified\",\n    r\"completed\",\n    r\"merged\",\n)\n\nCLAIM_PATTERNS = BLOCKED_PROGRESS_PATTERNS + (\n    r\"問題(?:ありません|なし)\",\n    r\"対応(?:済み|しました|した)\",\n)\n\n\ndef load_json(path: Path) -> dict:\n    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n\n\ndef state_fingerprint(state: dict, board_path: Path) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Fingerprint the actual Dropbox board, never retired GitHub queue fields.\"\"\"\n    if state.get(\"work_queue_source\") != \"dropbox_board\":\n        raise ValueError(\"work_queue_source must be dropbox_board\")\n    if \"work_items\" in state:\n        raise ValueError(\"legacy GitHub work_items field is retired\")\n    if \"next_step\" in state:\n        raise ValueError(\"legacy next_step field is retired\")\n    if not board_path.is_file():\n        raise ValueError(\"Dropbox work board is missing or unavailable: \" + str(board_path))\n    try:\n        with zipfile.ZipFile(board_path) as workbook:\n            if workbook.testzip() is not None:\n                raise ValueError(\"Dropbox work board contains a corrupt XLSX member\")\n            required = {\"[Content_Types].xml\", \"xl/workbook.xml\"}\n            missing = required.difference(workbook.namelist())\n            if missing:\n                raise ValueError(\"Dropbox work board is not a valid XLSX workbook\")\n    except (OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile, RuntimeError) as exc:\n        raise ValueError(\"Dropbox work board is unreadable: \" + str(exc)) from exc\n    payload = {\n        \"work_queue_source\": \"dropbox_board\",\n        \"execution_environment\": state.get(\"execution_environment\", {}),\n        \"dropbox_board_sha256\": hashlib.sha256(board_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),\n    }\n    raw = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(\",\", \":\"))\n    return hashlib.sha256(raw.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()\n\n\ndef has_progress_claim(text: str) -> bool:\n    return any(re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE) for pattern in CLAIM_PATTERNS)\n\n\ndef validate_evidence_claim(text: str, evidence: list[dict] | None) -> None:\n    if not has_progress_claim(text):\n        return\n    evidence = evidence or []\n    if not evidence:\n        raise ValueError(\"progress/completion claim requires explicit evidence records\")\n    for item in evidence:\n        if not item.get(\"kind\") or not item.get(\"path\") or not item.get(\"sha256\"):\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence record requires kind, path, and sha256\")\n        path = Path(item[\"path\"])\n        if not path.is_file():\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence file does not exist: \" + str(path))\n        actual = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()\n        if actual != item[\"sha256\"]:\n            raise ValueError(\"evidence SHA-256 mismatch: \" + str(path))\n\n\ndef validate_loop(history: list[dict], threshold: int = 2) -> None:\n    if threshold < 2:\n        raise ValueError(\"loop threshold must be >= 2\")\n    if len(history) < threshold:\n        return\n    tail = history[-threshold:]\n    fingerprints = [item.get(\"state_fingerprint\") for item in tail]\n    # Progress is represented by the structured fingerprint. Do not trust a\n    # caller-supplied progress boolean that can contradict unchanged state.\n    if fingerprints[0] and len(set(fingerprints)) == 1:\n        raise ValueError(\n            f\"forced stop: identical structured work state repeated {threshold} times\"\n        )\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--state\", type=Path, required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--text\", default=\"\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--evidence-json\", type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--history\", type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--loop-threshold\", type=int, default=2)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    try:\n        state = load_json(args.state)\n        evidence = None\n        if args.evidence_json:\n            evidence = json.loads(args.evidence_json.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        validate_evidence_claim(args.text, evidence)\n        if args.history:\n            history = json.loads(args.history.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n            if not isinstance(history, list):\n                raise ValueError(\"history must be a JSON list\")\n            validate_loop(history, args.loop_threshold)\n        print(\"OK: interaction preflight passed\")\n        return 0\n    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:\n        print(f\"STOP: {exc}\")\n        return 2\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

Retired work_item_updates is rejected.\"\n        required: true\n        type: string\n\npermissions:\n  contents: write\n  pull-requests: write\n\nconcurrency:\n  group: canonical-state-update\n  cancel-in-progress: false\n\njobs:\n  prepare:\n    if: github.actor == github.repository_owner\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n        with:\n          ref: main\n          fetch-depth: 0\n      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: \"3.x\"\n      - name: Prepare atomic state bundle\n        env:\n          REQUEST_JSON: ${{ inputs.request_json }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          printf '%s' \"$REQUEST_JSON\" > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/state-update-request.json\"\n          branch=\"save/currentize-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n          git switch -c \"$branch\" origin/main\n          git config user.name \"github-actions[bot]\"\n          git config user.email \"41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\"\n          python scripts/apply_canonical_state_update.py --request-file \"$RUNNER_TEMP/state-update-request.json\"\n          git commit -m \"chore: apply reviewed canonical state update\"\n          git push --set-upstream origin \"$branch\"\n          echo \"branch=$branch\" >> \"$GITHUB_ENV\"\n      - name: Open pull request\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SAVE_PR_TOKEN }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$GH_TOKEN\" || { echo \"SAVE_PR_TOKEN repository secret is required.\" >&2; exit 1; }\n          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls\" \\\n            -f base=main \\\n            -f head=\"$branch\" \\\n            -f title=\"Canonical state update\" \\\n            -f body=\"Audited canonical-state patch. State, audit record, and generated views are one atomic commit; repository guards remain required.\"\n",

[L2]   "content": "name: Canonical state request intake\n\non:\n  pull_request_target:\n    types: [opened, reopened, synchronize]\n    branches: [main]\n    paths:\n      - \"canonical-state-requests/request.json\"\n\npermissions:\n  contents: write\n  pull-requests: write\n  issues: write\n\nconcurrency:\n  group: canonical-state-request-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n  cancel-in-progress: false\n\njobs:\n  create-audited-state-update:\n    if: >-\n      github.actor == github.repository_owner &&\n      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&\n      startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'canonical-state-request/')\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n        with:\n          ref: main\n          fetch-depth: 0\n      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: \"3.x\"\n      - name: Validate request branch and prepare atomic update\n        env:\n          REQUEST_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}\n          REQUEST_PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SAVE_PR_TOKEN }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$GH_TOKEN\" || { echo \"SAVE_PR_TOKEN repository secret is required.\" >&2; exit 1; }\n          git fetch origin \"refs/heads/${REQUEST_BRANCH}:refs/remotes/origin/${REQUEST_BRANCH}\"\n          changed_files=\"$(git diff --name-only origin/main...refs/remotes/origin/${REQUEST_BRANCH})\"\n          test \"$changed_files\" = \"canonical-state-requests/request.json\" || {\n            echo \"Request PR must change only canonical-state-requests/request.json.\" >&2\n            exit 1\n          }\n          git show \"refs/remotes/origin/${REQUEST_BRANCH}:canonical-state-requests/request.json\" > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/state-update-request.json\"\n          branch=\"save/currentize-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n          git switch -c \"$branch\" origin/main\n          git config user.name \"github-actions[bot]\"\n          git config user.email \"41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\"\n          python scripts/apply_canonical_state_update.py --request-file \"$RUNNER_TEMP/state-update-request.json\"\n          git commit -m \"chore: apply reviewed canonical state update\"\n          git push --set-upstream origin \"$branch\"\n          echo \"generated_branch=$branch\" >> \"$GITHUB_ENV\"\n      - name: Open audited state update PR and close intake request\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SAVE_PR_TOKEN }}\n          REQUEST_PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          pr_url=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls\" \\\n            -f base=main \\\n            -f head=\"$generated_branch\" \\\n            -f title=\"Canonical state update\" \\\n            -f body=\"Audited canonical-state patch submitted through the owner-only request intake. State, audit record, and generated views are one atomic commit; repository guards and normal review/merge requirements remain required.\" \\\n            --jq .html_url)\"\n          gh api -X POST \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${REQUEST_PR_NUMBER}/comments\" \\\n            -f body=\"Canonical update request processed. Review and merge the generated state-update PR: $pr_url\"\n          gh api -X PATCH \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${REQUEST_PR_NUMBER}\" -f state=closed\n",

merge_patch, validate_queue_retirement\nfrom apply_canonical_state_update import validate_technical_patch\n\n\nclass CanonicalStateUpdateTests(unittest.TestCase):\n    def test_merge_patch_recurses_and_replaces_lists(self):\n        target = {\"a\": {\"b\": 1, \"keep\": 2}, \"items\": [1, 2]}\n        merge_patch(target, {\"a\": {\"b\": 3}, \"items\": [4]})\n        self.assertEqual(target, {\"a\": {\"b\": 3, \"keep\": 2}, \"items\": [4]})\n\n    def test_technical_patch_rejects_retired_queue_data(self):\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, \"work_items/next_step updates are retired\"):\n            validate_technical_patch({\"work_items\": [{\"id\": \"old\"}]}, {})\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, \"work_items/next_step updates are retired\"):\n            validate_technical_patch({\"next_step\": {\"target\": \"old queue\"}}, {})\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, \"work_items/next_step updates are retired\"):\n            validate_technical_patch({\"current_position\": {\"summary\": \"x\"}}, {\"work_item_updates\": [{\"id\": \"old\"}]})\n\n    def test_technical_patch_rejects_nested_retired_queue_data(self):\n        payloads = (\n            {\"current_position\": {\"work_items\": []}},\n            {\"current_position\": {\"next_step\": \"old queue\"}},\n            {\"current_position\": {\"metadata\": {\"work_item_updates\": []}}},\n        )\n        for patch in payloads:\n            with self.subTest(patch=patch):\n                with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, \"work_items/next_step updates are retired\"):\n                    validate_technical_patch(patch, {})\n\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, \"work_items/next_step updates are retired\"):\n            validate_technical_patch({\"current_position\": {\"summary\": \"x\"}},\n                                     {\"metadata\": {\"work_item_updates\": []}})\n\n    def test_technical_patch_requires_nonempty_object(self):\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, \"non-empty technical-state patch\"):\n            validate_technical_patch({}, {})\n        with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, \"patch must be an object\"):\n            validate_technical_patch([], {})\n\n    def test_save_pipeline_preserves_retired_queue_contract(self):\n        state = {\"work_queue_source\": \"dropbox_board\"}\n        validate_queue_retirement(state)\n\n    def test_save_pipeline_rejects_reintroduced_legacy_queue(self):\n        for legacy_items in ([], [{\"id\": \"old\"}]):\n            state = {\n                \"work_queue_source\": \"dropbox_board\",\n                \"work_items\": legacy_items,\n            }\n            with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, \"legacy GitHub work_items field is retired\"):\n                validate_queue_retirement(state)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    unittest.main()\n",

[L9]     "body": "## Summary\n- Make Dropbox's fixed file `/ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx` the sole daily work queue.\n- Delete the retired `work_items` and `next_step` fields from canonical `docs/現在状態.json`; guards reject either field if reintroduced, including an empty `work_items` placeholder.\n- Remove active rules that treated GitHub JSON or generated views as the daily queue, and remove the obsolete next-step rule section.\n- Prevent queue fallback in view generation, resume checks, save/currentize, and technical-state patch handling.\n- Update stale generated-view snapshots so they no longer display old task items or claim GitHub queue ownership.\n- Fingerprint the actual Dropbox board for loop detection rather than mutable GitHub queue fields.\n- Preserve technical evidence, historical verification records, PAT-expiry constraint linked to Issue #1059, and direct-chat originals.\n\n## Verification\n- Latest `Current state views` run 39005914715: success, including deterministic rendering, canonical-state/view pairing, integrity checks, direct-chat search smoke test, and three disposable-clone atomic-save checks.\n- Latest `Interaction control guard` run 39005913543: success.\n- Latest `current-state-guard` run 39005913553: success, including full regression tests and protection of historical direct-chat originals.\n- Latest `Main work progress gate` run 39005913615: success.\n- The `resume_check.py` job in run 39005913543 used the configured Dropbox credential and successfully read and validated the live board at `/ChatGPT/Dropbox作業管理統合ボード.xlsx`. It confirmed the Dropbox queue source and no GitHub fallback.\n- `tests/test_resume_check.py` includes missing-board and unreadable-board fail-closed cases, rejects GitHub queue source and retired fields, and checks the pending-response gate.\n- Scope limitation: live board read validates availability, not the actual cloud outage path. Missing/unreadable cases are covered by automated local fixtures; a live Dropbox outage was not induced.\n- Current board content identifies item 003 (GitHub queue switch) and item 004 (legacy information cleanup/reference verification) as in progress/not started respectively. This PR's code and CI work contributes evidence for item 003; item 004's remaining repository-wide reference audit is not yet certified complete.\n- Dropbox board metadata last showed modification 2026-10-16 07:59:59 UTC. The board itself has not been modified by this work.\n\n## Merge policy\nChat approval was received on 2026-10-17. Do not merge as part of this update. Keep the existing PR state unchanged until the board's recorded approval/operational gate is reconciled. Do not claim the board was updated while a direct write-back path is unavailable.",

[L2]   "content": "name: Save request intake\n\non:\n  pull_request_target:\n    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]\n  workflow_dispatch:\n    inputs:\n      queue_filename:\n        description: \"Queue filename under .github/save-queue/\"\n        required: true\n        type: string\n\nconcurrency:\n  group: save-intake-global\n  cancel-in-progress: false\n\npermissions:\n  contents: write\n  pull-requests: write\n\njobs:\n  intake:\n    if: >-\n      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||\n      (\n        github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&\n        startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'chat-save-request/') &&\n        github.event.pull_request.draft == false\n      )\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - name: Resolve triggering pull request\n        id: pr\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$PR_NUMBER\"\n          pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\")\"\n          head_ref=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.ref')\"\n          head_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.sha')\"\n          head_repo=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.repo.full_name')\"\n          draft=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.draft')\"\n          test \"$draft\" = \"false\"\n          test \"$head_repo\" = \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\"\n          case \"$head_ref\" in\n            chat-save-request/*) ;;\n            *) echo \"Not a save-request PR; nothing to do.\"; exit 0 ;;\n          esac\n          echo \"number=$PR_NUMBER\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_ref=$head_ref\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_sha=$head_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Resolve manual queue input\n        id: manual\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          QUEUE_FILENAME: ${{ inputs.queue_filename }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          queue_file=\".github/save-queue/$QUEUE_FILENAME\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Invalid queue filename: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n\n          # Queue files from automated intake live on the queue PR branch, not main.\n          # Resolve the unique open save-request PR containing the requested file.\n          mapfile -t prs < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"chat-save-request/\")) | [.number,.headRefName] | @tsv')\n          matches=()\n          for item in \"${prs[@]}\"; do\n            read -r number head_ref <<< \"$item\"\n            if gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/$number/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | grep -Fxq \"$queue_file\"; then\n              head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/$number\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n              matches+=(\"$number\"$'\\t'\"$head_ref\"$'\\t'\"$head_sha\")\n            fi\n          done\n          if [ \"${#matches[@]}\" -ne 1 ]; then\n            printf 'Expected exactly one open save-request PR for %s; found %s\\n' \"$queue_file\" \"${#matches[@]}\" >&2\n            printf '%s\\n' \"${matches[@]}\" >&2\n            exit 1\n          fi\n          IFS=$'\\t' read -r pr_number head_ref head_sha <<< \"${matches[0]}\"\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_sha=$head_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"source_pr=$pr_number\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Checkout trusted base branch\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n        with:\n          ref: main\n          fetch-depth: 0\n\n      - name: Set up Python\n        uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: '3.x'\n\n      - name: Check canonical save backlog\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t saves < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName,createdAt --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"save/direct-chat-\")) | [.number,.createdAt] | @tsv')\n          if [ \"${#saves[@]}\" -eq 0 ]; then\n            exit 0\n          fi\n          echo \"Existing canonical save PRs: ${saves[*]}\"\n          echo \"Stale canonical save PRs do not block intake; concurrency serializes intake runs.\"\n\n      - name: Validate and read queue entry\n        id: queue\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          if [ \"${{ github.event_name }}\" = \"workflow_dispatch\" ]; then\n            queue_file=\"${{ steps.manual.outputs.queue_file }}\"\n            head_sha=\"${{ steps.manual.outputs.head_sha }}\"\n          else\n          mapfile -t changed < <(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | sort)\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"1\"\n          queue_file=\"${changed[0]}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Unexpected queue path: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n          fi\n          tree_url=\"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/trees/${head_sha}?recursive=1\"\n          tree_json=\"$(gh api \"$tree_url\")\"\n          blob_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$tree_json\" | jq -r --arg path \"$queue_file\" '.tree[] | select(.path == $path) | .sha')\"\n          test -n \"$blob_sha\"\n          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/blobs/${blob_sha}\" --jq '.content' |\n            tr -d '\\n' | base64 --decode > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          test -s \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Diagnose runtime save category files\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          echo \"runtime_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)\"\n          echo \"runtime_script_hash=$(git hash-object scripts/check_save_request_category.py)\"\n          echo \"expected_script_hash=$(git show HEAD:scripts/check_save_request_category.py | git hash-object --stdin)\"\n          grep -n \"re.escape(heading)\" scripts/check_save_request_category.py\n\n      - name: Validate save request category\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          validation_file=\"$RUNNER_TEMP/save-request-category.md\"\n          {\n            printf '%s\\n' '## 保存対象種別'\n            printf '%s\\n' '会話記録'\n            printf '\\n'\n            cat \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          } > \"$validation_file\"\n          python scripts/check_save_request_category.py \"$validation_file\"\n\n      - name: Create isolated save branch from main\n        id: branch\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git fetch origin main\n          base_sha=\"$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)\"\n          branch=\"save/direct-chat-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n          git switch -c \"$branch\" \"$base_sha\"\n          git config user.name \"github-actions[bot]\"\n          git config user.email \"41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\"\n          echo \"branch=$branch\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"base_sha=$base_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Run canonical save script\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python scripts/save_and_currentize.py             --content-file \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"             --message '直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期'\n\n      - name: Verify atomic save result\n        env:\n          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.base_sha }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -z \"$(git status --porcelain)\"\n          test \"$(git rev-parse HEAD^)\" = \"$BASE_SHA\"\n          mapfile -t changed < <(git -c core.quotepath=false show --format='' --name-only HEAD | sed '/^$/d')\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"4\"\n          direct_chat_path=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | grep '^直チャット/')\"\n          test -n \"$direct_chat_path\"\n          expected=\"$(printf '%s\\n'             'BUD.md'             'docs/現在状態.json'             'docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md'             \"$direct_chat_path\")\"\n          actual=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | sort)\"\n          test \"$actual\" = \"$(printf '%s\\n' \"$expected\" | sort)\"\n\n      - name: Push save branch\n        env:\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push --set-upstream origin \"$BRANCH\"\n\n      - name: Open canonical save pull request\n        id: final_pr\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SAVE_PR_TOKEN }}\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$GH_TOKEN\" || { echo \"SAVE_PR_TOKEN repository secret is required.\" >&2; exit 1; }\n          final_pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls\" \\\n            -f base=main \\\n            -f head=\"$BRANCH\" \\\n            -f title='直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期' \\\n            -f body=)\"\n          final_pr_number=\"$(printf '%s' \"$final_pr_json\" | jq -r '.number')\"\n          test -n \"$final_pr_number\"\n          echo \"number=$final_pr_number\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Resolve save lifecycle after verified intake\n        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}\n        env:\n          QUEUE_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number || '' }}\n          FINAL_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.final_pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python - <<'PY'\n          import json\n          import os\n          import subprocess\n          import sys\n          sys.path.insert(0, \"scripts\")\n          from save_lifecycle_status import resolve\n\n          data = {\n              \"queue_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"QUEUE_PR_NUMBER\"]) if os.environ[\"QUEUE_PR_NUMBER\"] else None,\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"intake\": {\n                  \"status\": \"success\",\n                  \"source\": \"save-request-intake\",\n              },\n              \"final_save_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"FINAL_PR_NUMBER\"]),\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"canonical_readback\": {\n                  \"verified\": False,\n              },\n          }\n          result = resolve(data)\n          assert result.status == \"final_save_pending\", result\n          print(json.dumps(result.__dict__, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))\n          PY\n\n      -
